    OSCC: Certified Observation-Safe Coupling Optimization for Gradient-Noise Control in Imperfect-Information Learning

    OSCC：用于不完美信息学习中梯度噪声控制的认证观测安全耦合优化

    Miaobo Hu, Shuhao Hu, Xiaobo Guo, Xin Wang, Bokun Wang, Rui Chen, Daren Zha

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OSCC develops safety criteria and a gradient-aware coupling rule to reduce policy-gradient noise in imperfect-information learning, supported by certified selection and experiments. This is a substantive algorithmic contribution to optimization for learning and decision-making, while its coupling of rollout branches is only an incidental connection to compositionality and does not address model or agent-system organization.

    OSCC 提出了安全准则和一种考虑梯度的耦合规则，以降低不完美信息学习中的策略梯度噪声，并通过认证选择和实验提供了支持。这对学习与决策优化作出了实质性算法贡献；rollout 分支耦合与组合性仅属间接关联，也没有涉及模型或智能体系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Coupled rollouts can reduce the noise of counterfactual action comparisons, but two issues prevent standard common-random-number constructions from serving as a general learning primitive in imperfect-information environments. First, an invalid coupling may expose hidden state, synchronize endogenous policy randomness, or misalign chance events after counterfactual histories diverge. Second, in multi-action policy optimization, lower return-contrast variance is not by itself the relevant objective: the optimizer depends on the return covariance matrix after projection through the local policy-gradient geometry. We introduce observation-safe counterfactual coupling (OSCC), a framework that defines an admissible class through marginal preservation, information-state safety, branch-local policy randomness, semantic event alignment, and trace-before-oracle replay. We derive a gradient-aware coupling criterion showing that, for marginal-preserving couplings, policy-gradient noise changes are determined by policy-Jacobian-weighted off-diagonal return covariance. This motivates OSCC-Select, a calibration-only selector that chooses among independent, root-only, continuation-only, and fully coupled rollouts using separate safety and gain certificates. Its gain target combines projected gradient noise with measured physical sampling cost and falls back to independent sampling whenever a simultaneous lower confidence bound does not certify improvement. On 100,000 fixed-root Leduc comparisons, the fully coupled CP-GRPO instantiation reduces return-contrast variance from 41.1158 to 18.1441, a 55.87% reduction, while preserving the declared branch marginals. With three actions, OSCC-Select chooses continuation coupling and attains gradient-noise trace 0.0783 versus 0.0917 for return-variance selection. Increasing calibration from 64 to 2,048 groups raises certification from 0.327 to 0.995.

    中文

Flow-based training fits this loop: it samples procedures in proportion to reward, and the flow through each skill credits it for the next library revision. Three obstacles stand in the way of making this self-improvement reliable: flow training suffers strategy collapse over tree-structured histories; nonnegative flow-based credit rewards frequent use as if it were benefit; and library edits rest on the task reward the policy optimizes. We introduce R$^2$ Flow, a recursive self-improvement framework that alternates policy learning, independent verification, and versioned skill-library updates on a shared-state orchestration graph. The graph merges histories that differ only in the order of independent steps, allowing flow training to pool evidence across equivalent executions. A flow-share readout of the trained flow, invariant to the backward policy, and a separate signed utility rank which skills to change, verifier evidence decides whether an edit is warranted, and a residual-variance plateau sets when to update. Committed edits reshape the graph the next policy learns on, realizing recursive skill evolution. Across question answering, mathematical reasoning, interactive decision making, and code generation, R$^2$ Flow improves task accuracy and library-edit precision over heuristic orchestration, reinforcement learning, and skill-evolution baselines, and transfers across executors. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/r2flow.

    中文

    基于 LLM 的智能体可以通过重用和修订其编排成可执行流程的技能，在不同任务中自我改进。基于流的训练适合这一循环：它按奖励成比例地采样流程，并通过每项技能中的流量，为其在下一次库修订中提供贡献归因。要使这种自我改进可靠，存在三项障碍：基于流的训练在树状历史中会出现策略崩溃；非负的基于流的贡献归因会把频繁使用当作收益来奖励；而技能库编辑依赖于策略所优化的任务奖励。我们提出 R$^2$ Flow，这是一种递归自我改进框架，在共享状态编排图上交替进行策略学习、独立验证和带版本管理的技能库更新。该图会合并仅在独立步骤顺序上有所不同的历史，使基于流的训练能够汇集等价执行的证据。训练所得流量的流量份额读出不受反向策略影响；另行计算的有符号效用对技能进行排序，以决定要修改哪些技能；验证器证据决定编辑是否有充分依据，而残差方差平台期则确定何时更新。已提交的编辑会重塑下一策略所学习的图，从而实现递归技能演化。在问答、数学推理、交互式决策和代码生成任务中，R$^2$ Flow 相较于启发式编排、强化学习和技能演化基线，提升了任务准确率和技能库编辑精度，并且能够迁移到不同执行器。代码见 https://github.com/beita6969/r2flow.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures how equivalent tool-schema transformations affect agent success and proposes a framework for auditing schema bias, finding that training helps only on seen variants. This substantially informs tool-use agent design; compositional generalization is relevant because agents must handle recombinations of tool interfaces, but the abstract does not establish a broader composition mechanism.

    本文测量了等价的工具模式转换如何影响智能体的成功率，并提出审查模式偏差的框架；研究发现，训练只对训练中见过的变体有效。这对工具调用智能体设计具有重要启示；组合泛化与此相关，因为智能体必须处理工具接口的重新组合，但摘要并未确立一种更广泛的组合机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on tool-use agentic tasks when given a fixed tool schema. Yet a tool schema is not the action space of an agent; it is merely one interface representation of it. The same executable action can be exposed through many different, functionally equivalent tool definitions, and an agent that has truly learned a task should behave consistently across them. We show that current agents often do not, a phenomenon we term schema bias. To study this systematically, we introduce an executable transformation framework that rewrites a native tool schema using nine operators, including merging and splitting tools, altering how a single tool is expressed, and distributing one action across several dependent calls. The tasks, executable actions, and reachable states remain fixed, so any change in success is attributable to the interface alone. Evaluating eleven LLMs, including two closed models, on up to 32 schema variants, we ask how large schema bias is, how it manifests, whether the difficulty of a schema variant can be predicted without a full evaluation, and whether training removes it. We find that schema bias is substantial even for the newest models: success rates range from complete failure to 97% depending solely on the schema. To reliably estimate schema difficulty, it requires running a small sample of the target queries. Training repairs a schema variant only when that variant appears in the training data.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）在使用固定工具模式的工具调用智能体任务中表现出色。然而，工具模式并不是智能体的动作空间，它只是动作空间的一种接口表示。同一个可执行动作可以通过许多功能等价的工具定义来呈现，而真正学会某项任务的智能体应当在这些不同定义下表现一致。我们发现当前的智能体往往做不到这一点，并将这种现象称为模式偏差。为系统研究这一问题，我们提出一个可执行转换框架，使用九种操作改写原生工具模式，包括合并和拆分工具、改变单个工具的表达方式，以及将一个动作分散到多个相互依赖的调用中。任务、可执行动作和可达状态均保持不变，因此任何成功率变化都只归因于接口本身。我们在最多 32 种模式变体上评估了 11 个 LLM（包括两个闭源模型），研究模式偏差有多严重、如何表现、能否在不进行完整评估的情况下预测某个模式变体的难度，以及训练能否消除它。我们发现，即使是最新模型也存在显著的模式偏差：成功率仅由模式决定，可从完全失败到 97% 不等。要可靠估计模式难度，需要对目标查询进行少量抽样运行。只有当某个模式变体出现在训练数据中时，训练才能修复该变体。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

We introduce VStress, an auditable replay contract, and VStress-CA, a correlation-aware allocation policy that estimates the conditional marginal information of an unqueried verifier on a sealed calibration split, discounts uncertainty, normalizes by call cost, and stops or abstains when the next call is not informative. The controller freezes its decision and cost ledger before joining the clean oracle; a dependence-shift alarm disables channel preference and falls back to exact-stop. The controlled audit gives the mechanism boundary: at 35% symmetric corruption, majority-5 improves balanced accuracy from 0.6578 to 0.7739, whereas at 65% it loses 0.1226 points. In the matched fixed-budget comparison, breadth, redundancy, and adaptive allocation obtain balanced accuracies 0.6048, 0.6375, and 0.6538, with 3.4216 calls per item and an RLVR score of 0.6417 for VStress-CA. Dependence diagnostics also increase from same-model repeats to cross-family channels, with conditional marginal gains of 0.0126, 0.0462, and 0.0913. These measurements turn correlation from a post-hoc warning into an auditable allocation decision.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formulates and evaluates budget allocation for checking external conditions tied to stored intentions, including a policy that reserves capacity for future opportunities. This is a substantial contribution to agent memory and resource organization; decision quality is present, but the abstract does not make reasoning mechanisms a central contribution.

    本文针对检查与已存储意图相关的外部条件，提出并评估了预算分配方法，其中包括一种为未来机会预留容量的策略。这对智能体记忆和资源组织作出了重要贡献；虽然涉及决策质量，但摘要并未将推理机制作为核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Prospective memory allows an agent to retain an intention tied to a future condition, but the stored intention does not reveal whether that condition currently holds. Checking it may require web access, multi-step tool use, and paid calls. Existing systems decide when intentions require attention, but do not allocate the resulting observations under a shared budget. We introduce the first resource-allocation formulation for the external observations required by stored intentions under a shared episode budget. BudgetPM offers two policy variants that share a hard-budget executor. BudgetPM-Static uses a lightweight Logistic scorer to learn whether a check improves the current decision. BudgetPM-Sequential distills full-episode hindsight schedules into a lightweight policy that decides when to spend or reserve capacity using only pre-query information at deployment. We evaluate BudgetPM against two public memory-agent systems, five matched controls, and four hand-designed monitoring or budget-adaptation rules. Across two benchmarks and three backbones, BudgetPM-Static outperforms adapted Mem0 and PMA workflows. On PM-Bench, its Logistic scorer reaches competitive quality--cost operating points alongside higher-capacity scorers and retains 99.9--100\% of unconstrained quality with 42--54\% fewer observations. Under severe scarcity and the same hard caps, BudgetPM-Sequential exceeds the strongest tested natural monitoring schedule by 1.92--2.58 Set F1 points. It reaches the same Set F1 and on-time recall with 16--33\% fewer observations. Matched attribution, exact-cost analysis, and a fixed-budget load intervention link this gain to competition between present and future opportunities. These results yield a demand--capacity design rule: local gating works when capacity covers demand, while future-aware supervision adds value when observations compete across time.

    前瞻记忆使智能体能够保留与未来条件相关的意图，但已存储的意图并不能揭示该条件当前是否成立。检查这一条件可能需要访问网络、进行多步工具调用并支付调用费用。现有系统会判断何时需要关注意图，但不会在共享预算下分配由此产生的观测。我们首次针对共享回合预算下存储意图所需的外部观测，提出了资源分配形式化方法。BudgetPM 提供两种共用硬预算执行器的策略变体。BudgetPM-Static 使用轻量级 Logistic 评分器，学习一次检查是否能改善当前决策。BudgetPM-Sequential 则将完整回合的事后最优调度提炼为轻量级策略，在部署时仅使用查询前信息，决定何时花费或预留容量。我们将 BudgetPM 与两个公开的记忆智能体系统、五种匹配控制方案，以及四种人工设计的监控或预算自适应规则进行评估。在两个基准和三种骨干模型上，BudgetPM-Static 的表现优于经适配的 Mem0 和 PMA 工作流。在 PM-Bench 上，其 Logistic 评分器与容量更大的评分器相比，达到了有竞争力的质量—成本权衡点；在观测次数减少 42--54% 的情况下，仍保留了无约束质量的 99.9--100\%。在严重资源匮乏且硬性上限相同的条件下，BudgetPM-Sequential 比测试中最强的自然监控调度高出 1.92--2.58 个 Set F1 点。它以少 16--33\% 的观测次数达到了相同的 Set F1 和准时召回率。匹配归因分析、精确成本分析和固定预算负载干预表明，这一增益源于当前机会与未来机会之间的竞争。这些结果得出一条需求—容量设计规则：当容量足以覆盖需求时，局部门控有效；当观测机会在不同时间之间竞争时，面向未来的监督能够带来额外价值。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CollabFlow learns how agents form teams and exchange evidence, with a flow-based objective that maintains multiple high-reward teams across rounds. This substantially advances multi-agent organization, with partial contributions to reusable team composition and outcome-based improvement; it does not investigate internal model mechanisms.

    CollabFlow 学习如何组建智能体团队并交换证据，并通过基于流的目标函数，使多个高奖励团队在不同轮次中保持活跃。这显著推动了多智能体组织的发展，也对可复用的团队组合和基于结果的改进作出了部分贡献；但它没有研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets a system improve from its own outcomes; in LLM-based multi-agent systems, Agents refine one another within a task, and outcomes improve how they collaborate across tasks. However, existing multi-agent collaboration leaves this loop open: collaboration is pre-defined at the operator level, topology-only learning keeps verbatim exchange that propagates errors, and reward maximization on a system's own outcomes concentrates on a few teams. To address these challenges, we propose CollabFlow, an RSI system of Learned Agent Collaboration: a trainable Collab-Director constructs teams of complete Agents, a frozen executor runs them, and each round's outcomes retrain the director. Within each round, the edges of a collaboration graph carry protocols of Evidence-Conditioned Communication: a receiver adopts a differing answer only when the sender's evidence is stronger by a margin, so the director learns who communicates and how. Across rounds, we further propose Collaborative Trajectory Balance (CTB), a flow-based objective that credits each team once across its construction orders and targets a reward-proportional distribution over teams, so several good teams stay in play. We also bound how far this self-generated target moves between rounds, which shrinks as records accumulate. On twelve datasets, CollabFlow outperforms all baselines and keeps improving across rounds. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CollabFlow-631E.

    中文

    递归自我改进（RSI）使系统能够根据自身结果加以改进；在基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中，智能体在任务内相互改进，而任务结果则推动它们在不同任务之间改进协作方式。然而，现有多智能体协作并未形成完整的这一循环：协作在算子层面是预先定义的，仅学习拓扑结构的方法会保留逐字交流，从而传播错误，而基于系统自身结果进行奖励最大化又会使少数团队占据主导。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 CollabFlow，一种学习智能体协作（Learned Agent Collaboration）的 RSI 系统：可训练的 Collab-Director 构建由完整智能体组成的团队，冻结的执行器运行这些团队，并在每一轮结束后利用结果重新训练指挥器。在每一轮中，协作图的边承载证据条件通信（Evidence-Conditioned Communication）协议：只有当发送方的证据以一定幅度强于接收方时，接收方才会采纳不同的答案，因此指挥器能够学习谁与谁通信以及如何通信。在不同轮次之间，我们进一步提出协作轨迹平衡（Collaborative Trajectory Balance，CTB），这是一种基于流的目标函数：它会对每个团队的各种构建顺序统一计分一次，并以按奖励成比例的团队分布为目标，从而让多个优秀团队持续参与。我们还对这一自行生成的目标在不同轮次间的变化幅度给出上界；随着记录累积，该上界会收窄。在十二个数据集上，CollabFlow 优于所有基线，并且持续逐轮改进。代码见 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CollabFlow-631E。

    Serhii Zabolotnii

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper defines runtime assurance contracts that govern when high-risk agents may act, using mandatory gates and state transitions, and tests them with synthetic failure cases. This is a substantial contribution to agent control and policy design; its connection to reasoning is incidental because it evaluates authority decisions, not how models reason.

    本文定义了运行时保障契约，借助强制门槛和状态转移规定高风险智能体何时可以采取行动，并通过合成故障案例进行测试。这对智能体控制和策略设计作出了重要贡献；它与推理的联系只是附带的，因为研究评估的是权限决策，而非模型如何推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Benchmarks, audits, and agent protocols describe performance, permissions, and repair, but not how observed evidence should change an agent's authority during a consequential task. We propose a Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC), a policy-level formal schema binding autonomy boundaries, component eligibility, evidence state, transition policy, human-review capacity, and non-compensatory gates. Under RAC, soft metrics may inform routing, whereas a failed or unknown mandatory gate forces retry, switch, escalation, deferral, or stop; aggregate performance cannot authorize action. We define the contract, an evidence record, a permission rule, and five invariants. A deterministic failure-injection study in agentic coding evaluates 174 cases, each a distinct mechanism, under a gate conjunction, a score-only rule, and a restricted protocol baseline. At the published example weights and threshold, the score rule admits 56 of 63 block-required injections and all 24 review-required injections; tuned in hindsight, it matches the conjunction case for case. For positive weights, a positive threshold, binary risk signals, and each signal firing alone on some case, the two rules agree on every case if and only if the threshold does not exceed the smallest weight. On 124 further cases written blind by a model of another vendor, the conjunction itself admits 35 of 79 injections, and so does the tuned score rule: a missing detector is invisible to every decision rule. Eighteen hand-authored traces check version-pinned evidence and review transitions. In a prospective synthetic holdout of 24 episodes, RAC and a separately implemented full stateful baseline both match the labels of two blinded LLM judges. These studies test mechanisms on synthetic cases; they establish neither deployed safety nor cross-domain effectiveness.

    中文

    基准测试、审计和智能体协议描述了性能、权限和修复方式，却没有说明在后果重大的任务中，观测到的证据应如何改变智能体的权限。我们提出运行时保障契约（Runtime Assurance Contract，RAC），这是一种策略层面的形式化模式，用于绑定自主性边界、组件资格、证据状态、状态转移策略、人工审核能力和不可补偿门槛。在 RAC 下，软指标可以用于路由，而未通过或状态未知的强制门槛则会触发重试、切换、升级处理、延期或停止；总体性能不能授权执行动作。我们定义了该契约、证据记录、权限规则和五项不变量。在智能体编程任务中开展的确定性故障注入研究评估了 174 个案例，每个案例对应一种不同机制，并比较门槛合取规则、纯评分规则和受限协议基线。在公布的示例权重和阈值下，评分规则放行了 63 个必须拦截的注入案例中的 56 个，以及全部 24 个必须审核的注入案例；通过事后调参，它在每个案例上都与合取规则一致。对于正权重、正阈值、二元风险信号，且每个信号都至少在某个案例中单独触发的情况，当且仅当阈值不超过最小权重时，两种规则才会在所有案例上保持一致。在另外 124 个由另一家供应商的模型盲写的案例中，合取规则本身放行了 79 个注入案例中的 35 个，调优后的评分规则也一样：任何决策规则都无法察觉缺失的检测器。18 条人工编写的轨迹用于检查固定版本的证据和审核状态转移。在一项前瞻性合成留出评估中，对于 24 个回合，RAC 和一个单独实现的完整状态化基线都与两位盲测 LLM 评审的标签一致。这些研究在合成案例上检验机制；它们既不能证明实际部署中的安全性，也不能证明跨领域有效性。

    The paper develops a theoretically grounded method for selecting MoE experts by modeling redundancy and synergy between them, with a monotone optimization algorithm.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models effectively scale model capacity through sparse activation, their deployment is often bottlenecked by prohibitive memory requirements. Extracting a compact subset of experts presents a promising solution. However, existing expert selection heuristics predominantly rely on Top-k ranking, which isolates the evaluation of individual experts and ignores the intricate inter-expert dependencies introduced by the MoE gating network. In this paper, we propose DS-MoE, a theoretically grounded framework that redefines expert selection via difference-of-submodular (DS) optimization. By analyzing the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss degradation, we reveal functional duality within expert combinations: redundancy (where experts encode overlapping representations) and synergy (where experts provide complementary error cancellation). To navigate this duality, we mathematically decouple redundancy reduction from synergy maximization by formulating the selection objective as a DS function. Furthermore, we devise a tailored majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm with provable monotonicity guarantees to efficiently identify the optimal expert subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DS-MoE effectively preserves indispensable expert combinations, achieving superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines.

    Sahel Torkamani, Henry Gouk, Rik Sarkar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces magnitude potential as a geometric measure of how data points are represented, using it to examine generalization, memorization, decision boundaries, and grokking. This is a substantial representation-geometry contribution, while modular arithmetic is an evaluation setting rather than a contribution to compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文提出幅度势作为一种几何度量，用于衡量数据点如何被表征，并借此考察泛化、记忆、决策边界和 grokking。这对表征几何作出了重要贡献；模运算只是评估场景，并非对组合泛化或推理机制的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Explaining generalization and training dynamics in neural networks remains a challenge, and various approaches have been developed to study different aspects of these phenomena. In this paper, we introduce the idea of {\em magnitude potential} -- a quantity based on the theory of metric magnitude -- that reflects how well an arbitrary point is represented by a given set. We find that this basic quantity can be applied to examine various features in neural generalization. The ratio between the magnitude potential with respect to a class and with respect to the entire data, computed at the logit layer, is informative of the representation of the point. In experiments, these ratios for individual training points are found to be correlated with the Feldman memorization scores. Magnitude potential ratios aggregated across points detect structural changes in the decision boundaries and provide a geometric indicator of grokking in modular arithmetic. Although the magnitude potential ratio and neural collapse are both closely associated with intra-class and inter-class geometric structure, the magnitude potential ratio remains informative even when neural collapse is explicitly suppressed.

    Miaobo Hu, Shuhao Hu, Xiaobo Guo, Xin Wang, Bokun Wang, Daren Zha

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FSPO contributes a controller, risk calibration, and resource-feasibility methods for adaptive LLM RL post-training, with empirical gains and fewer trajectory failures. This advances training and adaptive resource allocation, but the abstract does not focus on reasoning mechanisms or compositional capabilities.

    FSPO 为自适应 LLM RL 后训练提出了控制器、风险校准和资源可行性方法，并取得了实证性能提升、减少了轨迹失败。这推动了训练和自适应资源分配的发展，但摘要并未聚焦于推理机制或组合能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adaptive LLM reinforcement-learning post-training changes multiple training actuators online, including rollout temperature, group size, clipping, KL regularization, verifier allocation, and update budget. Three coupled issues remain unresolved. A future-risk model trained from behavior trajectories need not estimate the risk induced by the controller that will be deployed; a score calibrated on logged state-action pairs can become miscalibrated after selective action choice; and independent per-resource minimum costs do not in general certify a feasible multi-resource continuation. We introduce FSPO, a feedback-state controller for budgeted LLM RL post-training that addresses these issues jointly. FSPO learns a policy-consistent risk-to-go model whose Bellman target follows the same frozen controller used for future decisions, together with a long-horizon utility model. Decision-conditioned trajectory calibration (DCTC) calibrates risk on cross-fitted trajectories generated by actions selected by provisional controllers. A Pareto resource continuation certificate (PRCC) admits an action only when a non-dominated cumulative reservation remains feasible over the residual horizon. Under a matched GRPO resource envelope, FSPO reaches 66.11% held-out and 59.43% OOD accuracy, compared with 64.47% and 57.03% for PB2, the strongest evaluated adaptive baseline. Three paired training seeds give gains of +2.42 and +3.19 percentage points over the contextual bandit on held-out and OOD evaluation. Under high behavior-deployment mismatch, policy-consistent risk lowers selected-decision ECE from 0.108 to 0.053; DCTC lowers it from 0.039 to 0.022 at matched acceptance; PRCC removes false-feasible admissions on an 18-action catalog ($0.197\rightarrow0.000$); and enabling all three components reduces trajectory failure from 0.181 to 0.083 in a factorial ablation.

    中文

    自适应 LLM 强化学习后训练会在线调整多种训练控制量，包括 rollout 温度、组大小、裁剪、KL 正则化、验证器分配和更新预算。仍有三个相互关联的问题尚未解决：基于行为轨迹训练的未来风险模型未必能估计将要部署的控制器所导致的风险；在记录的状态—动作对上校准的分数，在经过选择性动作选择后可能变得校准不准；各资源独立的最低成本通常无法证明多资源的后续过程可行。我们提出 FSPO，这是一种用于预算约束下 LLM RL 后训练的反馈状态控制器，能够联合处理这些问题。FSPO 学习一个策略一致的剩余风险模型，其 Bellman 目标遵循用于未来决策的同一个冻结控制器，并同时学习一个长时域效用模型。决策条件轨迹校准（DCTC）在由临时控制器所选动作生成的交叉拟合轨迹上校准风险。帕累托资源续航证书（PRCC）仅当剩余时域内仍存在可行的非支配累计预留量时，才允许采取某个动作。在匹配的 GRPO 资源范围下，FSPO 的留出准确率和分布外（OOD）准确率分别达到 66.11% 和 59.43%，而评估中最强的自适应基线 PB2 分别为 64.47% 和 57.03%。三个配对训练随机种子在留出评估和 OOD 评估中，相较上下文老虎机分别提高了 +2.42 和 +3.19 个百分点。在行为与部署高度不匹配时，策略一致风险将所选决策的 ECE 从 0.108 降至 0.053；在接受率匹配时，DCTC 将 ECE 从 0.039 降至 0.022；PRCC 在包含 18 个动作的目录上消除了错误的可行准入（$0.197\rightarrow0.000$）；在因子消融实验中，启用全部三个组件将轨迹失败率从 0.181 降至 0.083。

    RealtimeWAM: One-Step Asynchronous World Action Models

    RealtimeWAM：单步异步世界动作模型

    Chengtao Lv, Jinyang Du, Shuyi Feng, Yang Yong, Shiqiao Gu, Shunzi Yang, Ruihao Gong, Shen Ren, Tianwei Zhang, Wenya Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RealtimeWAM combines teacher-anchored consistency distillation for one-step action generation with asynchronous pipelining across video and action experts, achieving large inference speedups with little performance loss. Its main contribution advances efficient computation and coordination within a model system; action prediction is present, but the abstract does not establish a contribution to general reasoning mechanisms.

    RealtimeWAM 将用于单步动作生成的教师锚定一致性蒸馏与视频专家和动作专家之间的异步流水线相结合，在性能损失很小的情况下大幅提升推理速度。其主要贡献在于推进模型系统内部的高效计算与协同；虽然涉及动作预测，但摘要并未证明其对通用推理机制有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World Action Models (WAMs) incorporate visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Recent efficient WAMs adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures and compute video representations once for reuse by the action expert. However, intra-expert iteration (\ie, multi-step action denoising) and inter-expert waiting (\ie, sequential execution of the video and action experts) still limit inference efficiency. To this end, we present RealtimeWAM, an extremely efficient WAM variant with one-step action generation and asynchronous inference, addressing these two bottlenecks. To reduce intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) to address a local-global error gap: low local consistency error alone does not guarantee accurate final actions. TACD supplements local consistency with explicit supervision from the frozen teacher's multi-step rollout endpoint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Additionally, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP) to eliminate unnecessary expert-level waiting. It overlaps the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks (\eg, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin) and model variants (\eg, Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM) demonstrate the superiority of RealtimeWAM. Notably, RealtimeWAM maintains near-lossless performance (\ie, $<1\%$ drop) across these benchmarks while delivering significant end-to-end speedup (\eg, $\sim25\times$ on H100). Our code and checkpoints are available via this \href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/scripts/realtimewam}{link}.

    中文

    世界动作模型（WAM）融合来自视频生成骨干网络的视觉表征，以引导动作预测。近期高效的 WAM 采用 Transformer 混合（MoT）架构，并仅计算一次视频表征，供动作专家重复使用。然而，专家内迭代（\ie，多步动作去噪）和专家间等待（\ie，视频专家与动作专家顺序执行）仍限制着推理效率。为此，我们提出 RealtimeWAM，这是一种极高效的 WAM 变体，采用单步动作生成和异步推理，旨在解决这两个瓶颈。为减少专家内迭代，我们提出教师锚定一致性蒸馏（TACD），以弥合局部与全局误差之间的差距：仅有较低的局部一致性误差并不能保证最终动作准确。TACD 在局部一致性约束之外，补充来自冻结教师多步 rollout 终点的显式监督，从而实现准确的单步动作生成。此外，我们提出跨专家波前流水线（CEWP），以消除不必要的专家级等待。它通过按块共享视频 KV 缓存，使两个专家的执行重叠，并仅在相应的动作注意力即将使用缓存时进行同步。在多个不同基准（\eg，LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin）以及多种模型变体（\eg，Fast-WAM 和 Faster-WAM）上的大量实验表明，RealtimeWAM 表现优异。值得注意的是，RealtimeWAM 在这些基准上保持了近乎无损的性能（\ie，$<1\%$下降），同时实现了显著的端到端加速（\eg，在 H100 上达到$\sim25\times$）。我们的代码和检查点可通过此\href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/scripts/realtimewam}{链接}获取。

    Learnable Spectral Activations

    可学习频谱激活

    Tamir Shor, Or Litany, Alex Bronstein

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Learnable spectral activations factor representation into feature selection and learned harmonic shaping, with evidence that this improves signal fitting. The explicit composition of frequencies supports a strong CompGen connection; the factorization offers partial representation-mechanism insight, but the paper does not investigate learned mechanisms in trained models.

    可学习频谱激活将表示因子分解为特征选择与学习得到的谐波整形，并有证据表明这能改善信号拟合。对频率进行显式组合与 CompGen 有较强关联；这种因子分解也带来一定的表示机制洞见，但论文并未研究训练模型中的学习机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Implicit neural representations (INRs) are shaped by the spectral structure induced by their input encodings and activation functions. Existing methods improve fitting primarily by modifying which frequencies are available to the network, through coordinate encodings or periodic nonlinearities. However, frequency access is not the only bottleneck: signals with localized or spatially varying structure require the network to efficiently compose frequencies into multi-harmonic internal responses. We introduce learnable spectral activations (LSA), which replace fixed neuron-level nonlinearities with a residual truncated Fourier series whose harmonic amplitudes are learned during training. LSA does not expand the asymptotic function class. Instead, it changes the factorization of the representation: linear weights select features while activation coefficients control spectral shaping, and the two are updated by separate gradients. Because the activation output is affine in the coefficients given fixed pre-activations, spectral tuning becomes a more direct subproblem compared to architectures where it is entangled with feature selection. Empirically, this factorization concentrates more target-signal energy in the leading eigenmodes of the neural tangent kernel, consistent with improved optimization behavior. Across audio, image, neural radiance field, and neural acoustic field tasks, LSA also improves reconstruction quality.

    中文

    隐式神经表示（INR）受其输入编码和激活函数所诱导的频谱结构影响。现有方法主要通过坐标编码或周期性非线性函数，改变网络可利用的频率来改善拟合。然而，频率访问并非唯一瓶颈：具有局部结构或空间变化结构的信号，需要网络能够高效地将频率组合成多谐波内部响应。我们提出可学习频谱激活（LSA），以残差截断傅里叶级数取代固定的神经元级非线性函数，并在训练过程中学习其谐波振幅。LSA 不会扩展渐近函数类，而是改变表示的因子分解方式：线性权重选择特征，激活系数控制频谱整形，并通过彼此独立的梯度更新。给定固定的预激活值时，激活输出关于这些系数是仿射的，因此，与频谱调节和特征选择纠缠在一起的架构相比，频谱调节成为一个更直接的子问题。实证结果表明，这种因子分解会使更多目标信号能量集中于神经切线核的主导特征模态，与优化行为的改善一致。在音频、图像、神经辐射场和神经声场任务中，LSA 也提升了重建质量。

    ENGLISH

    Recent game design agents have made substantial progress in generating playable games. However, program correctness does not ensure an enjoyable experience for players. We present Recursive Game Creator, an experience-oriented harness to advance agentic game development from rough game prototypes into entertaining games. Recursive Game Creator organizes recursive development around four components: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer translates user instructions and Reviewer's feedback into detailed plans. The Builder turns these plans into candidate games. The coding-native Player creates and executes reusable policies through programmatic interfaces to efficiently collect diverse gameplay trajectories, mitigating evaluation bias caused by slow GUI-based collection. The Reviewer uses carefully designed trajectory-based metrics to induce player preferences, integrating with visual evidence and explicit textual preferences to evaluate games against game-specific criteria. Finally, the Reviewer accepts the better version and provides improvement reviews for the next round, closing the recursive loop. Our method achieves state-of-the-art overall performance of 77.89 on GameCraft-Bench. On GameASG-Bench, it achieves a strict task success rate of 53.2%, a 34.1% improvement over the same-model baseline, and the highest mean runtime-check pass rate at 93.4% among compared methods. A user study shows longer playtime and higher ratings. Project page is at: https://imbaldy.github.io/recursive-game-creator/.

Fine-tuning can update the model, but it requires access to model weights and additional training. Parameter-free methods avoid training, but they may overfit a fixed validation set, lack reliable domain knowledge, or lose visual details by saving experience only as text. To address these limitations, we present a model-agnostic framework that allows frozen LLMs and VLMs to learn from deployment experience through three forms of external expertise: a Skill that guides reasoning and tool use, a Knowledge Memory that stores reliable facts supported by earlier cases or trusted external evidence, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base that keeps visual examples and guides the model to relate each retrieved case to the current image. Instead of relying on a fixed validation set, a validation strategy keeps an update only if it helps on new cases without degrading performance on earlier ones. Across six benchmarks covering clinical diagnosis, clinical workflows, medical reasoning, and medical and non-medical visual reasoning, and with four open-weight and closed-source base models, our framework improves performance during online deployment by up to 34.2% over the base model on medical tasks, generalizes to unseen cases, transfers to other models without further optimization, and works in non-medical domains.

    大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）通常在部署后保持冻结，因此无法从自己处理过的案例中学习。这在医学领域尤其令人担忧，因为新的临床证据、更新的指南和新疗法都可能改变既定实践。微调可以更新模型，但需要访问模型权重并进行额外训练。无参数方法无需训练，但可能对固定验证集过拟合、缺乏可靠的领域知识，或因仅以文本保存经验而丢失视觉细节。为解决这些限制，我们提出一个与模型无关的框架，使冻结的 LLM 和 VLM 能通过三种外部专长形式从部署经验中学习：指导推理和工具使用的 Skill、存储由先前案例或可信外部证据支持的可靠事实的 Knowledge Memory，以及保留视觉示例并引导模型将检索到的案例与当前图像联系起来的 Multimodal Knowledge Base。该框架不依赖固定验证集，而是采用一种验证策略：只有当某项更新能帮助处理新案例且不降低先前案例上的表现时，才予以保留。在涵盖临床诊断、临床工作流程、医学推理以及医学和非医学视觉推理的六个基准上，使用四种开放权重和闭源基础模型进行评估后，我们的框架在在线部署期间使医学任务表现相比基础模型最高提升 34.2%，能够泛化到未见案例、无需进一步优化即可迁移到其他模型，并且也适用于非医学领域。

    ENGLISH

    Transformers have in-context learning capabilities, where some known learning algorithms can be executed in the forward pass through the model. Recent work shows that transformers can exactly perform Lloyd's algorithm for $k$-means clustering with $n$ points in $d$ dimensions with an embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = d+k$ (thus, requiring attention projection matrices of size $(d+k)^2$). In this work, we build upon this result in the following ways: First, we present an equally expressive but smaller transformer that executes Lloyd's algorithm with embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = (d + \lceil \log_2 k \rceil)$. Next, we train these transformers to learn the clustering algorithms given a distribution of clustering tasks, and theoretically characterize and empirically validate the factors affecting the convergence and in-distribution generalization of learning algorithms based on stochastic gradients. Finally, we probe the general clustering abilities of these learned algorithms (in the form of transformers), and try to understand situations where they succeed and fail.

    Meghanadh Pulivarthi, Swaraj Kumar Biswal, Kushagra Bhushan, Yatin Nandwani, Sachindra Joshi, Dinesh Raghu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RIT-RAG combines retrieval with structural navigation and an LLM agent that selects document nodes and reformulates queries, advancing agentic information access. Its compositional and reasoning connections are incidental to organizing retrieval and producing answers; the abstract does not claim insight into compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    RIT-RAG 将检索与结构化导航结合，并由 LLM 智能体选择文档节点、改写查询，推进了智能体式信息访问。它与组合和推理的关联只是组织检索及生成答案的附带结果；摘要没有声称其揭示了组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in external corpora. Agentic RAG enables iterative search, yet exposes the model to isolated chunks without document structure, making it difficult to distinguish relevant evidence from chunks that merely resemble the query. Structure-aware methods such as PageIndex navigate using the structure but cannot scale to structures of large corpora that cannot fit in the LLM context. Hence, they first commit to a single document using a document retriever and cannot recover from a wrong choice. We propose RIT-RAG (Retrieval-Induced Tree RAG), which combines content retrieval with structural navigation. Offline, RIT-RAG builds a tree for each document from its table of contents or sitemap. At query time, it retrieves a broad set of chunks and uses their positions to induce manageable sub-trees, potentially across multiple documents. An LLM agent navigate these sub-trees, selectively reads promising nodes, and reformulates queries when needed. Thus, retrieval proposes where to look, while the agent decides what to read. Across financial, scientific, and customer-support benchmarks, RIT-RAG achieves the highest answer accuracy among vanilla, graph-based, and agentic baselines. On EntQABench, our new benchmark of 2.84 million technical-documentation webpages, it improves accuracy by 6.6--11.4 points over the strongest baseline across three LLMs.

    中文

    检索增强生成（RAG）将语言模型建立在外部语料库提供的依据之上。智能体式 RAG 支持迭代搜索，但会让模型接触不到文档结构的孤立文本块，因此难以区分相关证据与仅仅类似查询的文本块。PageIndex 等结构感知方法利用结构导航，但对于无法放入 LLM 上下文的大型语料库结构，这类方法难以扩展。因此，它们会先借助文档检索器选定单个文档，若选错便无法恢复。我们提出 RIT-RAG（检索诱导树 RAG），将内容检索与结构导航结合起来。在离线阶段，RIT-RAG 根据每份文档的目录或站点地图构建一棵树。在查询阶段，它检索一组广泛的文本块，并根据这些文本块的位置诱导出易于处理的子树，范围可以跨越多个文档。LLM 智能体遍历这些子树，有选择地读取有希望的节点，并在需要时改写查询。因此，检索负责提出应查看的位置，而智能体负责决定读取什么。在金融、科学和客户支持基准测试中，RIT-RAG 的答案准确率高于原生、基于图和智能体式基线。在我们新建的 EntQABench 基准上（包含 284 万个技术文档网页），与最强基线相比，RIT-RAG 在三个 LLM 上将准确率提高了 6.6--11.4 个百分点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.

    With the rapid proliferation of social media, harmful memes have become a growing threat to online ecosystems. Recent studies have introduced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and external knowledge into harmful meme detection. However, existing methods mainly retrieve similar instances or auxiliary information, limiting their ability to capture reusable harmfulness knowledge and underlying reasoning mechanisms, and thus constraining both detection performance and interpretability.     Large language model serving is increasingly limited not only by model size and GPU speed, but also by scheduling during autoregressive decoding, where continuous batching interleaves requests at token granularity as sequences arrive and finish. We study whether lightweight scheduling policies can improve latency-throughput tradeoffs without changing model architectures, kernels, or deploying learned schedulers. We implement a Python/PyTorch continuous-batching testbench with real Hugging Face execution and evaluate eight policies across 1,152 GPU-model-scheduler-workload runs using ShareGPT-derived traffic, six Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral models, and Modal L40S, A100, and H100 GPUs. Scheduler choice changes throughput, TTFT, completion latency, and tail behavior under fixed model, GPU, workload, batch size, and prefill budget. Aging shortest-prompt-first is the strongest practical baseline in many L40S and mixed-workload settings, while oracle remaining-length scheduling shows that job-size knowledge alone is insufficient because batching and hardware effects also shape performance. The custom dataset has been uploaded to Hugging Face.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Dream2Discern 利用审计器引导的潜在扰动训练多智能体执行结果的运行时预测，是一种改进智能体系统监控的实质性方法。表征算子在此用作增广工具，而非用于研究内部表征；结果预测本身并不等同于推理能力。

    ENGLISH

    Reliable deployment of LLM-based multi-agent systems calls for runtime auditors that predict terminal outcomes from observed execution prefixes. These auditors typically learn from a limited corpus of trajectories with verified outcomes. Expanding this corpus requires costly execution and verification, yet broader failure coverage alone provides no explicit criterion for identifying prefixes that the current auditor finds difficult to classify. To this end, we propose Dream2Discern, a runtime auditor trained through implicit augmentation guided by its own prediction loss. During Dream, we select perturbations of the auditor's representation operators to increase prediction loss on recorded prefixes, yielding hard latent variants. During Discern, the auditor learns to predict execution outcomes from these variants using the original labels. The variants are regenerated as the auditor learns, turning a limited corpus into a renewable source of hard examples and requiring no additional trajectory collection or outcome verification. Extensive evaluations on AFTraj-2K and StepShield show that Dream2Discern outperforms competitive failure auditors and achieves over 90% trajectory-level weighted accuracy on both benchmarks while balancing prediction accuracy and timeliness.     本文推导了 TTT 记忆更新中与预测相关的分量，并通过干预测试其行为贡献，为快速权重关联如何被修正提供了重要的机制层面见解。本文也直接研究模型系统中的测试时记忆；语言模型评估与推理能力的关系只是附带的，而摘要并未考察推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-time-training (TTT) layers update fast-weight memory while processing an input sequence. A gradient-based update, however, does not by itself establish how the memory revises an existing association. We study the structure and empirical role of prediction-derived updates in released TTT implementations. For dot-product objectives, we characterize the absence of a prediction-error residual and establish conditions under which inner-loop ascent and descent are equivalent after reparameterization. For the LayerNorm-based squared-error objective used by TTT-Linear and TTT-MLP, we derive the inner gradient and identify a prediction-derived component that cancels at the released initialization in the zero-epsilon limit. We then measure the full normalized prediction's contribution on three trained checkpoints. Removing this contribution while retaining the LayerNorm Jacobian gives a mean gradient norm ratio of 0.25 to 0.32 across the models. On 100,303 tokens from War and Peace, the same intervention with local per-token norm matching raises perplexity by 2.8-2.9% on TTT-Linear-760M and 1.3B, whereas freezing all fast-weight updates raises it by factors of 4.2-4.5. Separate synthetic tests illustrate the dependence of plain delta-rule overwriting on step size. The results distinguish a prediction-derived update from its behavioral value and show why implementation analysis and live interventions are both needed to assess test-time memory.

    测试时训练（TTT）层在处理输入序列时会更新快速权重记忆。然而，基于梯度的更新本身并不能说明记忆如何修正已有的关联。我们研究了已发布 TTT 实现中由预测导出的更新的结构及其经验作用。对于点积目标，我们刻画了预测误差残差的缺失，并确定了在重新参数化后内循环上升与下降等价的条件。对于 TTT-Linear 和 TTT-MLP 所使用的基于 LayerNorm 的平方误差目标，我们推导了内循环梯度，并识别出一个由预测导出的分量：在零 epsilon 极限下，该分量在已发布的初始化处会抵消。随后，我们在三个训练好的检查点上测量完整归一化预测的贡献。在保留 LayerNorm 雅可比的同时移除这一贡献后，各模型的平均梯度范数比为 0.25 至 0.32。在《战争与和平》的 100,303 个词元上，采用局部逐词元范数匹配的同一干预使 TTT-Linear-760M 和 1.3B 的困惑度提高了 2.8-2.9%；相比之下，冻结所有快速权重更新会使困惑度提高 4.2-4.5 倍。另行进行的合成测试展示了简单 delta 规则覆盖对步长的依赖性。这些结果区分了由预测导出的更新与其行为价值，并说明评估测试时记忆为何既需要实现分析，也需要在线干预。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs). As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks--characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making--existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging. To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code. Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors. It introduces AgentFlow, a unified execution paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents. For asynchronous execution, it integrates sliding-window strategies that bound trajectory staleness, and employs TransferMesh, a topology-aware synchronization mechanism that routes weights after each step over the fastest transport available to each receiver. Beyond agentic RL, LoongSage incorporates a memory-efficient Teacher Manager that decouples the scaling of teacher models from GPU memory constraints, natively supporting Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Extensive evaluations across four complete training runs, spanning complex reinforcement learning and multi-teacher distillation, demonstrate that task rewards improve steadily while the train-inference gap is kept under continuous control, and the fully asynchronous pipeline removes synchronous idle bubbles, sustaining hardware utilization.

    强化学习（RL）已成为大型语言模型（LLM）后训练流程中的关键阶段。随着 LLM 能力前沿从静态推理转向智能体任务——其特征包括调用外部工具、多轮交互和长时域决策——现有主流 RL 框架变得愈发笨重，增加了采用、使用和调试的开销。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 LoongSage，这是一个原生支持智能体、完全异步的 RL 框架，其轻量级核心约有 14K 行代码。LoongSage 基于 Megatron 进行分布式训练，基于 SGLang 进行高吞吐推理，将编排集中在单一控制器进程中，并将所有驻留 GPU 的组件封装为 Ray actor。它引入 AgentFlow 这一统一执行范式，用于编排白盒和黑盒智能体。为支持异步执行，它集成了限制轨迹陈旧程度的滑动窗口策略，并采用 TransferMesh——一种感知拓扑的同步机制，在每个步骤之后通过各接收端可用的最快传输方式路由权重。除智能体式 RL 外，LoongSage 还集成了节省内存的 Teacher Manager，将教师模型扩展与 GPU 内存限制解耦，并原生支持 Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation。涵盖复杂强化学习和多教师蒸馏的四次完整训练运行的广泛评估表明，任务奖励持续提升，同时训练与推理之间的差距得到持续控制；完全异步的流水线消除了同步空闲时段，并保持硬件利用率。

    LeanPRM: Lean-Grounded Process Supervision for Natural Language Proof Verification

    LeanPRM：基于 Lean 的自然语言证明验证过程监督

    Rodney Lafuente-Mercado, Salman Rahman, Jingyan Shen, James Shiffer, Saadia Gabriel, Pavel Izmailov

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LeanPRM uses paired formal proofs to generate step-level correctness labels and trains verifiers that improve proof checking and selection, a substantial contribution to mathematical reasoning evaluation and feedback. Proof steps have structure, but the abstract does not claim compositional learning or generalization, and Lean is used as a labeling tool rather than a model-systems contribution.

    LeanPRM 使用配对的形式化证明生成步骤级正确性标签，并训练验证器以改进证明检查和筛选，这是对数学推理评估与反馈的重要贡献。证明步骤具有结构，但摘要并未声称实现了组合学习或泛化；Lean 在此用作标注工具，而非模型系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI systems now write long and difficult mathematical proofs, and checking their step-by-step validity is becoming a bottleneck. A learned verifier could check proofs cheaply, but training one requires a correctness label on every step, and such labels are hard to obtain for open-ended proofs. Existing methods take them from human annotators, which is costly, or derive them from final answers, which proofs do not have, and formalizing each proof in Lean requires expert effort. We introduce LeanPRM, a framework that uses the Lean proof assistant to create step-level labels for natural-language proofs. A model writes a natural-language proof together with a paired formal proof, without feedback from Lean. Lean then labels every step, and a second model discards failures caused only by the formal syntax, so that the negative labels mark errors in the mathematics. LeanPRM contains 10,634 proofs with 152K labeled steps and no human annotation. A Qwen3-4B verifier trained on LeanPRM raises exact step-label accuracy on a held-out set of 200 proofs (LeanPRM-Bench) from 48.2 to 74.7, as opposed to 60.3 when the same base model is trained on PRM800K. It also selects better proofs in best-of-N selection on IMO-level problems, and outperforms the PRM800K-trained verifier on three of four external verification benchmarks. Training on LeanPRM improves verifiers at every size from 0.6B to 8B parameters on LeanPRM-Bench, Hard2Verify and IMO-GradingBench. Given the labels need no human annotation, LeanPRM can grow with the supply of formal statements, offering a path to step-level feedback on AI-generated proofs that are hard for humans to check.

    中文

    AI 系统如今能够撰写篇幅很长、难度很高的数学证明，逐步检查其有效性正逐渐成为瓶颈。学习型验证器可以低成本地检查证明，但训练验证器需要为每个步骤提供正确性标签，而开放式证明的这类标签很难获取。现有方法要么依赖人工标注，成本高昂；要么从最终答案推导标签，但证明并没有最终答案；而在 Lean 中形式化每个证明则需要专家付出大量精力。我们提出 LeanPRM，这是一个利用 Lean 证明助手为自然语言证明生成步骤级标签的框架。模型在没有 Lean 反馈的情况下，同时编写自然语言证明及其配对的形式化证明。随后，Lean 为每个步骤标注标签，第二个模型则剔除仅由形式语法导致的失败，使负标签标记的是数学错误。LeanPRM 包含 10,634 个证明和 152K 个带标签步骤，无需人工标注。在 LeanPRM 上训练的 Qwen3-4B 验证器，在由 200 个证明组成的留出集（LeanPRM-Bench）上的步骤标签精确准确率从 48.2 提高到 74.7；作为对照，同一基础模型在 PRM800K 上训练后，准确率为 60.3。它还在 IMO 难度级别的问题上通过 best-of-N 选择挑出更好的证明，并在四个外部验证基准中的三个上优于用 PRM800K 训练的验证器。在 LeanPRM 上训练，可提升 LeanPRM-Bench、Hard2Verify 和 IMO-GradingBench 上从 0.6B 到 8B 参数规模所有验证器的表现。由于这些标签无需人工标注，LeanPRM 可以随着形式化命题数量的增加而扩展，为 AI 生成且人类难以检查的证明提供步骤级反馈。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    It presents a capability-compiled agentic Bayesian optimization framework whose composable BO components and compiler support adaptation, with ablations showing effects on optimization quality. Composition is a substantive design element but not a direct study of compositional generalization; agent memory and execution organization support a strong Systems score, while optimization alone offers only an incidental connection to reasoning.

    本文提出一种能力编译型智能体贝叶斯优化框架，其可组合的 BO 组件和编译器支持自适应，并通过消融实验展示了它们对优化质量的影响。组合是重要的设计要素，但本文并非直接研究组合泛化；智能体记忆和执行组织为系统方面的评价提供了有力依据，而优化本身与推理仅有偶然联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Materials and chemical optimization must choose the next synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity simulation from sequential observations under a limited budget. Large language models can use task knowledge to propose adjustments, but composing surrogates, acquisition functions, and search strategies is constrained by compatibility, parameter dependencies, and evidence requirements. We present Agentic-MatriBO, a capability-compiled agentic Bayesian optimization (BO) framework that represents BO components and selection conditions as composable capabilities. A language policy proposes BO recipes and candidate plans; a compiler checks proposals against the registered capability catalog; and a deterministic execution layer validates and commits candidates. Oracle observations are stored in research memory and inform later rounds. We compare Agentic-MatriBO with eight baselines on four offline finite candidate pools---COF, PCE10, Buchwald--Hartwig (BH), and Suzuki--Miyaura---using five seeds per condition; results are reported descriptively. Across the four tasks, Agentic-MatriBO has the best mean endpoint quality after orienting each objective so that higher is better. On COF, it reaches the tabulated optimum in all five seeds both in the end-to-end comparison and after shared initialization, where it also retains an advantage in cumulative quality. Its normalized area under the best-so-far quality curve during the BO stage (nAUC-BO) is substantially higher on COF, near parity with the best baseline on PCE10 and BH, and lower on Suzuki. COF ablations show that removing the capability compiler or evidence gate coincides with lower cumulative quality and fewer exact-optimum hits. The framework provides an inspectable interface for evidence-conditioned BO adaptation.

    Rethinking Quality in Large Language Model Routing: Security-Conditioned Model-and-Budget Selection

    重新思考大型语言模型路由中的质量：以安全性为条件的模型与预算选择

    Yichi Zhang, Zhenxiang Huang, Yuyang Zhang, Yuchen Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SCRouter selects a model and token budget using separate utility and security predictions, with a query-specific probe and benchmark evaluation. This is a substantial contribution to routing and computational allocation; its security and utility objectives are not evidence about reasoning mechanisms, so Reasoning remains low.

    SCRouter 使用独立的效用和安全性预测来选择模型与 token 预算，并通过针对每个查询的探测器进行评估。这是对路由和计算资源分配的重要贡献；其安全性与效用目标并非推理机制方面的证据，因此 Reasoning 维度的相关性较低。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) routers reduce serving cost by choosing which model to call and how many output tokens to grant it for each query. Existing routers rank model-budget actions using a single quality metric. This does not work for mixed workloads. For ordinary queries, a good answer is correct and useful (utility); for security-sensitive queries, a good answer refuses harmful requests or resists malicious instructions (security). These two objectives prefer different models and budgets. We propose SCRouter, a router that learns when to prioritize security and how to allocate the token budget. For each model-budget pair, it estimates the probability that the response finishes within budget. It uses this probability to predict utility and security separately. A small probe determines how to weight these two predictions for each query. SCRouter then selects the model and budget by balancing the weighted utility and security against cost. We also build SCRouterBench, a benchmark of 38,869 utility and security queries spanning nine security dimensions, each answered under all 144 combinations of 12 models and 12 budgets, plus 2,753 out-of-domain queries. SCRouter improves the baselines by 13-29 points in-domain and 19-23 points out-of-domain.

    Kwai Summary Attention V2 技术报告

    OneRec Team, Chenglong Chu, Guohong Mu, Guowang Zhang, Hao Peng, Hui Wang, Jian Liang, Jiangxia Cao, Jiao Ou, Jiaxin Deng, Lu Ren, Muhao Wei, Ruiming Tang, Tianle Xu, Wenwu Ou, Xingmei Wang, Zhixin Ling, Zhiyuan Liang, Ziqi Wang, Chaoyi Ma, Haixiao Gao, Kuo Cai, Renpu Liu, Ruochen Yang, Wenlong Xu, Xinqi Jin, Yan Sun, Yifan Wang, Yingzhi He, Yiyu Wang, Yusen Huo, Zhaojie Liu, Zihan Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The report introduces summary tokens that flexibly compress KV memory and act as sparse indexers to reduce full-attention computation. This is a substantial contribution to model memory and computation design, but the abstract gives no substantive interpretability, compositionality, or reasoning contribution.

    该报告提出了摘要 token，使其能够灵活压缩 KV 内存，并充当稀疏索引器以减少全注意力计算。这是对模型内存和计算设计的重要贡献，但摘要没有实质性涉及可解释性、组合性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Summary-token architectures such as Kwai Summary Attention (KSA) compress distant context into learnable Summary token per chunk, and hybrid variants interleave these layers with full attention to retain exact access to the original text. In such hybrid KSA-Full architecture, the interleaving inserted summary tokens are served as a streaming flow role across different layers. Although effective, however, it also introduce some bottlenecks: (1) the different layers summary compression chunk must be same, therefore hard to reach a flexible KV Cache compression, e.g., different layer set different summary compression chunk window. (2) in the full-attention layers, the summary token introduced additional computation cost, but such layer ignore them and still pay quadratic prefilling, therefore unfriendly to the computation side. Motivated by them, we developed the KSA V2, which not only achieves a more flexible KV cache memory compression but also reduces the computation cost in Full attention layer. Specifically, we found that the summary tokens can serve two roles: the KV memory and sparse indexer.

    Kwai Summary Attention（KSA）等摘要 token 架构会将远处上下文压缩为每个块中的可学习摘要 token；混合变体则将这些层与全注意力层交错，以保留对原始文本的精确访问。在这种混合 KSA-Full 架构中，交错插入的摘要 token 在不同层之间充当流式传递角色。不过，尽管这种架构有效，它也会带来一些瓶颈：（1）不同层的摘要压缩块必须相同，因此难以实现灵活的 KV Cache 压缩，例如为不同层设置不同的摘要压缩窗口。（2）在全注意力层中，摘要 token 增加了额外计算开销，但此类层会忽略它们，仍需承担二次方级的预填充计算，因此不利于计算效率。受这些问题启发，我们开发了 KSA V2，它不仅实现了更灵活的 KV 缓存内存压缩，也降低了全注意力层中的计算成本。具体而言，我们发现摘要 token 可以发挥两种作用：作为 KV 内存和稀疏索引器。

    Riding the Fixed-Point Curve: Image Classification in the Continuous Thought Machine

    沿固定点曲线前行：连续思维机器中的图像分类

    Thomas Hannagan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how CTM neural states and attention evolve during image classification, identifying attracting fixed points, non-normal dynamics, and a largely image-independent processing strategy. This gives substantial insight into internal dynamics, while its focus on classification offers only partial evidence about reasoning and no substantive contribution to composition or system design.

    论文分析了 CTM 在图像分类期间神经状态和注意力如何演化，发现了吸引固定点、非正规动力学以及大体上不依赖图像的处理策略。这为内部动力学提供了重要洞见；与此同时，论文聚焦于分类，对推理的证据有限，也没有对组合或系统设计作出实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) is a recurrent network that attends to inputs and makes predictions based on the synchronization between its neurons. On tasks spanning many domains, it displays emergent thought processes that have not been explained. We report a number of findings about how the CTM classifies images, focusing on ImageNet. Thinking steps are attracting but strongly non-normal maps exhibiting balanced amplification (Murphy and Miller, 2009); while attraction is already present at CTM initialization, training highly promotes non-normality. By Banach's theorem, the neural state thus has a locally unique attracting fixed point, which moves at every step, and the thought trajectory is the curve these fixed points trace, followed one tick behind. Most of that curve's motion is shared across images, and visible as a previously reported traveling wave of activity across neurons. The attention schedule along the thought is largely generic: shuffling queries across images at every tick costs only 7 percent of classification accuracy, while image-independent increments predict the next query with R^2 = 0.98 (held out). Our results suggest that the CTM has found a single strategy to process all ImageNet images.

    中文

    连续思维机器（CTM）是一种循环网络，它对输入进行注意力处理，并依据神经元之间的同步情况作出预测。在涵盖许多领域的任务中，它表现出尚未得到解释的涌现式思维过程。我们报告了关于 CTM 如何进行图像分类的若干发现，重点研究 ImageNet。思考步骤是具有吸引性的、但强烈非正规（non-normal）的映射，并表现出平衡放大（Murphy and Miller, 2009）；尽管 CTM 初始化时已存在吸引性，训练仍大幅增强了非正规性。根据 Banach 定理，神经状态因此具有一个局部唯一的吸引固定点，该固定点每一步都会移动；思维轨迹是这些固定点所描出的曲线，且落后一个时刻跟随。该曲线的大部分运动在不同图像之间共享，并表现为此前报告过的、跨神经元传播的活动行波。思维过程中的注意力调度大体上具有通用性：在每个时刻跨图像打乱查询只会使分类准确率下降 7 个百分点，而与图像无关的增量对下一次查询的预测效果达到 R^2 = 0.98（留出集）。我们的结果表明，CTM 已经找到一种处理所有 ImageNet 图像的统一策略。

    HEM-Med: A Hierarchical Agentic Memory Framework for Safe Multi-Center Medication Recommendation

    HEM-Med：用于安全多中心用药推荐的分层智能体记忆框架

    Min Xiao, Jin Li, Shoujin Wang, Yeguang Zhen, Yishuo Li, Wenpeng Lu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HEM-Med’s main contribution is a hierarchical memory that separates shared clinical experience from hospital-specific prescribing patterns, alongside safety-aware recommendation. This provides substantive insight into memory organization (Systems 4); attribution and disentanglement give a partial connection to representation mechanisms (MechInterp 3), while recommendation performance alone offers only incidental links to composition and reasoning.

    HEM-Med 的主要贡献是分层记忆，它将共享临床经验与医院特定的处方模式分开，并结合安全感知推荐。这为记忆组织提供了实质性见解（Systems 4）；归因与解耦也与表征机制有一定联系（MechInterp 3），而单纯的推荐表现与组合和推理仅有间接关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Medication recommendation (MR) is critical for clinical decision support. While existing MR methods are mostly designed for single-center learning, where only one independent hospital is involved, multi-center MR with hospitals of different scales has become increasingly demanding in practice. In multi center settings, abundant data from large medical centers can improve recommendation performance for low-resource centers. Despite a few preliminary attempts on this task, two critical gaps remain. Gap 1: Existing multi-center methods fail to disentangle transferable cross-hospital clinical experience from hospital-specific prescribing patterns, limiting clinical feasibility and physician acceptance. Gap 2: They commonly overlook multi label safety constraints of MR, including drug-drug interaction risks and local formulary feasibility, which are essential for safe real-world deployment. To address these gaps, we propose HEM-Med, a novel hierarchical agentic memory framework for multi-center MR. To address Gap 1, we design a disentangled hierarchical memory module that builds patient-level medication context attribution records and disentangles them into cross hospital experience memory and hospital-specific residual memory. To address Gap 2, we introduce a safety-aware medication set generation module, which integrates dual-level experience retrieval with safety-aware set decoding to produce clinically relevant, safer, and locally adaptive medication recommendations. Experiments on a real-world multi-center eICU dataset show that HEM-Med outperforms representative transfer learning, LLM-based, and MR baselines in terms of both recommendation accuracy and safety.

    中文

    用药推荐（MR）对于临床决策支持至关重要。现有 MR 方法大多针对单中心学习设计，即仅涉及一家独立医院；而在实践中，来自不同规模医院的多中心 MR 需求日益增长。在多中心场景中，大型医疗中心的丰富数据可以提升资源有限中心的推荐表现。尽管已有少数初步研究尝试处理这一任务，仍存在两个关键缺口。缺口 1：现有多中心方法无法区分可跨医院迁移的临床经验与特定医院的处方模式，限制了临床可行性和医生的接受度。缺口 2：这些方法通常忽视 MR 的多标签安全约束，包括药物相互作用风险和本地药品目录的适用性，而这些对安全的真实部署至关重要。为弥补这些缺口，我们提出 HEM-Med，这是一种用于多中心 MR 的新型分层智能体记忆框架。针对缺口 1，我们设计了一个解耦的分层记忆模块，用于构建患者级用药上下文归因记录，并将其拆分为跨医院经验记忆和医院特定残差记忆。针对缺口 2，我们引入安全感知的药物集合生成模块，将双层经验检索与安全感知的集合解码相结合，从而生成符合临床需要、更安全且能适应本地情况的用药建议。在真实世界多中心 eICU 数据集上的实验表明，HEM-Med 在推荐准确性和安全性方面均优于有代表性的迁移学习、基于 LLM 的方法及 MR 基线。

    TANGO: RNA Topology and Geometry Co-Design

    TANGO：RNA 拓扑与几何协同设计

    Tianmeng Hu, Biao Luo, Ke Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TANGO’s main contribution is a staged, multi-agent RL method that co-designs RNA sequence, secondary topology, and tertiary geometry, using curriculum transfer and trade-off refinement. Its structured co-design and transfer support a strong composition score; reinforcement learning and multi-agent organization are relevant to reasoning and systems, but are secondary to the application-specific design task.

    TANGO 的主要贡献是一种分阶段的多智能体 RL 方法，通过课程迁移和权衡优化，对 RNA 序列、二级结构拓扑及三级结构几何进行协同设计。其结构化协同设计与迁移支持较高的组合评分；强化学习和多智能体组织与推理及系统相关，但相较于面向特定应用的设计任务，它们属于次要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Designing RNA sequences that satisfy target tertiary-structure objectives is an important problem in RNA engineering, with broad applications in synthetic biology and therapeutics. Existing 3D RNA design methods have made substantial progress, but they largely treat the target fold as a geometry-only objective. This is incomplete for RNA, whose functional folds are specified not only by tertiary geometry but also by secondary base-pairing topology. We therefore formulate RNA inverse design as a topology-and-geometry co-design problem and propose TANGO, a multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for this task. TANGO adopts a staged curriculum: it first learns a topology-aware policy from secondary-structure targets, then transfers this policy to tertiary-structure targets to train a general co-design model, and finally applies frontier-guided fine-tuning to refine target-specific trade-offs among secondary-structure fidelity, tertiary-structure fidelity, and sequence diversity. Experiments show that TANGO generates diverse and novel designs, improving tertiary- and secondary-structure performance by 18.3% and 52.7%, respectively, over the strongest baseline.

    中文

    设计满足目标三级结构要求的 RNA 序列，是 RNA 工程中的重要问题，在合成生物学和治疗学领域有广泛应用。现有 3D RNA 设计方法已取得显著进展，但大多将目标折叠仅视为几何目标。这对 RNA 来说并不完整，因为其功能性折叠不仅由三级几何结构决定，也由二级碱基配对拓扑决定。因此，我们将 RNA 逆向设计表述为拓扑与几何协同设计问题，并提出 TANGO，一种用于该任务的多目标多智能体强化学习框架。TANGO 采用分阶段课程：首先根据二级结构目标学习具备拓扑感知能力的策略，然后将该策略迁移至三级结构目标，以训练通用协同设计模型，最后通过前沿引导微调，优化二级结构保真度、三级结构保真度和序列多样性之间针对特定目标的权衡。实验表明，TANGO 能生成多样且新颖的设计；与最强基线相比，其三级结构和二级结构表现分别提升 18.3% 和 52.7%。

    ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps

    ActiveEvidence：基于决策的证据图与可验证采集间隙

    Miaobo Hu, Shuhao Hu, Xiaobo Guo, Xin Wang, Bokun Wang, Peng Zhang, Daren Zha

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a decision-certifiable method for a multimodal agent to acquire evidence selectively, with interaction graphs, gap-directed refinement, and independent trajectory verification. This advances agent decision and tool-use systems; decision-making is related to reasoning, but the abstract focuses on evidence acquisition rather than reasoning mechanisms or capability development.

    本文为多模态智能体选择性获取证据提出了一种可进行决策认证的方法，包含交互图、间隙引导的细化和独立的轨迹验证。这推进了智能体决策和工具使用系统的发展；决策与推理相关，但摘要重点在证据获取，而非推理机制或能力发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $\epsilon$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.

    中文

    多模态智能体必须决定视觉证据是否值得获取、应查询哪个候选对象或分辨率，以及何时进一步交互已无法改变其决策。我们在严格的免费元数据/付费观测边界、随机向量成本和冻结执行轨迹的设定下研究这一问题，并将其视为可进行决策认证的主动证据获取问题。反事实证据交互图（CEIG）表示单项证据价值、有符号的二阶交互和有向条件性损害，同时为尚未解决的交互维护显式分数区间；决策加权的区间目标则收紧可能改变动作身份的界限。间隙引导的细化只评估可能取代当前最优采集方案的交互，并在某个$\epsilon$决策证书表明未解决项无法使所选动作超出声明容差范围发生改变时停止。该证书与模型相关：它验证固定的学习得分下与策略一致的最优性，而语义质量则通过冻结后标签单独衡量。成对的后续 rollout 学习付费预览的下游价值；在线运行成本过滤器与独立的有限策略族轨迹认证相互分离；采集监控器及独立实现的验证器则将每份证书绑定到冻结轨迹。在 640 个案例上（训练、验证和测试分别为 384/128/128），控制器达到 0.842 的任务分数、0.816 的 grounding F1、0.873 的证据召回率、1.74 次已接受调用、286.5K 个视觉词元，以及 742ms 的 p95 延迟。对已发出证书的密集重放显示，动作一致率为 0.992，证书率为 0.988；每次决策评估的昂贵交互项为 19.6 个，而非 191.4 个。

    CascadeLedger: Counterfactual Auditing of Information and Resource Integrity in LLM Cascades

    CascadeLedger：对 LLM 级联中的信息与资源完整性进行反事实审计

    Miaobo Hu, Shuhao Hu, Xiaobo Guo, Xin Wang, Bokun Wang, Daren Zha

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops counterfactual auditing methods for execution traces, routing information access, and resource accounting in LLM cascades. Its contribution substantially advances auditing and organization of model systems; routing is present, but the abstract does not study reasoning or internal representations.

    该论文开发了反事实审计方法，用于检查 LLM 级联中的执行轨迹、路由信息访问和资源核算。其贡献显著推进了模型系统的审计和组织；虽然涉及路由，但摘要并未研究推理或内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce CascadeLedger, a counterfactual execution-audit framework for budgeted language-model cascades. The protocol enforces call-before-read semantics, binds successful reads to service and cache identities, records availability and component-wise budget transitions, and freezes the event trace before any target or task scorer is joined. The central object is aggregate-equivalent trace validity: two executions can share a final answer, declared resource projection, and service histogram while differing in whether their routing decisions used only legitimately observable information. We complement single-trace invariants with counterfactual prefix non-interference (CPNI), which couples a visible prefix and policy randomness while changing only a declared hidden family. The counterfactual influence frontier (CIF) localizes the earliest violating prefix and a minimal hidden witness; projection-preserving adversarial mutation (PPAM) searches for invalid traces that remain acceptable to a non-counterfactual checker. Across frozen-cache, independently generated, and serving evaluations, the two-layer audit reports a clean false-positive rate of 0.0000, detects 0.9983 of serialized faults and 0.9982 of unlogged hidden-read faults, and changes 0.3403 of corrupted quality-resource conclusions after deterministic recomputation. The online recorder and offline CPNI audit have separate overhead measurements. Learned routing and semantic verification provide downstream compatibility studies under the same execution contract.

    中文

    我们提出 CascadeLedger，一种针对预算受限语言模型级联的反事实执行审计框架。该协议强制遵守先调用后读取语义，将成功读取与服务及缓存身份绑定，记录可用性和组件级预算变化，并在关联任何目标或任务评分器之前冻结事件轨迹。其核心对象是聚合等价轨迹有效性：两次执行可能具有相同的最终答案、声明的资源投影和服务直方图，但路由决策所用信息是否仅来自合法可观测内容却可能不同。我们以反事实前缀非干扰（CPNI）补充单轨迹不变量：固定可见前缀和策略随机性，同时仅改变指定的隐藏类别。反事实影响边界（CIF）定位最早发生违规的前缀及最小隐藏见证；保持投影不变的对抗性修改（PPAM）则搜索那些无效但仍会被非反事实检查器接受的轨迹。在冻结缓存、独立生成和服务评估中，这种双层审计报告的干净样本假阳性率为 0.0000，检测出 0.9983 的序列化故障和 0.9982 的未记录隐藏读取故障；经过确定性重新计算后，它改变了 0.3403 的错误质量—资源结论。在线记录器与离线 CPNI 审计分别测量了开销。学习型路由和语义验证在相同执行契约下提供了下游兼容性研究。

    Spectral Indistinguishability and Learning-Curve Identifiability in Quadratic Networks

    二次网络中的频谱不可区分性与学习曲线可辨识性

    Dekun Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes what spectral summaries and scalar learning curves can identify about quadratic networks, deriving indistinguishability results and conditions for recovering predictors and teacher structure. This gives substantial transferable insight into model representations and learned mechanisms, but it does not address composition, reasoning capabilities, or model-system organization.

    论文分析频谱摘要和标量学习曲线能够从二次网络中辨识出什么，推导出不可区分性结果以及恢复预测器和教师结构的条件。这为模型表示和学习机制提供了重要且可迁移的洞见，但没有涉及组合、推理能力或模型系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Motivated by information-organization sculpting, we study spectral summaries and scalar learning curves in centered quadratic networks. We construct analytic positive input densities with Gaussian one- and two-coordinate marginals. Their complete fourth-moment operators are orthogonally intertwined by a map fixing the entire diagonal teacher algebra, giving equal anchored spectral measures. For selected common teachers with a nonzero cycle invariant, their factorized loss curves differ because the map does not preserve matrix multiplication. Cycle length $r$, which can be arbitrarily large, gives $O(\varepsilon^r)$ contrast uniformly in training time for each fixed construction. For a supplied pair, noisy scalar loss queries require order $\varepsilon^{-2r}$ observations, while bounded initialization interventions with scalar gradient readouts require order $\varepsilon^{-2}$. A shared-input score, equal to a paired-gradient difference, attains the optimal input-sample exponent without knowing the teacher. An explicit family of diverging auxiliary teacher scales instead admits a nonzero finite limiting contrast at coupling $1/\log L$. Conversely, for Gaussian inputs and a rationally independent teacher spectrum, one exact scalar loss curve identifies the initial predictor up to sign conjugation. Within this rationally independent class, with nonzero diagonal inverse-state error in every coordinate and calibrated time and loss scales, it also identifies the unknown teacher spectrum and active dimension, modulo simultaneous rotations. For fixed dimension and distinct unordered teacher sums, dimension-minimal exact observations give generic joint local recovery. Finite exact global bounds hold for a known teacher and, on the active class, under a blind dimension cap. Exact certificates and full-weight replay verify the construction; numerical inverse checks reveal severe ill-conditioning.

    中文

    受信息组织塑造这一议题启发，我们研究中心化二次网络中的频谱摘要和标量学习曲线。我们构造了具有高斯单坐标和双坐标边缘分布的解析正输入密度。它们的完整四阶矩算子由一个正交交织映射联系，该映射固定整个对角教师代数，因此得到相同的锚定频谱测度。对于某些具有非零环不变量的共同教师，它们的因子化损失曲线有所不同，因为该映射不保持矩阵乘法。环长度 $r$可任意大，并且对每个固定构造，都能在整个训练时间范围内产生 $O(\varepsilon^r)$ 对比度。对于给定的一对对象，带噪声的标量损失查询需要数量级为 $\varepsilon^{-2r}$ 的观测；而有界初始化干预配合标量梯度读出则需要数量级为 $\varepsilon^{-2}$。一个共享输入评分（等于一对梯度之差）在不知道教师的情况下，便能达到最优输入样本指数。相反，一族显式发散的辅助教师尺度会在耦合 $1/\log L$ 处产生非零有限的极限对比度。反过来，对于高斯输入和有理无关的教师频谱，一条精确的标量损失曲线就能将初始预测器辨识到符号共轭为止。在这一有理无关类别中，若每个坐标均具有非零的对角逆状态误差，且时间和损失尺度经过校准，那么它还能在同时旋转意义下辨识未知教师频谱和有效维度。对于固定维度和互异的无序教师和，维度最小的精确观测可实现一般情形下的联合局部恢复。对于已知教师，以及在有效类别上且维度上界未知的情况下，均存在有限的精确全局界。精确证书和全权重重放验证了这一构造；数值逆向检查则揭示了严重的病态性。

    这项研究比较了推理轨迹和答案配置对准确率及遵循更新后证据的影响，并提出将这两种属性一并评估。这是关于推理行为的一项重要实证贡献，但没有研究内部机制或系统架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A reasoning trace retained at answer time plays two roles: it can raise accuracy, and it can compete with the current evidence when the two disagree. We disentangle these roles by crossing verified evidence versions with the traces generated from each and answering from the same traces and evidence under two configurations: continuation of the model's own thinking and a separate answer call. Across three model families (gpt-oss, Gemma4, Qwen3) on HotpotQA and MuSiQue, the separate call raises evidence-following over continuation by 29.9 to 60.6 points. On the same pairs, removing the trace lowers accuracy by similar amounts under both configurations. Yet continuation repeats the stale conclusion in most conflicts, and the separate call follows the current evidence far more often. Benefiting from a trace and deferring to it are therefore distinct properties. Further analyses show that the final line of a trace carries most of its value, gold evidence helps most before the trace is written, distractors weaken correction under a separate call, and renewed reasoning, unlike a verification instruction, follows the current evidence in most conflicts. Because trace deletion alone cannot reveal which source an answer follows, evaluations should report both properties together with the answer configuration.

    在作答时保留的推理轨迹有两种作用：它可以提高准确率；当两者不一致时，也可能与当前证据相竞争。我们通过交叉组合经核验的证据版本及各版本生成的轨迹，将这两种作用区分开来，并在两种配置下使用相同的轨迹和证据作答：延续模型自身的思考，以及单独调用一次作答。在 HotpotQA 和 MuSiQue 上对三个模型系列（gpt-oss、Gemma4、Qwen3）的实验表明，与延续思考相比，单独作答调用使证据遵循率提高了 29.9 至 60.6 个百分点。在相同的配对条件下，移除轨迹会使两种配置下的准确率都以相近幅度下降。然而，在大多数冲突中，延续思考会重复过时的结论，而单独作答调用则更常遵循当前证据。因此，从轨迹中获益与服从轨迹是两种不同的属性。进一步分析表明，轨迹的最后一句承载了其大部分价值；黄金证据在轨迹写下之前最有帮助；干扰项会削弱单独作答调用中的纠正效果；重新进行推理则不同于验证指令，在大多数冲突中能够遵循当前证据。由于仅删除轨迹无法揭示答案究竟遵循哪个来源，评估应同时报告这两种属性以及答案配置。

    Bingbing Wang, Jingjie Lin, Weiming Qiao, Jing Li, Ruifeng Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is a shared evidence-state memory policy trained with trajectory-level process rewards, substantially advancing memory-agent design and optimization. Its RL and trajectory methods are incidental to reasoning capability, and the abstract gives no evidence about internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文的主要贡献是一个共享证据状态的记忆策略，并通过轨迹级过程奖励对其进行训练，实质性地推进了记忆智能体的设计与优化。其 RL 和轨迹方法与推理能力的联系只是附带的，摘要也没有提供有关内部表征或组合泛化的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models increasingly rely on external memory to answer queries grounded in long-horizon histories such as multi-session dialogues and lengthy documents. However, existing memory methods often optimize retrieval and memory construction separately, without a shared reward space for evaluating search, writing, and stopping decisions. To address this, we propose All-in-One Memory (AiO-Mem), which organizes these operations as transitions over a shared evidence state and directly evaluates the semantic quality of each action in a unified reward space. AiO-Mem compiles heterogeneous histories into source-traceable multi-view events, providing a shared substrate for retrieval and memory writing. A unified memory policy actor then rolls out complete interaction trajectories over this shared evidence state. A separate trajectory-conditioned process reward model is trained through evidence-grounded supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level DPO to assign process scores to the collected trajectories. These scores are aggregated into an action-balanced trajectory reward and used by Process-Aligned DAPO (PA-DAPO) to optimize the memory policy. Across long-context memory benchmarks, AiO-Mem consistently improves answer accuracy over both static memory systems and RL-trained memory agents.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    本文提出采用融合空间和动态调度的多样本扩散生成方法，并以几何视角说明如何保留各自的生成轨迹。这为面向吞吐量的计算提供了实质性见解，但摘要并未证明组合泛化能力或对已学习表征的机制可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion models achieve high-quality image generation but remain computationally expensive due to iterative denoising across many timesteps. Existing acceleration methods mainly reduce per-sample latency, but gains along this axis are becoming saturated. We instead explore an orthogonal throughput-oriented direction by processing multiple samples within a single denoising evaluation. To this end, we propose ManiFusion, a backbone-agnostic framework for multi-sample generation through fused-space computation. ManiFusion jointly processes multiple samples by fusing them before the denoising backbone and separating them afterward through unfusion. We provide a geometric perspective on how multiple samples can share a fused representation while retaining the information needed to guide their individual generation trajectories. To better align fusion allocation with denoising stages, ManiFusion uses Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling (TFS), which dynamically adjusts fusion factors throughout sampling. ManiFusion generalizes across diffusion families, including both U-Net and transformer backbones in pixel and latent spaces. We further show that ManiFusion composes with existing acceleration methods and reaches throughput regimes unattainable by prior approaches with minimal quality degradation.
