    风险与拒绝：LLM 对自杀意念的响应机制

    Drishti Goel, Soorya Ram Shimgekar, Jeongah Lee, Violeta J. Rodriguez, Daniel S. Brown, Ravi Karkar, Koustuv Saha

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study analyzes refusal behavior in LLMs and uses mechanistic analyses and ablations to link SI refusals to a direction also involved in harmful-request refusals. This provides substantial insight into an internal behavior mechanism; the safety evaluation and protocol intervention do not substantively address composition, reasoning, or system organization.

    这项研究分析了 LLM 的拒绝行为，并通过机制分析和消融实验，将对 SI 的拒绝与一个也参与拒绝有害请求的方向联系起来。这为理解内部行为机制提供了重要见解；安全评估和方案干预并未实质性涉及组合、推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Refusal is a common safety mechanism in large language models (LLMs), yet in contexts of suicidal ideation (SI), refusing to engage can itself constitute a safety failure. We evaluate how eight instruction-tuned LLMs respond to SI and self-harm disclosures across three datasets, varying whether models are informed that a disclosure expresses SI and whether they receive a clinician-developed response protocol, and complement this with mechanistic analyses in six open-weight models. Our results reveal a nuanced relationship between refusal and response-level risk. At baseline, elevated risk in model responses is driven primarily by inattention to the disclosure, alongside refusal to engage. Mechanistic analyses suggest that models may refuse SI disclosures through the same direction that mediates their refusals of harmful requests. However, informing models of the SI context, or suppressing refusal directly, increases engagement without reliably lowering response risk, and may raise it. In contrast, the clinician-guided protocol consistently reduces response-level risk while also reducing refusal. Together, these analyses and ablations motivate the need for models that refuse only when warranted and engage in interactionally safe ways when users disclose SI.

    中文

    拒绝是大型语言模型（LLM）常见的安全机制，但在涉及自杀意念（SI）的情境中，拒绝参与互动本身也可能构成安全失误。我们在三个数据集上评估了八种指令微调 LLM 对 SI 和自残披露的响应，改变模型是否获知披露表达了 SI，以及是否向模型提供由临床医生制定的响应方案；此外，我们还对六种开放权重模型进行了机制分析。结果揭示了拒绝与响应层面风险之间的复杂关系。在基线条件下，模型响应中的风险升高主要源于未关注披露内容，同时也与拒绝参与互动有关。机制分析表明，模型可能通过与其拒绝有害请求相同的方向来拒绝 SI 披露。然而，告知模型 SI 情境，或直接抑制拒绝，虽会增加模型的参与度，却不能可靠地降低响应风险，甚至可能使风险上升。相比之下，临床医生指导的方案始终能够降低响应层面风险，同时也减少拒绝。综合这些分析与消融实验，我们认为，需要开发只在适当情况下拒绝、并在用户披露 SI 时以互动安全的方式参与交流的模型。

    Aaron J. Li, Weijia Xu, Chandan Singh, Zixiao Chen, Jeevana Priya Inala, Charlotte Siska, Acar Tamersoy, Bin Yu, Ion Stoica, Michel Galley, Jianfeng Gao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TokenEconomizer adaptively injects micro-skills, prunes tools, and interrupts failure loops to reduce coding-agent token costs across task sequences. This is a substantial agent orchestration contribution, but the abstract reports cost control rather than insight into internal mechanisms or reasoning capability.

    TokenEconomizer 会自适应地注入微技能、剪除工具并中断失败循环，从而降低智能体在一系列任务中的编码成本。这是对智能体编排的重要贡献，但摘要报告的是成本控制，并未提供关于内部机制或推理能力的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Advances in frontier coding agents have sharply increased the token costs of AI-assisted software engineering. Their token efficiency is typically evaluated on isolated tasks, whereas real-world developers use them to continuously build, update, and maintain large-scale projects. This mismatch motivates us to evaluate agents over sequences of realistic coding tasks, where we find that agents exhibit recurring environment-dependent token costs that existing methods struggle to reduce. To minimize these costs, we introduce TokenEconomizer, an external controller that cuts environment-specific token costs over a sequence of tasks. These cuts come from determining (i) which operational micro-skills to inject, (ii) which persistently irrelevant tools to prune, and (iii) when to intervene in unproductive failure loops. Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI paired with frontier models, TokenEconomizer reduces the average token cost by 18.4-30.9% with comparable task success. Savings hold in every repository under every tested agent-model setting and generalize to diverse domains such as sequential web development and security auditing, where costs fall by 6.4-21.2% depending on task structure. Our work establishes adaptive black-box cost control as a promising direction for reducing token costs of coding agents in realistic settings.

    中文

    前沿编码智能体的发展大幅提高了 AI 辅助软件工程中的 token 成本。它们的 token 效率通常通过孤立任务评估，而现实中的开发者会持续使用它们来构建、更新和维护大型项目。这种不匹配促使我们在一系列符合实际情况的编码任务上评估智能体；我们发现，智能体会反复产生依赖环境的 token 成本，而现有方法难以降低这些成本。为尽量降低这些成本，我们提出 TokenEconomizer，这是一种外部控制器，可在一系列任务中削减特定于环境的 token 成本。它通过确定以下事项来降低成本：(i) 注入哪些操作性微技能，(ii) 剪除哪些持续无关的工具，以及 (iii) 何时干预无成效的失败循环。在使用前沿模型的 Claude Code、Codex 和 GitHub Copilot CLI 上，TokenEconomizer 在任务成功率相当的情况下，将平均 token 成本降低了 18.4-30.9%。在每个被测智能体—模型配置下，所有代码仓库均实现了节省；这一效果还泛化到连续 Web 开发和安全审计等不同领域，成本根据任务结构下降了 6.4-21.2%。我们的工作表明，自适应黑盒成本控制是降低真实场景中编码智能体 token 成本的一个有前景的方向。

    The way a knowledge graph is serialized as text for inclusion into LLM context can substantially affect downstream LLM performance, with prior work reporting tens of percentage points variations across formats. However, existing studies consider only a limited set of representations and predate frontier reasoning models, which now offer stronger reasoning, instruction-following, and long-context capabilities. We evaluate 15 graph representation formats across nine frontier LLM configurations on ontology-based knowledge extraction and structural graph reasoning tasks. While knowledge extraction is relatively insensitive to different serialization formats, the choice of the optimal format for structural reasoning tasks significantly affects accuracy. We demonstrate that the optimal representation choice depends on model, query, and task and propose to approach graph serialization as a dynamic orchestration decision.

    R$^2$Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop

    R$^2$Orch：通过技能内化循环中的自我博弈实现智能体编排的递归自我改进

    Mingda Zhang, Yun Huang, Qiang Huang, Yanjin Li, Rui Qian, Qichao Zhao, Tiesunlong Shen, Na Zhao, Jian Wang, Xiaoying Tang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    R²Orch proposes recursive self-play training, learnability-based task selection, and skill withdrawal for agent orchestration, with evaluations across several task types. Its central contribution is agent training and organization, supporting Systems 4; links to reasoning and reusable skills are secondary, and the abstract gives no direct evidence about internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    R²Orch 提出用于智能体编排的递归自我博弈训练、基于可学习性的任务选择和技能撤除，并在多种任务类型上进行了评估。其核心贡献是智能体训练与组织，支持 Systems 4；与推理和可复用技能的联系属于次要方面，摘要没有直接证据表明其推进了内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In recent years, agentic orchestration has been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing orchestration learning still faces key challenges, including hand-designed curricula, advantage collapse when a task's rollouts all reach the same outcome, and unreliable evaluation signals that judge each skill by one noisy score. To address these challenges, we propose R$^2$Orch, a new paradigm of Recursive Self-Play Orchestration: an inner loop of self-play that improves the orchestrator on self-chosen tasks, and an outer loop that improves how the inner loop improves. To support this paradigm, we introduce Recursive Learnability, a training objective that rewards a Proposer for choosing tasks whose rollouts keep reaching different outcomes as skills are withdrawn. Built on this objective, we further propose Skill Withdrawal, in which the outer loop withdraws each skill once a controlled evaluation within self-play shows that the orchestrator performs as well without it. Moreover, the two loops form one cycle: failures are distilled into skills, skills into parameters, and withdrawals lead the Proposer to new failures, so the orchestrator moves toward zero-skill deployment. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that R$^2$Orch consistently outperforms baselines across question answering, math, code, and interactive tasks.

    中文

    近年来，智能体编排已广泛应用于解决复杂的人类任务。然而，现有的编排学习仍面临若干关键挑战，包括人工设计课程、任务的所有 rollout 都达到相同结果时优势坍塌，以及用一个含噪分数评判每项技能所导致的不可靠评估信号。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 R$^2$Orch，一种递归自我博弈编排的新范式：内循环通过在自主选择的任务上进行自我博弈来改进编排器，外循环则改进内循环的改进方式。为支持这一范式，我们提出递归可学习性（Recursive Learnability）这一训练目标：当技能逐步撤除时，如果某个提议器（Proposer）选择的任务其 rollout 仍持续产生不同结果，就对其给予奖励。基于这一目标，我们进一步提出技能撤除（Skill Withdrawal）：一旦自我博弈中的受控评估表明编排器在没有某项技能时表现同样出色，外循环便撤除该技能。此外，两个循环共同构成一个周期：失败被提炼为技能，技能被转化为参数，而技能撤除会引导提议器遇到新的失败，使编排器逐步迈向零技能部署。在十二个数据集上的实验结果表明，R$^2$Orch 在问答、数学、代码和交互任务中始终优于基线。

    原生几何与线性可恢复性：对齐如何改变柏拉图式缩放

    Angus Hoy, Austin Lutterbach, Jasper Chong, Aman Kumar, Michael J. Smith

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study compares native representation geometry with linear recoverability across model families and finds that model scale strengthens alignment-based correspondence without showing convergence in native geometry. This is a substantial contribution to representation geometry; SAE and feature methods are comparison tools here, with no demonstrated advance in compositionality, reasoning, or systems.

    这项研究比较了不同模型系列中的原生表征几何与线性可恢复性，发现模型规模增强了基于对齐的对应关系，却未显示原生几何趋于一致。这是对表征几何的重要贡献；SAE 和特征方法在此仅作为比较工具，没有显示出在组合性、推理或系统方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Do larger models learn increasingly similar representations of the same world? The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) predicts that they should, but similar can mean native cosine geometry---nearest-neighbour structure induced by cosine similarity before any learned alignment---or linear recoverability: correspondence revealed by a supervised linear map. Using matched Legacy Survey and Hyper Suprime-Cam (HSC) embeddings across five model families, we find that Ridge alignment strengthens the relationship between model size and cross-dataset neighbourhood correspondence relative to native cosine geometry. The effect appears in all five families and persists when both representations are reduced to dimension, so it is not simply that wider embeddings give alignment more dimensions to work with. The learned maps remain far from rotations or uniform scaling, and Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) and Block-Sparse Featuriser (BSF) features give no advantage over the same alignment applied to dense embeddings. Model scale thus improves linear recoverability more clearly than native cosine-neighbourhood correspondence, without establishing convergence toward a shared native metric geometry.

    中文

    更大的模型是否会学到越来越相似的世界表征？柏拉图表征假说（PRH）预测答案是肯定的，但“相似”可以指原生余弦几何——即任何学习得到的对齐之前，由余弦相似度诱导的最近邻结构——也可以指线性可恢复性：通过监督线性映射揭示的对应关系。我们使用五个模型系列中相匹配的 Legacy Survey 和 Hyper Suprime-Cam（HSC）嵌入，发现相较于原生余弦几何，岭回归对齐增强了模型规模与跨数据集邻域对应关系之间的联系。这一效应出现在全部五个系列中；即便将两个表征都降至同一维度，效应依然存在，因此这并非仅仅因为更宽的嵌入为对齐提供了更多维度。学习得到的映射远非旋转或统一缩放；稀疏自编码器（SAE）和块稀疏特征器（BSF）的特征，相比于对密集嵌入应用相同对齐方法，并无优势。因此，模型规模对线性可恢复性的提升，比对原生余弦邻域对应关系的提升更为明显，但这并不能证明表征正趋向共享的原生度量几何。

    Next Token or Vector? Learning How Far to Decode

    下一个 Token 还是向量？学习解码的跨度

    Sai Sreenivas Chintha, Chidera Biringa, Rishab Sharma, Anusha Agrawal, Prachi Badarayani, Gemma Zhang, Nigel Boachie Kumankumah, Marco Ayala, Sulaiman Vesal

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CADENCE learns to route between prediction lengths and decode accepted continuations in parallel, with the main contribution improving adaptive computation and generation throughput. Hidden states inform the router, but the abstract gives no account of internal representations or reasoning mechanisms, so those connections remain incidental.

    CADENCE 学习在不同预测长度之间进行路由，并并行解码被接受的续写；其主要贡献是提升自适应计算效率和生成吞吐量。隐藏状态会为路由器提供信息，但摘要没有说明内部表征或推理机制，因此这些联系只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Standard autoregressive decoding advances one token at a time, even when several upcoming tokens can be predicted together. We propose CADENCE (Context-Adaptive DEcoding), a generation method that learns both what to draft and how far to draft. Gaussian prediction heads represent future spans as continuous latent vectors, and a shared decoder converts the selected vector into token predictions in parallel. A learned router selects the prediction length from the model's own hidden states and predicted Gaussian parameters, adapting generation granularity to the current context with single-token generation as a fallback. The backbone verifies each proposed continuation and retains the prefix that matches its greedy predictions. Experiments with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on Alpaca, GSM8K, and HumanEval show that router-selected positions yield higher draft acceptance than applying the corresponding prediction length everywhere. CADENCE achieves up to 1.3x higher generation throughput than standard greedy decoding.

    中文

    标准自回归解码每次前进一步，生成一个 token，即便可以同时预测接下来的多个 token。我们提出 CADENCE（Context-Adaptive DEcoding，上下文自适应解码），一种同时学习起草什么内容以及起草多长跨度的生成方法。高斯预测头将未来片段表示为连续潜向量，共享解码器则把选定向量并行转换为 token 预测。一个学习得到的路由器根据模型自身的隐藏状态和预测的高斯参数选择预测长度，使生成粒度适应当前上下文，并以单 token 生成为后备方案。骨干模型会验证每个提议的续写，并保留与其贪心预测相匹配的前缀。在 Alpaca、GSM8K 和 HumanEval 上使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的实验表明，与在所有位置一律应用相应预测长度相比，由路由器选择的位置具有更高的草稿接受率。CADENCE 的生成吞吐量最高可达标准贪心解码的 1.3 倍。

    通过 Harness-Policy 优化实现自我进化的编码智能体

    Zhepei Wei, Wenlin Yao, Baolin Peng, Danqing Wang, Qianhui Wu, Hao Cheng, Yu Meng, Jianfeng Gao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Self-HPO alternates harness and policy optimization, using reinforcement learning and policy-generated harness proposals to improve coding-agent performance and generalization. This substantially advances agent organization, while reasoning is a training context rather than a studied mechanism, and no compositional capability is described.

    Self-HPO 交替优化 harness 和策略，利用强化学习和由策略生成的 harness 提议来提升编码智能体的性能与泛化能力。这显著推进了智能体组织方式；推理只是训练背景，而非研究机制，且文中没有描述组合能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment. Indeed, harness and policy are mutually reinforcing and evolving only one component is suboptimal---a harness tuned for one checkpoint may not target the failure modes of an updated policy, while policy learning remains limited to the trajectories elicited by a fixed harness. In light of this, we propose Self-HPO, a recursive self-improving framework for coding agents that alternates harness and policy optimization, using the evolving policy as its own harness proposer. Specifically, in each round, the current policy first analyzes its own failures and proposes new harness candidates (H-step). The policy is then updated through reinforcement learning (RL) under the selected harness (P-step), and hard tasks identified during training form the next harness search set, keeping harness optimization targeted to the policy's evolving failure modes. Across three coding benchmarks, Self-HPO consistently outperforms harness-only and policy-only baselines, improving Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's average resolve rate from 57.8% to 64.8%, with gains generalizing to out-of-distribution settings. Further analysis shows that both optimized components retain gains even when paired with their base counterparts, while their joint gain exceeds the sum of their individual gains. Self-HPO also improves reliability (Pass@1) and expands the capability frontier (Pass@k) over the base agent. Additionally, we show that with a stronger external model (e.g., Opus 4.8) as the harness proposer, the same framework yields a further performance boost.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在编码任务中展现出良好的潜力，其性能由策略模型以及协调其与环境交互的 harness 共同决定。事实上，harness 与策略相互促进，只改进其中一个组件并非最优——针对某个检查点调优的 harness 可能无法针对更新后策略的失效模式，而策略学习仍受限于固定 harness 所引出的轨迹。有鉴于此，我们提出 Self-HPO，这是一种面向编码智能体的递归自我改进框架，通过交替优化 harness 和策略，并让不断演进的策略充当自己的 harness 提议器。具体而言，在每一轮中，当前策略首先分析自身的失败，并提出新的 harness 候选项（H-step）。随后，在选定的 harness 下通过强化学习（RL）更新策略（P-step），训练过程中识别出的困难任务则构成下一轮 harness 搜索集，使 harness 优化始终针对策略不断演进的失效模式。在三个编码基准上，Self-HPO 始终优于仅优化 harness 或仅优化策略的基线，将 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的平均解决率从 57.8% 提高到 64.8%，且增益可泛化到分布外设置。进一步分析显示，即使与各自的基础版本配对，两个优化后的组件也都能保留增益，而二者的联合增益超过各自单独增益之和。与基础智能体相比，Self-HPO 还提升了可靠性（Pass@1）并拓展了能力前沿（Pass@k）。此外，我们表明，若使用更强的外部模型（例如 Opus 4.8）作为 harness 提议器，同一框架还能带来进一步的性能提升。

    Prune the Leaky Neurons: Mitigating Private Data Leakage in Fine-Tuned LLMs via Joint-Embedding-Guided Pruning

    剪除泄漏神经元：通过联合嵌入引导的剪枝缓解微调 LLM 中的私有数据泄漏

    Mohamed Shaaban, Mohamed Elmahallawy

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    JEPA-Prune compares representations from private and PII-free models, then uses attribution and neuron specificity to identify and prune neurons associated with private information while preserving utility. This offers transferable insight into localized knowledge and representation-based editing; pruning is a model intervention, but the abstract does not describe broader system design.

    JEPA-Prune 对比私有模型与无 PII 模型的表征，再利用归因方法和神经元特异性，识别并剪除与私有信息相关的神经元，同时保留模型效用。这为局部化知识和基于表征的编辑提供了可迁移的见解；剪枝属于模型干预，但摘要没有描述更广泛的系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on proprietary records enables domain adaptation but introduces two challenges: (i) privacy leakage of memorized private data, such as personally identifiable information (PII), and (ii) balancing private data removal with utility preservation. Existing defenses, including data sanitization and differential privacy, often degrade performance, while privacy-neuron editing lacks a PII-free reference to distinguish identity-specific neurons from those supporting useful text. We propose JEPA-Prune, a post-hoc neuron pruning framework guided by a model trained exclusively on PII-free views. Alongside the fine-tuned private model, JEPA-Prune, trains a public model on surrogate and masked views of the same records using a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), capturing domain knowledge without identifiers. A cross-model representation probe quantifies deviations between private representations of leaked records and this PII-free reference. Integrated gradients and a scale-invariant specificity score then identify PII-responsive neurons, which are pruned without retraining. Experiments show that pruning just 1.6% of neurons reduces PII inference accuracy by up to 7.4x and PII extraction recall by up to 13.9x, while keeping unseen-text perplexity within 16% of that of the unpruned model for most LLMs. In contrast, privacy-neuron editing increases perplexity by at least 26x.

    中文

    在专有记录上微调大型语言模型（LLM）能够实现领域适配，但会带来两项挑战：（i）记忆的私有数据泄漏，例如个人身份信息（PII）；（ii）在移除私有数据的同时保留模型效用。现有防御措施，包括数据清理和差分隐私，往往会降低性能；而隐私神经元编辑缺少不含 PII 的参考模型，因而无法区分身份特异性神经元与支持有用文本的神经元。我们提出 JEPA-Prune，这是一种事后神经元剪枝框架，由一个仅使用不含 PII 的视图训练的模型提供引导。除了微调后的私有模型，JEPA-Prune 还使用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），在同一批记录的代理视图和遮蔽视图上训练一个公开模型，从而在不包含标识符的情况下捕获领域知识。跨模型表征探针量化泄漏记录的私有表征与这一无 PII 参考之间的偏差。随后，综合梯度和尺度不变的特异性评分用于识别对 PII 有响应的神经元，并在无需重新训练的情况下将其剪除。实验表明，仅剪除 1.6% 的神经元，就能将 PII 推断准确率最多降低 7.4 倍、PII 提取召回率最多降低 13.9 倍，同时对大多数 LLM 而言，使未见文本的困惑度保持在未剪枝模型的 16% 以内。相比之下，隐私神经元编辑会使困惑度至少增加 26 倍。

    Ilia Zaznov

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper adds causal, content-addressed prefix memory to a looped Transformer and reports consistent perplexity gains across several settings, with ablations supporting the design. This is a substantial architectural contribution to model computation and memory, though it does not directly study internal representations or reasoning.

    本文为循环 Transformer 加入因果、基于内容寻址的前缀记忆，并报告了在多种设置下稳定的困惑度提升，消融实验也支持该设计。这是对模型计算与记忆架构的重要推进，但没有直接研究内部表征或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reusing a Transformer block across depth increases computation without replicating its parameters, but successive passes have no dedicated state through which positions can exchange compact summaries of their causal prefix. We introduce the causal latent workspace Transformer: an anchored, four-round shared-depth architecture in which each position writes gated vectors into prefix-specific latent slots and retrieves a content-addressed summary before the next shared block application. This path complements causal self-attention while the original input embedding remains accessible at every round. Across three byte-level corpora, three seeds, and two matched parameter budgets, the proposed model achieves the best mean held-out perplexity in five of six settings against five Transformer controls. At 101.71M parameters it leads on WikiText-103 raw, enwik8, and TinyStories, reaching perplexities 2.7820, 2.7843, and 1.6823; these improve upon the strongest non-workspace control on each corpus by 1.06%, 0.73%, and 1.01%. All nine seed-labelled comparisons at this budget favor the workspace. At 0.918M parameters it leads on WikiText-103 and TinyStories, whereas a conditioned loop is stronger on enwik8. Architectural ablations show that adding the workspace improves upon the anchored loop in all six settings and support refreshing its causal summaries at each round. Together, these results identify a causal, content-addressable prefix workspace as an effective structural augmentation of looped Transformers.

    跨深度重复使用 Transformer 块可以在不复制参数的情况下增加计算量，但连续的多轮处理中没有专门状态，供各位置交换其因果前缀的紧凑摘要。我们提出因果潜在工作空间 Transformer：一种锚定式、四轮共享深度架构，其中每个位置将门控向量写入前缀专属的潜在槽位，并在下一次应用共享块之前检索一个基于内容寻址的摘要。这条路径补充了因果自注意力，同时使原始输入嵌入在每一轮都可访问。在三个字节级语料库、三个随机种子和两种匹配参数预算下，与五种 Transformer 对照模型相比，所提模型在六种设置中的五种取得了最佳平均留出集困惑度。在参数量为 101.71M 时，它在 WikiText-103 raw、enwik8 和 TinyStories 上领先，困惑度分别达到 2.7820、2.7843 和 1.6823；相较于各语料库上最强的非工作空间对照模型，分别提升 1.06%、0.73% 和 1.01%。在这一参数预算下，所有九项带随机种子标记的比较结果都支持工作空间模型。在 0.918M 参数下，它在 WikiText-103 和 TinyStories 上领先，而在 enwik8 上，条件循环模型表现更强。架构消融实验表明，在全部六种设置中，加入工作空间都优于锚定循环模型，并支持每轮刷新其因果摘要。总的来说，这些结果表明，因果、基于内容寻址的前缀工作空间是循环 Transformer 的一种有效结构性增强。

    Zhenwei Tang, Jintao Liu, Di Bai, Xidong Wu, Xinwu Cheng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether post-training can elicit ranking behavior from Semantic IDs and compares training methods, with analysis of rationale quality. Its ranking and reasoning focus supports a strong Reasoning score, while SID representation alone does not establish compositional generalization, internal mechanisms, or model-system design.

    本文测试后训练能否诱发基于语义 ID 的排序行为，并比较不同训练方法，同时分析理由质量。其对排序与推理的关注支持较高的 Reasoning 评分；但仅凭 SID 表征无法证明组合泛化、内部机制或模型系统设计方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning rerankers write a rationale before ranking a candidate slate, and existing systems read item metadata to do so, even though generative recommenders increasingly represent items as compact Semantic IDs (SIDs). Ranking from SIDs alone has two appeals: SID prompts are far shorter than the matched item text, and although item codes are fixed from content, the backbone learns their token embeddings in part from user-item interaction sequences, so the tokens can carry behavioral signal that item text lacks. That training targets next-item generation, and whether it supports ranking a supplied slate from SIDs alone is untested. We build ReRankID, a controlled testbed in which models reason and rank from a history and slate shown only as SIDs, varying item rendering, history length, and slate size one at a time. On this testbed, such models often copy the input order instead of reranking, and readable metadata does not repair the failure. We compare supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampled self-training, on-policy distillation, and verifier-based reinforcement learning as post-training methods and find that they elicit the missing behavior. The strongest post-trained model, the 8B model trained with a graded ranking reward, gives the best SID-only ranking and matches strong text-reading LLMs whose prompts are about 20x longer. It ranks above random with no history at all, where a caption-reading reference does not, and it keeps its gains at long histories, where text prompts pass 50k tokens and the caption-reading reference stops improving. In a paired rationale audit, this model argues trade-offs better than that reference but describes items less accurately. The common post-training methods we test thus elicit ranking from SIDs but not faithful item descriptions, which calls for post-training that improves the reasoning itself, not only the ranking it produces.

    中文

    推理重排序器会先撰写理由，再对候选列表排序；现有系统为此会读取物品元数据，尽管生成式推荐系统越来越多地用紧凑的语义 ID（SID）表示物品。仅根据 SID 排序有两点吸引力：SID 提示远短于对应的物品文本；而且，尽管物品编码由内容确定，主干模型仍会部分依据用户-物品交互序列学习这些编码的词元嵌入，因此这些词元可能携带物品文本所缺乏的行为信号。这类训练的目标是生成下一个物品，但它能否支持仅根据 SID 对给定候选列表排序，尚未经过测试。我们构建了 ReRankID，这是一个受控测试平台，模型仅根据以 SID 表示的历史记录和候选列表进行推理与排序，并逐一改变物品呈现方式、历史长度和候选列表大小。在该测试平台上，这类模型经常照抄输入顺序，而不重新排序；可读的元数据也无法弥补这一失效。我们比较了监督微调、拒绝采样自训练、策略内蒸馏和基于验证器的强化学习等后训练方法，发现它们能够诱发缺失的行为。最强的后训练模型是使用分级排序奖励训练的 8B 模型，它在仅用 SID 排序时表现最佳，并能匹敌强大的读取文本的 LLM，而后者的提示约长 20 倍。完全不给历史记录时，它的排序仍高于随机水平，而读取说明文字的参考模型则做不到；在长历史条件下，它也能保持增益，此时文本提示会超过 50k 词元，而读取说明文字的参考模型不再提升。在一项成对理由审查中，该模型比参考模型更善于论证权衡，但对物品的描述准确性较低。因此，我们测试的常见后训练方法能够诱发基于 SID 的排序，却不能诱发忠实的物品描述；这说明后训练需要提升推理本身，而不只是提升其产出的排序。

    因果编辑序列化

    Louis Robinson

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CES contributes a pointer-addressed mechanism for localized edits in causal language-model generation, with a new localization head, positional encoding, and training procedure; its main advance is a model interface for computation and revision, supporting Systems 4. Edit operations compose text transformations, but compositional generalization is not the focus, so CompGen is 3; the abstract does not study internal representations or reasoning mechanisms, leaving MechInterp 1 and Reasoning 2.

    CES 为因果语言模型生成中的局部编辑提供了基于指针寻址的机制，并引入新的定位头、位置编码和训练过程；其主要进展是为计算与修订提供模型接口，支持 Systems 4。编辑操作会组合文本变换，但组合泛化并非重点，因此 CompGen 为 3；摘要没有研究内部表征或推理机制，因此 MechInterp 为 1，Reasoning 为 2。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Standard autoregressive language models generate text sequentially, but revision requires referring back to tokens in the input context or those already generated. Causal Edit Serialization (CES) is introduced as a framework for expressing such revisions within the same causal token stream. Special pointer tokens are paired with predicted source addresses, allowing insertion, deletion, replacement, copying and movement to be localized explicitly. A lightweight localization head and dual-index rotary position encoding support both address prediction and conditioning on previously emitted pointers, while retaining a standard causal attention mask. A pretraining procedure combines ordinary language modeling with serialized repairs derived from random corruptions, model-generated edits and repeated text. Across model scales and editing baselines, CES models demonstrate complete applied edits with modestly higher clean-text bits per byte than clean autoregressive models. Supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training provide a grammatical-error-correction proof of concept, producing more beneficial than harmful changes under reference-blind model judging. Correct repair programs also improve subsequent text prediction while the original context and its cached states are retained. CES provides a common interface for generation and localized revision, with potential extensions to iterative refinement and additional pointer-addressed transformations.

    中文

    标准自回归语言模型按顺序生成文本，但修订时需要回指输入上下文中的词元或已经生成的词元。本文提出因果编辑序列化（CES）框架，以便在同一因果词元流中表达此类修订。特殊指针词元与预测出的源地址配对，从而能够明确定位插入、删除、替换、复制和移动操作。轻量级定位头和双索引旋转位置编码支持地址预测以及以先前输出的指针为条件，同时保留标准因果注意力掩码。预训练过程将常规语言建模与序列化修复结合起来，修复样本源自随机损坏、模型生成的编辑和重复文本。在不同模型规模和编辑基线下，CES 模型能够完整应用编辑，其干净文本的每字节比特数仅略高于干净的自回归模型。监督式和强化学习后训练提供了语法错误纠正的概念验证；在不参考标准答案的模型评判下，产生的有益修改多于有害修改。正确的修复程序还能够改善后续文本预测，同时保留原始上下文及其缓存状态。CES 为生成与局部修订提供了通用接口，并有望扩展到迭代式优化及其他由指针寻址的变换。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    WAC jointly trains future prediction and action evaluation so critic signals shape predictive representations, with theoretical analysis of feature retention and selection regret; this substantially advances policy reasoning under counterfactual actions (Reasoning 4). The representation result is about task-relevant predictive features rather than interpretability, and the driving application alone does not establish compositional generalization or a new agent-system architecture, supporting MechInterp 3, CompGen 2, and Systems 3.

    WAC 联合训练未来预测与动作评估，使评判器信号塑造预测表征，并通过理论分析研究特征保留和选择遗憾；这显著推进了反事实动作条件下的策略推理（Reasoning 4）。表征方面的结果关注任务相关的预测特征，而非可解释性；自动驾驶应用本身也不足以证明组合泛化或新的智能体系统架构，因此支持 MechInterp 3、CompGen 2 和 Systems 3。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models have shown considerable promise in sequential decision-making by anticipating the consequences of actions and providing predictive foresight for policy learning. However, learning to reason about counterfactual actions remains challenging, since predictive objectives may underemphasize information critical for action evaluation, while unexecuted actions lack observed futures for direct supervision. To address these challenges, we propose the World Action Critic (WAC) Model, which proposes multimodal action candidates and jointly learns candidate-conditioned future prediction and consequence evaluation. In our proposed framework, critic supervision directly shapes intermediate predictive representations during rollout, encouraging them to retain information needed to distinguish action quality. Observed futures supervise prediction for executed actions, while external task-quality targets provide evaluation signals for counterfactual candidates. Through joint optimization, critic signals from these candidates propagate into predictive representations without requiring their observed futures. Our theoretical analysis characterizes critic-guided feature retention and bounds candidate-selection regret. Applied to autonomous driving, WAC achieves 93.4 PDMS on NAVSIM-v1, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly learning predictive foresight and consequence evaluation.

    世界模型通过预判动作后果，为策略学习提供预测性前瞻，因此在序列决策中展现出巨大潜力。然而，学习对反事实动作进行推理仍具有挑战性，因为预测目标可能忽视对动作评估至关重要的信息，而未执行的动作也没有观测到的未来可用于直接监督。为应对这些挑战，我们提出世界动作评估器（WAC）模型，它会提出多模态动作候选项，并联合学习以候选动作为条件的未来预测和后果评估。在我们提出的框架中，评判器监督会在展开过程中直接塑造中间预测表征，促使其保留区分动作质量所需的信息。观测到的未来用于监督已执行动作的预测，而外部任务质量目标则为反事实候选项提供评估信号。通过联合优化，这些候选项产生的评判信号会传播到预测表征中，而无需其对应的观测未来。我们的理论分析刻画了评判器引导的特征保留，并给出了候选选择遗憾的上界。在自动驾驶应用中，WAC 在 NAVSIM-v1 上达到 93.4 PDMS，展示了联合学习预测性前瞻与后果评估的有效性。

    The Reliance Hypothesis: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Rises as Language Resource Level Falls

    依赖假说：语言资源水平越低，思维链忠实度越高

    Lucas Resck, Jingyi Sun, Qianli Wang, Isabelle Augenstein, Anna Korhonen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how language resource level and task type relate to CoT faithfulness, finding that models rely on reasoning for more answers on lower-resource languages in knowledge-intensive tasks. This is a substantial empirical contribution to reasoning behavior and monitoring, but it does not investigate internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文研究语言资源水平和任务类型与 CoT 忠实度之间的关系，发现对于知识密集型任务，模型在低资源语言中会在更多答案上依赖推理。这是对推理行为和监测的重要实证贡献，但没有研究内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness matters for monitoring, explaining and safely deploying large language models, yet it has been studied mostly in English. Languages differ in level, the amount of text available to learn from, so models know less in lower-resource languages, which may change how much they rely on their reasoning. To our knowledge, we are the first to relate CoT faithfulness to both resource level and task type (knowledge- or reasoning-intensive). On parallel multiple-choice questions from Multilingual Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMMLU) in eight languages, faithfulness rises as resource level falls on knowledge-intensive tasks but not on reasoning-intensive ones, a gap that points the same way across four models and several faithfulness measures. We propose, and find support for, the Reliance Hypothesis: models rely more on their reasoning when they cannot recall the answer, as in lower-resource languages on knowledge-intensive tasks. Model confidence partly explains the effect of resource level, but not the knowledge-reasoning gap. Languages in which models are less confident rely more on reasoning, yet less confident answers within a language do not, a Simpson's paradox. In lower-resource languages, models rely on their reasoning for more answers, not more strongly for each. CoT monitoring may therefore be most informative in lower-resource languages, where it is least often validated.

    思维链（CoT）的忠实度对监测、解释和安全部署大型语言模型至关重要，但相关研究主要集中于英语。语言的资源水平，即可供学习的文本量，各不相同；因此，模型对低资源语言的了解较少，这可能改变模型对其推理的依赖程度。据我们所知，我们首次同时考察了 CoT 忠实度与资源水平及任务类型（知识密集型或推理密集型）之间的关系。在涵盖八种语言的多语言大规模多任务语言理解（MMMLU）平行选择题上，知识密集型任务中的忠实度随资源水平降低而上升，而推理密集型任务中则没有这种趋势；四个模型和多种忠实度度量都显示出方向一致的差异。我们提出并获得证据支持依赖假说：当模型无法回忆答案时，例如在低资源语言的知识密集型任务中，模型会更多依赖自身推理。模型置信度可以部分解释资源水平的影响，却无法解释知识与推理任务之间的差距。模型置信度较低的语言中，模型会更多依赖推理；但在同一种语言内，置信度较低的答案并不会如此，这构成了辛普森悖论。在低资源语言中，模型是在更多答案上依赖推理，而不是在每个答案上依赖得更强。因此，在低资源语言中监测 CoT 可能最有信息价值，而这些语言恰恰最少得到验证。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark that separates algorithm choice from data-driven correction in agentic causal discovery, and reports that LLM agents recover edges absent from existing algorithm outputs.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents can now run causal discovery algorithms on a dataset and report what comes out. Whether they do more than that, such as noticing where an algorithm went wrong and fixing it with further tests, is hard to tell from current benchmarks. Most of them give the variables meaningful names, and an LLM shown only the names of the T\"ubingen cause-effect pairs already gets 99% of the directions right. With the names removed, the data are usually clean enough that picking a better algorithm than PC closes most of the gap. We introduce Heuresis, a benchmark of anonymous simulated datasets whose mechanisms range from linear Gaussian to heavy-tailed. For each family of datasets it separates what a better existing algorithm can gain from what only a closer look at the data can gain, and it traces every edge an agent changes. Every family leaves a gap that none of the algorithms, the router and the two causal-discovery foundation models we ran can close, so a score above the best chosen algorithm has to come from using the data. We instantiate the benchmark with an agent harness and three LLMs, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 and Qwen 3.8 Flash. GPT-6.1 Sol surpasses the best chosen algorithm on all six families, by 14% adjacency F1 on the most difficult one, and Claude Opus 5.5 does so by 7.4% there. A third of the true edges the two agents restore on the two hardest families appear in no algorithm's output. The code and data will be publicly released to facilitate future work.

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents are increasingly integrated into real-world works, yet they must handle diverse domain-specific tools and complex multi-sub-task problems that sequential tool invocation resolves inefficiently and with severe context bloat. The Main-Agent Delegation and Sub-Agent Execution (MAD-SAE) paradigm addresses these issues by delegating sub-tasks to specialized sub-agents for parallel execution in isolated contexts, but its delegation and orchestration quality remains unquantified. We introduce MS-Eval, a unified evaluation kit comprising an MCP-intensive benchmark, a controlled execution harness, tailored delegation and orchestration metrics, and the MSQ index for comprehensive assessment. Evaluating four MAD-SAE variants and eight frontier models reveals that (1) sub-agent specialization (Spec) is the best practical practice; (2) open-source models are largely competitive with few exceptions; and (3) MAD-SAE generally raises cost with contingent payoff, benefiting most open-source models in both performance and efficiency while leaving closed-source models with higher cost and degraded performance. Our case study further traces these gains to better single-agent solutions, effective context offloading, and genuine sub-task parallelism, whereas unnecessary or redundant delegation turns the same cost into pure overhead.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study evaluates whether LLM agents adapt their decisions to incentives, partner behavior, and group composition in a collective-risk game. It offers substantial empirical insight into multi-agent behavior and evaluation, with reasoning connections limited to payoff decisions and no evidence about internal mechanisms or compositional capabilities.

    这项研究在集体风险游戏中评估 LLM 智能体是否会根据激励、伙伴行为和群体构成调整决策。它为多智能体行为与评估提供了重要的实证洞见；与推理的关联仅限于收益决策，也没有提供关于内部机制或组合能力的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language-model agents are increasingly deployed to act on behalf of people in settings where individual decisions shape shared outcomes. We examine whether five production models adapt their contributions to changing risks and partner behaviour, or instead follow a relatively fixed strategy. In a collective-risk dilemma game (CRG), six players contribute to a shared pool over ten rounds; if the pool falls short of its target, a catastrophe may destroy their remaining resources. Four models contributed approximately an equal share at every positive risk level, and four of the five also contributed when risk was zero, even though contributing could not improve their payoff. Explicitly stating that only the agent's own payoff mattered reduced zero-risk contributions for most models, while a more neutral prompt did not. Several models correctly identified which action offered the higher expected payoff at different risk levels, yet their contributions changed little. Against fixed partners, no model consistently chose the payoff-maximising response, and in mixed-model groups, a single agent's shortfall in the final round could cause an otherwise successful group to fail. Payoff-based selection also depended on population composition: in a single six-agent group, it favoured the model that contributed least and reduced group success, whereas in larger, randomly mixed populations, it favoured an exact fair-share model at moderate and high risk. These findings show that cooperative self-play alone is not evidence of strategic adaptability. Consistent with a machine-behaviour approach, evaluations of agents in multi-agent systems should test how they respond to incentives, partner actions, and population composition.

    中文

    语言模型智能体正越来越多地被部署来代表人们行事，而在这些场景中，个体决策会影响共同结果。我们考察五种生产级模型会否根据风险变化和伙伴行为调整贡献，还是遵循相对固定的策略。在集体风险困境游戏（CRG）中，六名玩家在十轮内向一个共享资金池投入资源；如果资金池未达到目标，灾难可能会摧毁他们剩余的资源。四种模型在每个正风险水平下都投入了近似相等的份额，五种模型中有四种在风险为零时也进行了投入，尽管投入并不能改善其收益。明确说明只有智能体自身收益重要后，大多数模型在零风险时的投入减少了，而更中性的提示则没有这种效果。有几种模型正确判断了不同风险水平下哪种行动的预期收益更高，但它们的投入几乎没有变化。面对固定伙伴时，没有模型能始终选择收益最大化的回应；在由不同模型组成的群体中，单个智能体在最后一轮投入不足，就可能导致原本成功的群体失败。基于收益的筛选也取决于群体构成：在一个六智能体群体中，它偏向投入最少的模型，并降低群体成功率；而在规模更大、随机混合的群体中，它在中高风险下偏向恰好投入公平份额的模型。这些发现表明，仅有合作式自我博弈并不能证明具备策略适应能力。与机器行为研究方法一致，对多智能体系统中智能体的评估应检验它们如何应对激励、伙伴行为和群体构成。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how class geometry in latent representations affects classifier-free guidance and proposes prototype regularization, with results across several condition types and modalities. Its transferable insight about representation geometry supports MechInterp; generalization to different conditions alone does not establish compositionality, reasoning, or systems contributions.

    本文分析潜在表征中的类别几何结构如何影响无分类器引导，并提出原型正则化；实验结果涵盖多种条件类型和模态。其关于表征几何结构的可迁移见解对 MechInterp 有帮助；仅在不同条件间实现泛化，并不能证明其涉及组合性、推理或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard component of conditional diffusion models, and guided generation performance has become the \textit{de facto} measure of state-of-the-art models. Recent work on latent diffusion models seeks to learn latent spaces that are easier to model with diffusion. However, under CFG, generation additionally depends on how conditions are arranged in the latent space. We study this arrangement under discrete class conditions, termed \emph{class geometry}, and investigate what class geometry allows a latent space to work well with CFG. Under a Gaussian class model, we show that shifting variance from intra- to inter-class at fixed total variance makes classes more distinguishable under noise, and derive a noisy posterior objective whose per-sample descent direction is proportional to the oracle CFG correction. Based on the analysis, we propose Prototype Regularization (PR), a lightweight surrogate for the intractable noisy posterior objective, which applies a cosine prototype classifier to spatially pooled latents. With a controlled training budget (20 epochs for VAE, 80 epochs for DiT), adding PR to an LDM baseline reduces guided gFID on ImageNet from 3.31 to 2.28, surpassing a DINOv3-aligned VA-VAE (2.44) with negligible overhead. We further demonstrate that PR generalizes to pseudo-labels derived from clustering, continuous text-embedding conditions, and video latents. Together, our findings highlight class geometry as a critical factor in guided generation and take a first step toward CFG-compatible representation learning. Our project page is available at: https://maps-research.github.io/cfg-geometry/.

    中文

    无分类器引导（CFG）是条件扩散模型的标准组成部分，而引导生成性能已成为衡量先进模型的\textit{事实标准}。近期关于潜在扩散模型的研究致力于学习更易于用扩散进行建模的潜在空间。然而，在 CFG 下，生成效果还取决于条件在潜在空间中的排列方式。我们研究离散类别条件下的这种排列，称为\emph{类别几何结构}，并探讨何种类别几何结构能使潜在空间更适用于 CFG。在高斯类别模型下，我们证明，在总方差固定的情况下，将方差从类内转移到类间会使类别在噪声下更易区分；我们还推导出一个带噪后验目标，其逐样本下降方向与预言机 CFG 校正项成正比。基于这一分析，我们提出原型正则化（PR），这是一种针对难以处理的带噪后验目标的轻量级替代方法，它对经过空间池化的潜在表示应用余弦原型分类器。在受控训练预算下（VAE 训练 20 个 epoch，DiT 训练 80 个 epoch），在 LDM 基线上加入 PR，可将 ImageNet 上的引导 gFID 从 3.31 降至 2.28，超过与 DINOv3 对齐的 VA-VAE（2.44），且额外开销可忽略。我们进一步证明，PR 可推广到从聚类得到的伪标签、连续文本嵌入条件和视频潜在表示。总的来说，我们的发现凸显了类别几何结构是引导生成的关键因素，并为兼容 CFG 的表征学习迈出了第一步。项目页面：https://maps-research.github.io/cfg-geometry/

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces concurrent constraint reinforcement, using multiple verifiable problems in capped completions to preserve reward signals while reducing rollout cost, and analyzes its reward and update variance.     本文提出并行约束强化：在有长度上限的补全中使用多个可验证问题，以保留奖励信号并降低 rollout 成本，同时分析其奖励方差和更新方差。这是对数学推理训练方法的重要贡献；其效率提升与 Systems 的关联只是附带的，因为本文没有推进模型或智能体系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long rollout windows make reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) expensive, yet simply shortening them can remove the correctness signal: when every single-problem rollout truncates before an answer, group-relative accuracy advantages vanish. As a technical continuation of Batched Contextual Reinforcement (BCR), we study how concurrent rewards relax this dependence on long windows. Concurrent Constraint Reinforcement (CCR) places three independently verifiable problems in one capped training completion. Correct answers completed before truncation retain credit, while a shared budget encourages shorter useful reasoning without an explicit length penalty. We connect this mechanism to conditional reward- and update-variance analyses and study 4B and 8B mathematical reasoning models. Against single-problem GRPO with a 32k window, CCR with an 8,000-token window reduces tokens per training step from 975,464 to 174,957 on 4B and from 793,832 to 165,788 on 8B, saving 82.1% and 79.1%, respectively. An 8B training trace shows increasing accuracy reward alongside shorter completions. Single-problem evaluations provide supporting evidence of retained reasoning quality. These results identify reward-preserving training structure as a practical route to lower per-step cost in short-window RLVR.

    较长的 rollout 窗口会增加可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的成本，但直接缩短窗口可能会消除正确性信号：当每个单问题 rollout 都在答案出现前截断时，组内相对准确率优势便会消失。作为《批处理上下文强化》（BCR）的技术延续，我们研究并行奖励如何降低对长窗口的依赖。并行约束强化（CCR）在一个有长度上限的训练补全中放入三个可独立验证的问题。在截断前完成的正确答案仍可获得奖励，而共享预算会鼓励更短且有效的推理，无需显式施加长度惩罚。我们将这一机制与条件奖励方差和更新方差分析联系起来，并研究 4B 和 8B 数学推理模型。与采用 32k 窗口的单问题 GRPO 相比，CCR 使用 8,000 token 窗口后，每个训练步骤的 token 数在 4B 模型上从 975,464 降至 174,957，在 8B 模型上从 793,832 降至 165,788，分别节省 82.1% 和 79.1%。一条 8B 训练轨迹显示，准确率奖励不断提高，同时补全内容变短。单问题评估也为推理质量得以保持提供了佐证。这些结果表明，保留奖励的训练结构是降低短窗口 RLVR 每步成本的一条实用途径。

    Transformer Programs (TP) (Friedman et al., 2023) constrain a Transformer's architecture so that its learned computation can be extracted as readable Python code. TP expose learned computations, but token accuracy can hide incorrect complete answers. In this work, we examine how program inspection provides insights beyond accuracy scores and helps guide training. We first evaluated TP on nine algorithmic tasks. We compared token accuracy with accuracy on complete output sequences and checked for failures missed by sampled tests. Further, we assessed training data improvements informed by program inspection and failure analysis, finding gains in sequence accuracy on several tasks. We examined a counting task where a program achieved 100% accuracy on sampled test sequences but failed on another input using the symbols and lengths allowed during training. The program counted correctly, but the required answer was missing from its output labels. After adding training examples with larger counts, the retrained models passed exhaustive evaluation over the bounded domain. In the frequency ranking task, inspection showed how correct counts contributed to incorrect answers in programs trained before and after changes to the training data. Finally, we studied constraints imposed by TP training and operations. The TP training process can lead to accuracy losses late in training. Our reference constructions also show how composing the restricted TP operations can use many layers or large lookup tables.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon agents learn from failure, but the value of a failure record can change as execution progresses. We study when retaining, compressing, or removing the same history block improves subsequent execution relative to full-history KEEP. We introduce RECAP, a framework that combines matched context interventions, execution-relational prediction, and independent policy certification. Matched environment states and rollout seeds measure success and continuation prompt-cost differences; prefix-only relations between a failure block and the current execution propose promising edits. Independent task bundles then select a policy subject to harmful-intervention and non-positive-benefit risk constraints under a fixed measurement protocol. A five-seed longitudinal case holds both the failure block and its summary fixed: compression fails at an early state and becomes a cost-saving intervention at a later state. Across five backbones, RECAP produces positive paired-success saving estimates with backbone-specific reliability-efficiency tradeoffs. On Hunyuan-A13B, it edits 43.24% of retained checkpoints while matching KEEP's observed 91.89% continuation success and reducing unconditional mean continuation prompt cost by 4,619.8 tokens (2.13%). The framework provides an execution-level reference for deciding when to forget: retain history by its value to what comes next.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    COMET proposes distillation, expert coordination, routing, and capacity control for task-agnostic continual vision-language learning; it explicitly aims to preserve multimodal representation geometry.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP retain zero-shot recognition ability, but their open-world use often requires task-agnostic continual learning: tasks arrive sequentially, past data are unavailable, task identity is unknown, and the backbone cannot be retrained. We argue that this setting fails VLMs through three coupled pressures beyond the stability-plasticity tradeoff: (1) modal-consistency drift, (2) representation-space interference, and (3) per-task capacity shortfall. We propose COMET (Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer) to resolve these three issues respectively as follows. A frozen teacher provides only a feature reference on a shared image-text pool; Tri-Affinity Distillation preserves image-image, text-text, and image-text geometry; and Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation aligns new experts with compatible prior experts so routing errors degrade gracefully. We design COMET to keep capacity and inference separate: a contextual bandit keeps or merges full per-task experts using post-training signals, while a reconstruction router selects sparse experts at test time without teacher semantics. On the X-TAIL benchmark, we show that each proposed component improves continual learning performance. COMET shows that continual vision-language adaptation can preserve multimodal geometry, coordinate accumulated experts, and allocate capacity jointly when feature reference, expert shaping, routing, and capacity control are separated by construction.

    ENGLISH

    Open-ended tool agents can complete the same objective through different tool paths, and their quality depends jointly on the interaction trace, environment state, and final artifacts, so such tasks rarely admit an executable ground-truth reward. The central challenge is therefore to construct a reward from existing experience that exposes the current policy's failures while remaining stationary during optimization. We introduce Reward Engine, which, like a self-motivated student, first works out what success requires and then optimizes toward it. From the task and initial trajectories, it builds a RewardPack of testcases for required correctness and rubrics for graded quality, each executed as a check that returns a judgment with evidence. The frozen RewardPack then guides the agent to revise and select its outputs, and can also serve as a reward for reinforcement learning. On WorkBuddy Bench Office and Claw-Eval, the constructed reward largely agrees with the benchmark graders, not reversing their ordering on 82.3\% and 80.5\% of candidate pairs. Used to revise executions, it raises three-run consistency ($\mathrm{Pass}^{3}$) over Baseline from 45.0\% to 54.0\% and from 78.4\% to 83.7\%.

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent memory to support long-term reasoning and personalized interactions. However, information collected from external sources can introduce security risks when untrusted claims (i.e., atomic statements) are later treated as authorized preferences, policies, or permissions. Existing defenses typically rely on content-based filtering or coarse-grained provenance tracking, which either fail to prevent unauthorized memory use or block legitimate information, sacrificing memory utility. To address these limitations, we propose SAFE-Mem, a fine-grained memory governance framework that improves security while preserving legitimate memory use. First, SAFE-Mem annotates each claim with three governance labels (i.e., kind, authority, and scope) to capture its provenance and permitted use. Second, governance-aware retrieval matches query requirements with claim permissions to block unauthorized influence while retaining legitimate information. Third, a governance-enabled memory graph connects source sentences, claims, and entities to support provenance tracking and efficient retrieval. Across four LLM backbones on MPBench and LoCoMo, SAFE-Mem attains the lowest attack success among defenses that retain legitimate memory, at least 77% below the strongest of them, and the highest answer accuracy of all evaluated defenses, improving it by up to 15%. The code is available at https://github.com/LVenum/SAFE-Mem.

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体日益依赖持久记忆来支持长期推理和个性化交互。然而，当来自外部来源的信息中包含不可信主张（即原子陈述），并在之后被当作获授权的偏好、策略或许可时，就会引入安全风险。现有防御通常依赖基于内容的过滤或粗粒度来源追踪，这些方法要么无法阻止未经授权的记忆使用，要么会屏蔽合法信息，从而牺牲记忆效用。为解决这些局限，我们提出 SAFE-Mem，这是一种细粒度记忆治理框架，能够在保留合法记忆使用的同时提升安全性。首先，SAFE-Mem 为每项主张标注三个治理标签（即类别、权限和范围），以记录其来源和允许用途。其次，治理感知检索会将查询要求与主张权限相匹配，从而阻止未经授权的影响，同时保留合法信息。第三，治理增强型记忆图连接源句、主张和实体，以支持来源追踪和高效检索。在 MPBench 和 LoCoMo 上使用四种 LLM 骨干模型进行评估时，在能够保留合法记忆的防御方法中，SAFE-Mem 的攻击成功率最低，比其中表现最强的方法至少低 77%；在所有受评估防御方法中，它的答案准确率最高，最高提升 15%。代码见 https://github.com/LVenum/SAFE-Mem。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-context decoding in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by the memory and computation required to attend over an ever-growing Key-Value (KV) cache at each autoregressive step. Although token-level sparse attention reduces this burden by restricting computation to a small subset of relevant past tokens, its practical gains are often offset by repeatedly recomputing layer-wise sparse indices as the context grows. A common remedy is to share sparse indices across layers by computing them only at designated anchor layers, but such static reuse ignores the layer-wise evolution of attention patterns, causing the reused indices to progressively deviate from the layer-specific optima and incur substantial attention loss. By revisiting cross-layer sparsity from the perspective of attention dynamics, we find that inter-layer salient token shift is highly localized: although the exact top-$\kappa$ indices differ across layers, the core high-attention tokens remain stable, with changes concentrated near the expanded boundary of previously selected regions. Motivated by this, we propose Prism Attention, a proposal-refined sparse attention framework. It replaces rigid cross-layer index reuse with a coarse-to-fine strategy, preserving layer-wise adaptability while retaining the efficiency benefits of cross-layer sharing. Extensive experiments show that Prism Attention achieves state-of-the-art performance among mainstream sparse attention methods on both reasoning and long-context benchmarks, while attaining a $3.4\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup over FlashAttention at 128K context length.

To address these limitations, we present \method, a CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference system that adaptively assigns these missed experts to the CPU or GPU for efficient execution. By exploiting differences in expert token-loads, \method selectively transfers high-load experts to the GPU while executing low-load experts on the CPU. To minimize inference latency, \method adaptively adjusts expert assignments to balance the CPU computation path against the GPU transfer-and-computation path, allowing both execution paths to complete as early as possible.     On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback. We establish a theoretical basis for this approach by showing that, under ideal on-policy assumptions, broadcasting raw summed feedback to every response token yields an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the sequence-level reverse-KL objective. To support effective learning in practice, \method{} discounts later feedback that may become less reliable under distribution shift and uses same-prompt rollout groups to calibrate teacher guidance. It preserves relative response preferences while retaining a controlled fraction of the group mean, which we term collective teacher pressure. However, skill-induced probability shifts do not necessarily represent reward-aligned credit; especially after an erroneous action changes subsequent interaction states, skill-conditioned supervision may become mismatched with the current state. To address this mismatch, we propose \methodname{}, which routes two complementary hindsight skills according to trajectory outcomes and error boundaries: Positive skills capture successful workflows to reinforce successful trajectories and pre-error decisions, while Negative skills capture failure-specific corrections to target decisive errors.     ENGLISH

Across the seven open-weight models, the unweighted model-average harm rate after admitted harmful requests is 74.5%. To identify what governs this decision, we apply a factorial intervention to the input request. Within our generated construction, neutralizing the requested-operation component produces the largest admission contrast (19 pp). A linear direction estimated from this contrast influences held-out admission in four of seven models; effects on operation-neutralized requests in some models show that it is not an operation-specific mechanism. We then test whether written refusal is behaviorally and representationally coupled to the same decision. Written refusal accompanies 33.6% of admitted harmful calls. Plain-text refusal training reduces unsafe admission in models that retain benign tool use, showing that response-level safety training can transfer to the call decision. Together, these results establish a partial, model-dependent relation between written refusal and tool admission. They motivate direct evaluation and supervision of tool admission rather than treating text refusal as its proxy.

    ENGLISH

    Large reasoning models (LRMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities but remain vulnerable to unsafe outputs. While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for safety alignment, its group-relative optimization may provide insufficient safety-directed learning signals. In this paper, we identify two failure modes: advantage collapse, where homogeneous rollout groups yield vanishing advantages, and unsafe diversification, where unsafe behaviors persist and become increasingly diverse. Our theoretical analysis reveals that behavioral consistency weakens within-group safety contrasts, while entropy regularization can diversify unsafe responses when relative signals vanish. To address these challenges, we propose Beacon, comprising Safety Signal Recovery (SSR) and Safety-Utility Decoupled Alignment (SUDA). SSR combines advantage-guided trajectory filtering and safe reference supervision to recover effective safety learning signals, while SUDA employs category-aware rewards and benign-only KL anchoring to mitigate over-refusal without compromising safety. Experiments across four Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill variants and eight benchmarks show that our framework achieves the best average safety and reasoning performance, reducing average safety error by up to 32.83 percentage points while maintaining low over-refusal.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, enabling non-autoregressive text generation through parallel decoding. Existing dLLMs can be broadly categorized into two families: masked diffusion models (MDMs) and uniform diffusion models (UDMs) In this work, we theoretically show that MDMs are easier to optimize due to their mask-based transition schedule but have lower computational expressivity, whereas UDMs enable iterative state revision and greater expressivity but are substantially harder to train. This trade-off raises a natural question: can we obtain the expressivity of iterative revision without giving up the simple, easy-to-optimize transition schedule of MDMs? Motivated by this analysis, we propose Lookahead Editing (\ours{}), which augments masked diffusion decoding with a rewritable proposal state. At each decoding step, the model performs several lookahead updates to iteratively refine future predictions in this proposal state before committing tokens to the masked sequence. This design introduces a rewritable proposal that uses additional compute to improve expressivity while keeping the simple mask-based transition schedule of MDMs. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B to obtain LED-\texttt{7B} and LED-\texttt{8B}, respectively. Across eight benchmarks, LED SFT yields average gains of $+11.4$ and $+7.7$ points over standard MDM SFT. Moreover, using SFT alone, LED-\texttt{8B} outperforms LLaDA2.1-16B Q-mode, which is trained with continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning.

    扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）已成为自回归语言模型的一种有前景的替代方案，它们通过并行解码实现非自回归文本生成。现有的 dLLMs 大体可分为两类：掩码扩散模型（MDMs）和均匀扩散模型（UDMs）。在这项工作中，我们从理论上表明，由于采用基于掩码的转移调度，MDMs 更容易优化，但计算表达能力较低；而 UDMs 支持迭代状态修订，表达能力更强，却显著更难训练。这种权衡引出了一个自然的问题：我们能否在不放弃 MDMs 简单且易于优化的转移调度的情况下，获得迭代修订带来的表达能力？受这一分析启发，我们提出前瞻编辑（\ours{}），通过加入可重写的提议状态来增强掩码扩散解码。在每个解码步骤中，模型会执行多次前瞻更新，在将词元提交到掩码序列之前，迭代地细化该提议状态中的未来预测。这种设计引入了可重写提议，利用额外计算提升表达能力，同时保留 MDMs 简单的基于掩码的转移调度。我们对 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen3-8B 进行微调，分别得到 LED-\texttt{7B} 和 LED-\texttt{8B}。在八个基准测试中，LED SFT 相较于标准 MDM SFT 的平均提升为 $+11.4$ 和 $+7.7$ 个百分点。此外，仅使用 SFT，LED-\texttt{8B} 的表现优于 LLaDA2.1-16B Q-mode；后者经过持续预训练、监督微调和强化学习训练。

    Local proxies for memory-efficient training

    用于内存高效训练的局部代理

    Wu S. Zihan, Brian A. Yuan, Guillaume Bellec

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes local proxy networks that estimate backpropagation gradients to reduce transformer training memory, with theoretical bounds and empirical results. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to efficient model computation, while its discussion of internal gradients does not investigate learned representations or mechanisms.

    本文提出局部代理网络来估计反向传播梯度，从而降低 Transformer 训练的内存需求，并给出了理论界限和实证结果。这是对高效模型计算的一项重要算法贡献；尽管讨论了内部梯度，但没有研究学得的表征或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Local learning algorithms can reshape resource requirements of artificial intelligence. The memory bottleneck of standard end-to-end backpropagation lies in the need to store all network activations until the loss gradient has been propagated back through. Local learning avoids this, but typically at a cost in accuracy. We study how to achieve accurate and memory efficient local learning in transformers. For each transformer block, we train a local proxy network to predict the global network output via distillation. Gradients can be independently propagated through this local proxy while estimating well the backpropagation gradients. In theory, this approach is exact for deep linear networks; in non-linear residual models, the gradient error can be bounded when using the appropriate residual proxy. We verify this numerically and demonstrate that optimizing the distillation loss improves gradient estimation. Evaluating the performance of proxy propagation on CIFAR-100 in vision transformers, we find that it achieves a better accuracy/memory trade-off compared to other local algorithms. Finally, we show that the method is further relevant for fine-tuning large language models on a small memory budget. Our method trains faster and achieves higher performance than memory-efficient zeroth-order learning algorithms with comparable memory cost.

    中文

    局部学习算法可以重塑人工智能的资源需求。标准端到端反向传播的内存瓶颈在于，必须存储所有网络激活，直到损失梯度反向传播完毕。局部学习避免了这一点，但通常要以准确率为代价。我们研究如何在 Transformer 中实现准确且内存高效的局部学习。对于每个 Transformer 块，我们训练一个局部代理网络，通过蒸馏来预测全局网络输出。梯度可以通过该局部代理独立传播，同时仍能较好地估计反向传播梯度。从理论上说，这种方法对于深层线性网络是精确的；对于非线性残差模型，使用适当的残差代理时，梯度误差可以被界定。我们通过数值实验验证了这一点，并证明优化蒸馏损失能够改善梯度估计。在视觉 Transformer 的 CIFAR-100 上评估代理传播性能时，我们发现与其他局部算法相比，它实现了更好的准确率与内存权衡。最后，我们表明，该方法也适用于在较小内存预算下微调大型语言模型。与内存高效的零阶学习算法相比，在内存成本相当的情况下，我们的方法训练更快且性能更高。

    Grounded Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Search Agents

    多轮搜索智能体强化学习中的扎根式信用分配

    Qirui Liu, Hao Chen, Yi Wen, Weijie Shi, Yao Zhao, Xianhe Chen, Hao Zhao, Xing Tang, Weihong Luo, Yuyu Luo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Grounded Credit Assignment separates evidence-retrieval and answer-correctness credit in reinforcement learning, improving grounded multi-turn search-agent performance. Its main contribution advances training and credit assignment for reasoning; search-agent use is relevant to Systems, but the abstract gives no broader agent architecture or memory contribution.

    扎根式信用分配在强化学习中分离证据检索与答案正确性的信用，从而提升多轮搜索智能体的扎根式表现。其主要贡献推动了推理训练和信用分配的发展；搜索智能体的应用与系统领域相关，但摘要没有提出更广泛的智能体架构或记忆贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Outcome-reward reinforcement learning such as GRPO gives every token of a search-agent rollout the same advantage, although the rollout exercises two capabilities: finding evidence and using it. We show that accuracy improves without grounding: Search-R1 raises accuracy on all seven QA benchmarks, yet on Bamboogle the evidence-supported share of correct answers falls from 84.0% to 42.9%. We attribute this to GRPO's credit assignment: rollouts that retrieve answer-bearing evidence are favoured in aggregate only in proportion to their accuracy gain over the rest, a grounding gap that answering from memory or misusing evidence shrinks or reverses. To address this, we propose Grounded Credit Assignment (GCA), which uses verifiable sub-outcomes (evidence retrieval and answer correctness) to correct search and answer credit separately: a wrong answer is blamed more than the search that found the evidence, and a correct answer that bypasses retrievable evidence is credited less. Never negative on evidence-finding search, the correction does not shrink with the grounding gap; capped at 10% of each token's advantage, it never overrides the outcome signal. Without extra models, rollouts, or training stages, GCA improves average EM over Search-R1 by 5.7 (Qwen2.5-3B) and 6.3 points (Qwen3-30B-A3B) and raises this share from 76.9% to 93.4%.

    中文

    像 GRPO 这样的结果奖励强化学习会给搜索智能体 rollout 中的每个词元相同的优势，尽管该 rollout 涉及两种能力：寻找证据和使用证据。我们表明，准确率可以在缺乏扎根依据的情况下提升：Search-R1 在全部七个 QA 基准上提高了准确率，但在 Bamboogle 上，正确答案中有证据支持的比例从 84.0% 降至 42.9%。我们将此归因于 GRPO 的信用分配方式：检索到包含答案的证据的 rollout，只会按其相对于其他 rollout 的准确率增益在总体上获得偏好；从记忆作答或误用证据会缩小甚至逆转这一扎根差距。为此，我们提出扎根式信用分配（GCA），利用可验证的子结果（证据检索和答案正确性）分别校正搜索与作答的信用：错误答案受到的归责高于找到证据的搜索过程，而绕过可检索证据给出正确答案时，所得信用会减少。对于寻找证据的搜索，这一校正绝不会为负，也不会随着扎根差距缩小；该校正上限为每个词元优势的 10%，因此绝不会覆盖结果信号。无需额外模型、rollout 或训练阶段，GCA 相较于 Search-R1 将平均 EM 提高了 5.7（Qwen2.5-3B）和 6.3 个百分点（Qwen3-30B-A3B），并将这一比例从 76.9% 提高到 93.4%。

    CIIR - Class-Indexed Interface Representation Learning

    CIIR——类索引接口表征学习

    Doo Yon Kim, Christian Wallraven

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CIIR provides a modular address space for transferring representations across unpaired datasets, including arithmetic and hierarchical codes, offering substantial insight into reusable composition and cross-dataset generalization. Its learned representations are not analyzed mechanistically, and modular communication alone offers only a partial systems contribution.

    CIIR 为跨未配对数据集迁移表征提供模块化地址空间，其中包括算术编码和分层编码，为可复用组合与跨数据集泛化提供了重要见解。本文没有从机制层面分析学得的表征，而模块化通信本身与系统领域的联系有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal learning commonly assumes paired or synchronized observations, yet independently collected datasets rarely provide such correspondence. We introduce CIIR, a modular encoder--decoder framework that connects heterogeneous datasets through a class-indexed address space while preserving each dataset's native input format and output module. A known local index selects address $k$, and an input-dependent 128-dimensional address representation Z_k(x) is written to that address. To demonstrate CIIR, we learn this address space from handwritten digits, clothing images, spoken-digit spectrograms, and hand signs without synchronized or instance-matched samples. Newly trained label-free receivers recover the requested addresses with 94.7% macro-average Address Realization Accuracy. We then attach the unseen SVHN dataset after freezing the base address space and train only lightweight adapters, achieving 90.2% MNIST>SVHN and 82.3% SVHN>MNIST end-to-end Address Transfer Accuracy without target-side decoder labels. To demonstrate generalizability of CIIR, we reuse the ten addresses as code elements in collision-free arithmetic and hierarchical address codes for all 100 CIFAR-100 classes and evaluate direct arithmetic-code realization through the existing receivers. These results establish CIIR as a compact interface for modular cross-dataset communication and post-hoc dataset attachment without exhaustive paired multimodal supervision.

    中文

    多模态学习通常假设观测数据成对或同步采集，但独立收集的数据集很少具备这种对应关系。我们提出 CIIR，这是一种模块化编码器—解码器框架，通过类索引地址空间连接异构数据集，同时保留每个数据集原生的输入格式和输出模块。已知的局部索引选择地址 $k$，并将依赖输入的 128 维地址表征 Z_k(x) 写入该地址。为了展示 CIIR 的效果，我们使用手写数字、服装图像、口述数字的频谱图和手势数据学习这一地址空间，过程中无需同步或实例匹配的样本。新训练的无标签接收器以 94.7% 的宏平均地址实现准确率恢复所请求的地址。随后，我们在冻结基础地址空间后接入未见过的 SVHN 数据集，仅训练轻量级适配器；在没有目标侧解码器标签的情况下，端到端地址迁移准确率达到 MNIST>SVHN 的 90.2% 和 SVHN>MNIST 的 82.3%。为了展示 CIIR 的泛化能力，我们将这十个地址作为编码元素，用于无碰撞算术编码和涵盖全部 100 个 CIFAR-100 类别的分层地址编码，并通过现有接收器评估直接算术码实现效果。这些结果表明，CIIR 是一种紧凑接口，可用于模块化跨数据集通信以及事后接入数据集，无需穷举式成对多模态监督。

    Algorithm Modelization: Transforming Optimization Algorithms into Evolvable Intelligence

    算法模型化：将优化算法转化为可演化的智能

    Jian Yao, Zhiyao Zhang, Yichen Li, Xingyu Wu, and Kay Chen Tan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper turns iterative optimization into a trainable autoregressive model that learns from algorithm trajectories and optimization feedback, then generalizes across problems and larger dimensions. This substantially advances learned problem-solving algorithms, with partial relevance to composition through population interactions and iterative dynamics; the abstract does not describe internal interpretability or agent system design.

    本文将迭代优化转化为可训练的自回归模型，使其从算法轨迹和优化反馈中学习，并泛化到不同问题和更高维度。它显著推动了学习式问题求解算法的发展；种群交互和迭代动态与组合性部分相关，但摘要没有描述内部可解释性或智能体系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Can algorithms be learned and evolved as models, rather than repeatedly redesigned as programs? We explore this question by introducing Algorithm Modelization, a new paradigm that turns iterative algorithms into trainable models. Its central idea is to regard algorithm execution trajectories as computational experience: by learning how algorithmic states evolve over iterations, a model can internalize the knowledge embodied in existing algorithms, reproduce their computational behaviors, and further evolve beyond them through training. As a first realization of this paradigm, we modelize iterative optimization as an autoregressive process, where preceding generations constitute the computational context for generating the next population. We develop a dimension-independent population-temporal architecture to capture both population interactions and iterative dynamics, together with an imitation-to-surpassing learning framework that first acquires algorithmic knowledge from heterogeneous teachers and then improves the resulting optimizer directly through optimization feedback. The modelized optimizer consequently goes beyond reproducing individual algorithms: it consolidates heterogeneous search knowledge into a single trainable model, achieves stronger optimization capability through subsequent improvement, and generalizes its acquired knowledge across problems and substantially larger unseen dimensions. More fundamentally, Algorithm Modelization makes algorithmic capability accumulable through learning, where new algorithms and problem-solving experience can become training resources for progressively improving the model. Our results establish a promising path from manually designed algorithms toward general algorithm models that learn, generalize, and evolve from computational experience.

    中文

    能否将算法作为模型来学习和演化，而不必反复将其重新设计为程序？我们通过提出算法模型化这一新范式来探索这个问题，它将迭代算法转变为可训练模型。其核心思想是将算法执行轨迹视为计算经验：通过学习算法状态如何随迭代演化，模型能够内化现有算法蕴含的知识，复现其计算行为，并通过训练进一步超越这些算法。作为这一范式的初步实现，我们将迭代优化模型化为自回归过程，其中前几代构成生成下一代种群的计算上下文。我们开发了一种与维度无关的种群—时间架构，用于捕捉种群交互和迭代动态；并提出一种从模仿到超越的学习框架，先从异构教师中获取算法知识，再通过优化反馈直接改进所得优化器。因此，模型化优化器不再局限于复现单个算法：它将异构搜索知识整合进一个可训练模型，通过后续改进获得更强的优化能力，并将习得的知识泛化到不同问题以及维度大得多的未见问题上。更根本地说，算法模型化使算法能力能够通过学习不断积累，新算法和问题求解经验都可以成为训练资源，以逐步改进模型。我们的结果为从人工设计算法迈向能够从计算经验中学习、泛化和演化的通用算法模型，确立了一条有前景的路径。

    ENGLISH

    Modern chess engines play far beyond human ability, often choosing moves whose underlying ideas are difficult for humans to understand. We propose an automatic metric for evaluating chess explanations, grounded in chess-engine evaluations. Evaluating state-of-the-art language models using this metric, we find that they perform surprisingly poorly, often relying on surface-level board observations rather than robust, transferable chess concepts. We then introduce BinProp, a training-free method that enables these same models to discover reusable chess concepts and use them to explain moves in natural language. BinProp improves explainability for every model tested, nearly tripling the average score compared with direct prompting. Beyond chess, the same method discovers useful concepts in Go, draughts, and shogi without additional tuning.

    Ziyang Chen, Junlong Jia, Xing Wu, Tinghao Yu, and Songlin Hu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LongForge measures and controls evidence, assertion, and reasoning structure in long-context training data, and shows that increasing breadth and depth improves benchmark performance, making a substantial contribution to structured data composition. Its reasoning graphs concern data organization rather than model reasoning mechanisms, while auditing and mixture control do not amount to a model or agent systems contribution.

    LongForge 测量并控制长上下文训练数据中的证据、断言和推理结构，并表明提高广度和深度能够改善基准表现，对结构化数据组合做出了重要贡献。其推理图描述的是数据组织，而非模型推理机制；审计和混合策略控制也不构成模型或智能体系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Existing quality control for long-context instruction-tuning data is a one-shot judgment inside the generation pipeline that leaves only a scalar, revealing neither which document parts an answer uses nor how many reasoning steps it writes down; the data can thus be neither audited nor controlled. We formalize data quality as a property of the alignment structure among document, question, and answer, and build LongForge, which pairs an analyzer that measures long-context data with a synthesizer that generates it. The analyzer reverse-reconstructs each sample into an evidence-assertion reasoning graph and programmatically computes four dimensions on it: breadth, depth, correctness, and completeness. Every reading traces back to specific evidence spans and reasoning steps, making data auditable. Measuring seven mainstream datasets reveals two previously unquantified defects: breadth barely grows with document length, and depth is generally low, the two being nearly orthogonal. The synthesizer then embeds the analyzer into generation, gating on correctness and completeness and deferring breadth and depth to a training-time mixture over measured values, which makes the training distribution controllable. On two backbones, its two mixtures, LongForge-1 and LongForge-N, outperform the strongest baseline by 2.2-4.7 points on average over six long-context benchmarks, and in a controlled comparison that holds the gate and the candidate pool fixed, raising breadth and depth alone is worth a further 1.16 points, making the structural distribution of training data a lever on downstream quality rather than only a description of it.

    中文

    现有长上下文指令微调数据的质量控制，是生成流程中的一次性判断，最终只留下一个标量；它既不揭示答案使用了文档中的哪些部分，也不显示答案写出了多少推理步骤，因此数据既无法审计，也无法控制。我们将数据质量形式化为文档、问题和答案之间对齐结构的属性，并构建 LongForge，将测量长上下文数据的分析器与生成数据的合成器配对。分析器将每个样本反向重构为证据—断言推理图，并以程序化方式计算其中的四个维度：广度、深度、正确性和完整性。每项解读都可追溯到具体证据片段和推理步骤，从而使数据可审计。对七个主流数据集的测量揭示了两个此前未量化的缺陷：广度几乎不随文档长度增长，深度普遍较低；两者近乎正交。随后，合成器将分析器嵌入生成流程，以正确性和完整性作为门控条件，并将广度和深度交由基于测量值的训练时混合策略处理，从而使训练分布可控。在两个主干模型上，LongForge-1 和 LongForge-N 这两种混合策略在六个长上下文基准上的平均表现比最强基线高 2.2–4.7 个百分点；在固定门控条件和候选池的受控比较中，仅提高广度和深度就能再提升 1.16 个百分点。这表明训练数据的结构分布可以成为影响下游质量的杠杆，而不只是对下游质量的描述。

    TreeOPSD develops critic-free credit assignment and bounded posterior self-distillation for long-horizon agent reinforcement learning, with benchmark gains. Its main contribution advances training for agentic problem-solving and agent systems, while tree structure is only a limited connection to compositional generalization and does not study internal mechanisms.

    TreeOPSD 为长时程智能体强化学习开发了无需评论家的信用分配和有界后验自蒸馏方法，并取得了基准测试收益。其主要贡献是推进面向智能体问题求解和智能体系统的训练；树结构与组合泛化仅有有限关联，且该工作没有研究内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models. However, training agents over long-horizon interactions presents two challenges: using only terminal rewards makes turn-level credit assignment sparse and high-variance, while sequential mini-batch updates on a fixed rollout batch introduce policy staleness as the current policy drifts from the behavior policy. Existing approaches obtain denser credit via learned critics, process reward models, or on-policy distillation, but they rely on a value network, step-level annotations, or a stronger external teacher that increase training complexity. Meanwhile, importance sampling and clipping mitigate policy drift, but they do not specify a finite target that stops sequential updates from overshooting. In this work, we introduce TreeOPSD, a critic-free, tree-aware posterior self-distillation framework for long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning. Treating each interaction turn as a tree node, TreeOPSD branches alternative continuations from shared prefixes and recursively backs up terminal rewards into implicit turn-level credit. It then maps each credit to a closed-form, bounded teacher distribution parameterized by the likelihood ratio relative to the frozen behavior policy. Minimizing the divergence between this teacher and the student policy recovers the policy-gradient direction as the tangent at the behavior policy while bounding updates toward a finite target across sequential mini-batches. Empirically, TreeOPSD improves agentic capabilities across several competitive benchmarks and model scales, especially for long-horizon tasks, e.g., raising the average accuracy of Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 by 4.97 points over GRPO on the Deep Research setting.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习已成为大型语言模型的一种可扩展后训练范式。然而，在长时程交互中训练智能体面临两个挑战：仅使用终端奖励会使回合级信用分配稀疏且具有高方差，而在固定 rollout 批次上进行顺序小批量更新，则会在当前策略偏离行为策略时引入策略陈旧问题。现有方法通过学习型评论家、过程奖励模型或同策略蒸馏来获得更密集的信用信号，但它们依赖价值网络、步骤级标注或更强的外部教师，从而增加了训练复杂度。与此同时，重要性采样和裁剪可以缓解策略漂移，却没有指定一个有限目标来阻止顺序更新过度偏移。在本文中，我们提出 TreeOPSD，这是一种面向长时程智能体强化学习、无需评论家且具备树结构感知能力的后验自蒸馏框架。TreeOPSD 将每个交互回合视为树节点，从共享前缀分叉出不同的后续路径，并递归地将终端奖励反向传播为隐式的回合级信用。随后，它将每个信用映射为一个闭式、有界的教师分布，该分布由相对于冻结行为策略的似然比参数化。最小化该教师与学生策略之间的散度，可在行为策略处以切线形式恢复策略梯度方向，同时将跨顺序小批量的更新限制在一个有限目标范围内。实证结果表明，TreeOPSD 在多个有竞争力的基准和模型规模上提升了智能体能力，尤其是在长时程任务上；例如，在 Deep Research 设置中，Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 的平均准确率比 GRPO 提高了 4.97 个百分点。
