    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MoEvolve uses activation-expanded expert capacity for bidirectional on-policy distillation, improving reasoning-task performance while returning capabilities to the original low-activation-budget model. This substantially advances training for reasoning and conditional computation, but the abstract does not analyze internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    MoEvolve 利用激活扩展后的专家容量进行同策略双向蒸馏，提升推理任务表现，同时将能力迁回原始的低激活预算模型。这实质性地推进了推理训练和条件计算，但摘要没有分析内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, but its outcome-level rewards provide only sparse supervision. On-Policy Distillation offers dense token-level feedback, yet requires a stronger compatible teacher, while on-policy self-distillation relies on hand-designed privileged information. We observe that the MoE architecture itself offers a way to resolve this dilemma, as increasing the activation budget per token exposes latent expert capacity and yields a potentially stronger teacher within the model. However, naive expansion degrades performance because newly co-activated experts are not optimized to work together. We therefore propose MoEvolve, a bidirectional distillation framework following a recovery-then-improvement strategy: we first restore the activation-expanded high-$k$ model and further strengthen it by exploiting its additional active capacity, then reverse the direction of distillation to transfer the enhanced capabilities back into the original low-$k$ configuration, retaining its inference-time activation budget. Across diverse MoE models and benchmarks, MoEvolve improves the initial models by up to $22.2$ domain-average points and outperforms same-budget RLVR baselines by up to $6.5$ points. Notably, the final low-$k$ models often surpass their activation-expanded teachers.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了混合专家（MoE）LLM，但其结果级奖励提供的监督较为稀疏。同策略蒸馏可提供密集的 token 级反馈，却需要一个更强且兼容的教师；而同策略自蒸馏则依赖人工设计的特权信息。我们观察到，MoE 架构本身提供了一种化解这一困境的途径：提高每个 token 的激活预算可以显露潜在的专家能力，从而在模型内部形成一个可能更强的教师。然而，朴素扩展会降低性能，因为新近共同激活的专家尚未经过协同工作的优化。因此，我们提出 MoEvolve，这是一种遵循“先恢复、后改进”策略的双向蒸馏框架：我们首先恢复激活扩展后的高-$k$模型，并通过利用其额外的活跃容量进一步增强它；随后反转蒸馏方向，将增强后的能力迁移回原始的低-$k$配置，同时保留其推理时激活预算。在多种 MoE 模型和基准测试中，MoEvolve 使初始模型的领域平均分最高提升了 $22.2$ 个百分点，并且比相同预算的 RLVR 基线最高提升了 $6.5$ 个百分点。值得注意的是，最终的低-$k$模型往往超过其激活扩展后的教师。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents increasingly use files and software tools to produce professional deliverables. Such work draws on materials, decisions, and feedback accumulated across assignments. We introduce OfficeTown, a generative simulation framework for professional organizations in which tasks and their context arise from continuing organizational work. From a natural-language description of an organization's purpose and activities, OfficeTown initializes an organization whose members coordinate work, delegate bounded assignments to assistant agents, and review their deliverables. Artifacts, decisions, and unresolved matters persist and shape subsequent work, while responsibilities and permissions determine what each member can see and do. We curate work requests, their context, and review feedback into executable resources for evaluation and learning. We construct OfficeTown Bench with 406 tasks and 4,836 evaluation criteria from 23 simulated organizations across eight professional domains, incorporating domain-expert feedback. Frontier-model evaluations reveal substantial remaining headroom. Supervised fine-tuning and on-policy distillation on OfficeTown data substantially improve Qwen3.5-9B on external professional-work benchmarks, including GDPval. Supplementary evaluations show that the principal--assistant harness achieves higher scores than the single- and multi-agent baselines tested. These results highlight the value of organizational simulation in generating work-grounded data and environments for the continued development of generalist agents.

    AI 智能体越来越多地使用文件和软件工具来制作专业交付成果。这类工作会用到在不同任务中积累的材料、决策和反馈。我们提出 OfficeTown，这是一种面向专业组织的生成式模拟框架，其中任务及其上下文源自持续进行的组织工作。根据对组织宗旨和活动的自然语言描述，OfficeTown 初始化一个组织，其成员协调工作、将范围明确的任务委派给助理智能体，并审查其交付成果。各类产物、决策和未解决事项会持续保留并影响后续工作，而职责和权限则决定每个成员可以看到和执行的内容。我们将工作请求、相关上下文和审查反馈整理为可执行资源，用于评估和学习。我们构建了 OfficeTown Bench，其中包含来自 8 个专业领域、23 个模拟组织的 406 项任务和 4,836 项评估标准，并纳入了领域专家的反馈。对前沿模型的评估显示，其性能仍有很大提升空间。使用 OfficeTown 数据进行监督微调和同策略蒸馏，大幅提升了 Qwen3.5-9B 在包括 GDPval 在内的外部专业工作基准上的表现。补充评估表明，主从式智能体框架取得的分数高于所测试的单智能体和多智能体基线。这些结果凸显了组织模拟在生成扎根于实际工作的数据和环境方面的价值，可用于持续发展通用型智能体。

    Process Reward Modeling with Reliability- and Conservatism-Aware Bayesian Belief

    结合可靠性与保守性的贝叶斯信念过程奖励建模

    Zhongjian Qiao, Zhixiang Zhou, Jiafei Lyu, Peisong Wang, Qiaosheng Zhang, Siyang Gao, Shuang Qiu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BayesianPRM models uncertainty in process rewards and calibrates them to improve LLM test-time scaling, a substantial algorithmic contribution to reasoning evaluation and improvement. Its Bayesian beliefs concern reward estimates, not internal model representations or system architecture.

    BayesianPRM 对过程奖励中的不确定性进行建模并加以校准，以改进 LLM 的测试时扩展，是对推理评估和改进的一项重要算法贡献。其贝叶斯信念针对奖励估计，而非模型内部表征或系统架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Process Reward Models (PRMs) play a central role in test-time scaling for large language model (LLM) reasoning. However, PRMs may provide inaccurate process rewards for test-time scaling, which we identify as arising from two sources of uncertainty: (1) \textit{PRM uncertainty} that arises from insufficient supervision data and imperfect PRM training; and (2) \textit{policy uncertainty} that results from the mismatch between the policy to collect supervision data and the policy for test-time scaling, leading to systematic reward overestimation. Previous studies fail to jointly consider both uncertainties. To bridge this gap, we propose BayesianPRM, which treats the process reward as a random variable within a reward hypothesis space and maintains a Bayesian belief over it. Since exact Bayesian inference over the continuous hypothesis space is generally intractable, we discretize the reward hypothesis space with a reward ensemble and introduce two complementary belief updates, each targeting one source of uncertainty: (1) to address PRM uncertainty, we introduce \textit{reliability-aware belief updating} that measures how well each ensemble member explains the supervision data and updates the belief with an amortized belief network optimized by the evidence lower bound (ELBO); and (2) to tackle policy uncertainty, we propose \textit{conservatism-aware belief calibration} which further reweights the belief toward lower rewards to suppress overestimation. These two updates yield a reliability- and conservatism-aware Bayesian belief, whose expectation determines the process reward. Experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks indicate that BayesianPRM consistently yields more accurate process reward estimates while enhancing test-time scaling performance.

    中文

    过程奖励模型（PRM）在大型语言模型（LLM）推理的测试时扩展中发挥着核心作用。然而，PRM 可能会为测试时扩展提供不准确的过程奖励；我们将其归因于两个不确定性来源：（1）\textit{PRM 不确定性}，源自监督数据不足和 PRM 训练不完善；（2）\textit{策略不确定性}，源自用于收集监督数据的策略与用于测试时扩展的策略之间不匹配，导致奖励被系统性高估。以往研究未能同时考虑这两种不确定性。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 BayesianPRM，它将过程奖励视为奖励假设空间中的随机变量，并对其维持贝叶斯信念。由于在连续假设空间上进行精确贝叶斯推断通常难以处理，我们利用奖励集成对奖励假设空间进行离散化，并引入两种互补的信念更新方式，分别针对一个不确定性来源：（1）为处理 PRM 不确定性，我们提出\textit{可靠性感知信念更新}，用于衡量集成中每个成员对监督数据的解释程度，并使用通过证据下界（ELBO）优化的摊销信念网络更新信念；（2）为处理策略不确定性，我们提出\textit{保守性感知信念校准}，进一步将信念向较低奖励重新加权，以抑制高估。这两种更新产生兼顾可靠性和保守性的贝叶斯信念，其期望值决定过程奖励。多模态推理基准上的实验表明，BayesianPRM 能够持续提供更准确的过程奖励估计，同时提升测试时扩展性能。

    ENGLISH

    Drifting Models generate a sample with a single function evaluation, making them attractive for fast parallel language generation, but their one-step formulation does not support iterative refinement. We propose Recurrent Language Generation via Drifting (ReLaDrift), which uses a shared Drifting Model to generate an initial draft from noise and iteratively refine it in a continuous latent space. We train this recurrence by sampling the number of rounds and applying the drifting loss only at the final round, stopping gradients through preceding rounds so that only one round requires backpropagation. Unlike the one-step Drifting Model, whose accuracy does not improve when iterated, ReLaDrift enables a trade-off between test-time computation and generation quality, as diffusion and flow language models do. On Sudoku Hard and GSM8K, it achieves competitive or superior performance compared with these iterative-generation approaches across a range of inference budgets. We present MultiAgent-OPD, which combines on-policy distillation with reinforcement learning to jointly train a shared-parameter Leader-Searcher-Answerer team end to end. We first train a Teacher in a Searcher-Answerer workflow using answer correctness. During team training, the frozen Teacher scores student-generated search and summary tokens to provide local process supervision for the Searchers, while the Leader learns from team success and the Answerer from candidate correctness. Across seven datasets, the trained system reaches 38.68% macro avg@4, exceeding Prompted Critic by 4.06 percentage points and C-MAS + RL, the trained cascaded multiagent system, by 2.61 percentage points.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RIVET uses response-informed training signals to improve pre-call model routing across multi-turn interactions, and the abstract reports reduced estimation error and lower call costs. This is a strong contribution to adaptive model routing, while task success is an evaluation target rather than a substantive study of reasoning, and no internal representations or compositional generalization are addressed.

    RIVET 利用响应信息训练信号，改进多轮交互中的调用前模型路由；摘要报告了估计误差降低和调用成本下降。这是对自适应模型路由的有力贡献；任务成功是评估目标，而非对推理的实质性研究，且文中没有涉及内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-turn LLM routing selects a model at every turn before its response is available, yet task success is revealed only when the interaction ends, leaving each intermediate choice without a label of its own. Logged trajectories, however, retain the response each call produced, which exposes what each turn required and how well the chosen model served it, evidence that outcomes alone hide. We introduce RIVET (Response-Informed Value Estimation for Turn-Level Routing), which exploits this post-call evidence during training while keeping routing strictly pre-call at deployment. RIVET jointly trains two value estimators over a shared state-model representation: a deployable Routing Value Estimator that scores candidate models from pre-call information, and a training-only Response-Informed Value Estimator that additionally observes the realized response. Conditioning on the response turns response-induced return variation from residual noise into an observed covariate, and we show that this reduces the leading asymptotic estimation error of the shared representation. On the MINT benchmark, RIVET solves more held-out tasks than the strongest multi-turn baseline while using 74.7% less total call cost.

    多轮 LLM 路由必须在每轮响应尚不可用时选择模型，但任务成功与否只有在交互结束时才会揭晓，因此每个中间选择都没有自己的标签。然而，记录下来的轨迹保留了每次调用产生的响应，因而揭示了每一轮的需求，以及所选模型满足需求的程度；这些证据仅凭最终结果是看不到的。我们提出 RIVET（用于轮级路由的响应信息价值估计），在训练期间利用这些调用后证据，同时确保部署时严格在调用前进行路由。RIVET 在共享的状态-模型表征上联合训练两个价值估计器：一个可部署的路由价值估计器，根据调用前信息对候选模型打分；另一个仅用于训练的响应信息价值估计器，还会观察实际产生的响应。以响应作为条件后，响应引起的回报变化便从残差噪声转为可观测协变量；我们证明，这会降低共享表征的主要渐近估计误差。在 MINT 基准上，RIVET 解决的留出任务数超过最强的多轮基线，同时总调用成本降低了 74.7%。

We introduce MGE-PO, centered on four-quadrant (4Q) advantage shaping that combines verified correctness with rollout generation entropy. Correctness determines the sign of an additional correction, while entropy controls its magnitude: lower-entropy successes receive larger bonuses and higher-entropy failures receive larger penalties. An online entropy-based question curriculum supports this credit rule using cached rollout measurements. At the final checkpoint after eight training epochs on Qwen3-8B-Base, adding 4Q across three policy optimization settings yields absolute gains of 3.23-3.69% in six-benchmark macro avg@32 and 4.24-11.06% in macro pass@32.     Think More or Read More? A Token-Budget Theory of Reasoning with Shared Context

    多思考还是多阅读？共享上下文下推理的 token 预算理论

    Manh Nguyen, Sunil Gupta, Hung Le

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes how reading and communication compete with reasoning under a fixed token window, deriving and validating an optimal debate group size and analyzing self-refinement. This advances both reasoning-budget analysis and agent communication design, while offering no insight into internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文形式化了固定 token 窗口下阅读和通信如何与推理争夺资源，推导并验证了最优辩论群体规模，并分析了自我改进。这推进了推理预算分析和智能体通信设计，但没有探究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning systems increasingly improve answers by incorporating additional context into the model's input, from multi-agent debate, where agents read their peers' responses, to self-refinement, where a model revisits its own drafts. In these systems, communication consumes context as one agent's output becomes another's input. We study the regime where token reading and generation draw on one fixed token window, so every token spent reading is a token that cannot be spent reasoning. We develop a \textbf{token-budget theory} that formalizes this trade-off, modeling accuracy as a function of the reasoning budget remaining after reading and aggregating votes with a Condorcet jury model that permits correlated errors. For multi-agent debate, the theory gives a closed-form prediction for the optimal number of agents. This quantity is estimated from single-agent measurements, allowing the optimal group size to be determined without running debate, and the same accounting extends to a heterogeneous set of different models. We empirically verify our theory and show that, at the predicted group size, our method outperforms strong baselines under the tightest calibration spend, where debate-calibrated rules can afford only one or two questions. Self-refinement obeys the same accounting, with its own draft in place of a peer message. The theory further predicts that communication pays only when the gain in the accuracy ceiling exceeds the reasoning room spent on reading, with this condition tightening as the window shrinks. Across five open models and four reasoning tasks, self-consistency matches or beats deployed debate at $93$\% of $980$ matched window-and-group-size settings, with the gap being largest under tight windows and nearly disappearing at a loose one, consistent with the theory. Under a shared window, how much room a model has left to \textit{think matters more than what it reads}.

    中文

    推理系统越来越多地通过向模型输入中加入额外上下文来改善答案，从多智能体辩论（智能体阅读同伴的回答）到自我改进（模型重新审视自己的草稿）皆是如此。在这些系统中，通信会消耗上下文，因为一个智能体的输出会成为另一个智能体的输入。我们研究 token 阅读与生成共用一个固定 token 窗口的情形，因此每花一个 token 阅读，就少一个 token 用于推理。我们提出一种\textbf{token预算理论}来形式化这种权衡：将准确率建模为阅读后剩余推理预算的函数，并用允许错误相关的 Condorcet 陪审团模型聚合投票。对于多智能体辩论，该理论给出了最优智能体数量的闭式预测。这个数量可根据单智能体测量结果估计，因此无需运行辩论即可确定最优群体规模；同样的核算方法也适用于由不同模型组成的异质集合。我们通过实证验证了该理论，并表明在预测的群体规模下，在校准开销最紧张的情况下，我们的方法优于强基线；此时经辩论校准的规则只能负担一两个问题。自我改进遵循相同的核算方式，只是用自己的草稿替代同伴消息。该理论还预测，只有当准确率上限的提升超过阅读所耗费的推理空间时，通信才有收益；窗口越小，这一条件越严格。在五个开放模型和四项推理任务中，在$93$% 的$980$窗口大小与群体规模匹配的设置下，自洽方法达到或超过已部署的辩论方法；差距在窗口较紧时最大，在窗口较宽时几乎消失，这与理论一致。在共享窗口下，模型还剩多少空间可\textit{思考，比它读到什么更重要}。

    Yibo Zhou, Yirong Xiang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces counterfactual pairing cycles to isolate relational role-binding errors from image-only, text-only, and additive shortcuts, with diagnostic and training uses. This provides a substantial evaluation and learning contribution for compositional relations, but does not investigate internal mechanisms or broader reasoning.

    本文提出反事实配对循环，以隔离关系角色绑定错误与纯图像、纯文本及加性捷径，并将其用于诊断和训练。这为组合关系提供了重要的评估与学习贡献，但没有研究内部机制或更广泛的推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Relational out-of-distribution errors are easy to describe and hard to evaluate cleanly. An image may be natural, a caption may be fluent, and all mentioned objects may be common, yet the caption may describe the wrong relation in the image. Many evaluations intended to test this behavior can be solved without checking the pairing at all, because negatives differ in caption style, template, length, object frequency, or image statistics. We propose counterfactual pairing cycles, a blocked evaluation primitive that reuses the same two images and the same two captions on both sides of the comparison, changing only which image is paired with which caption. This makes image-only, text-only, and additive component shortcuts cancel exactly in finite samples. The same contrast also gives a training loss for relational outlier exposure and a diagnostic for bilinear vision-language scores. Across synthetic controls, GQA, and COCO, cycles separate coarse image-caption matching from directional role-binding failures, while also identifying geometric size relations that remain strongly visible in global features. In a shortcut-contaminated COCO outlier-exposure stress test, a model selected by a near-perfect shortcut validation AUROC retains substantial relational signal but remains below cycle training on exact cycles; cycle training improves CycleAcc from 0.882 to 0.927. The main lesson is simple: to test whether a model understands a pairing, the benchmark should keep the parts fixed, change the pairing, and ask only about coupling. The official implementation is available online.

    中文

    关系型分布外错误很容易描述，却很难得到干净的评估。一张图像可能很自然，一段说明可能很流畅，提到的对象也都很常见，但说明描述的关系却可能与图像中的关系不符。许多旨在测试这种行为的评估无需检查配对就能通过，因为负例在说明风格、模板、长度、对象频率或图像统计特征上有所不同。我们提出反事实配对循环这一分块评估原语：比较两侧都复用相同的两张图像和相同的两段说明，只改变图像与说明的配对方式。这样，有限样本中的纯图像、纯文本和加性组件捷径会被精确抵消。同一种对比也可用于关系型异常暴露的训练损失，以及双线性视觉语言分数的诊断。在合成控制实验、GQA 和 COCO 上，循环能够区分粗粒度的图像说明匹配与方向性角色绑定失败，同时也能识别在全局特征中仍然显著可见的几何尺寸关系。在一个受捷径污染的 COCO 异常暴露压力测试中，由近乎完美的捷径验证 AUROC 选出的模型保留了大量关系信号，但在精确循环上仍不及循环训练；循环训练将 CycleAcc 从 0.882 提升至 0.927。核心教训很简单：若要测试模型是否理解配对，基准应固定部件、改变配对，并只询问二者的关联。官方实现已在线发布。

    Farhan Zarif, Kazi Shahid Ahmed Galib, Synthia Akter Promi, Shabnam Sharmin Tarin, Ariyan Hossain, Sadif Ahmed, Farig Yousuf Sadeque

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper audits how small tool-using agents respond to prompt injections and proposes reporting attack outcomes alongside task completion, with evidence that system prompts shift measured attack success. This is a substantial evaluation contribution for agent safety and behavior (Systems), while it does not investigate internal mechanisms, composition, or general reasoning capability.

    本文审查小型工具使用智能体对提示注入的响应，并提出应同时报告攻击结果和任务完成情况；证据表明，系统提示会改变测得的攻击成功率。这对智能体安全与行为（系统）评估作出了重要贡献，但没有探究内部机制、组合能力或一般推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-using agents read untrusted external content, which exposes them to indirect prompt injection (IPI), where hidden instructions hijack the agent's tool calls. Benchmarks measure IPI security by the attack success rate (ASR), which treats every failed attack as a successful defense. To test this assumption, we audit 33,000 trajectories from eleven open-weight agents (2-14B parameters) on InjecAgent and AgentDojo. A label-blind LLM judge shows that most failed attacks are ignored (76-80%) rather than refused (17-18%). With identical model weights, changing only the system prompt shifts InjecAgent ASR from 0.2% to 43%. Our Attack-Task Outcome Matrix (ATOM) further shows that in 21.7% of AgentDojo episodes, the agent stayed safe but did not complete the user's task. A low ASR therefore mostly reflects agents silently ignoring injections, not refusing them. Evaluations should report how attacks fail and whether the user's task is completed, alongside ASR. We release the labeled corpus, judge prompt, and analysis code.

    工具使用智能体会读取不可信的外部内容，因此容易受到间接提示注入（IPI）的影响；隐藏指令可能劫持智能体的工具调用。基准通过攻击成功率（ASR）衡量 IPI 安全性，并将每次攻击失败都视为成功防御。为检验这一假设，我们审查了 11 个开放权重智能体（参数量为 2–14B）在 InjecAgent 和 AgentDojo 上的 33,000 条轨迹。一个不知晓标签的 LLM 评审器表明，大多数失败的攻击被忽略（76–80%），而非被拒绝（17–18%）。在模型权重完全相同的情况下，仅改变系统提示就会使 InjecAgent 的 ASR 从 0.2% 变为 43%。我们的攻击—任务结果矩阵（ATOM）还显示，在 AgentDojo 的 21.7% 情节中，智能体虽然保持安全，却没有完成用户任务。因此，低 ASR 主要反映的是智能体悄然忽略注入，而非拒绝注入。评估除报告 ASR 外，还应说明攻击如何失败以及用户任务是否完成。我们发布了标注语料、评审器提示和分析代码。

    Sample, Mix, or Verify? Allocating Test-Time Compute under Imperfect Verifiers

    采样、混合还是验证？不完美验证器下的测试时计算分配

    Srinivasan Iyengar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SPLIT uses a fitted probability model to allocate sampling and verification compute under imperfect, correlated verifiers, with broad empirical evaluation across tasks and agents. This substantially advances inference-time compute allocation (Systems); its connection to reasoning is through selecting solutions on reasoning tasks, without a contribution to reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    SPLIT 使用拟合的概率模型，在验证器不完美且错误相关的情况下分配采样与验证计算，并在多种任务和智能体上进行了广泛的实证评估。这显著推进了推理时计算分配（系统）；它与推理的联系在于为推理任务选择答案，但没有对推理机制或组合泛化作出贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A common way to make language models and agents more accurate is to spend more compute at inference time: generate many candidate solutions and submit the one a verifier prefers. Success then requires that some candidate is correct and that the verifier picks it. The first grows predictably with the number of samples; the second does not, because real verifiers (unit tests, majority votes, LLM judges, reward models) accept wrong answers, reject right ones, and make correlated mistakes. With a fixed budget, a practitioner must decide how many samples to draw, which models to draw them from, and how much to spend on verification, and today these choices are made by rules of thumb. We introduce SPLIT, which makes them from a small labelled pilot. It rests on an exact formula for the probability of submitting a correct answer under accept/reject and top-score selection that accounts for varying task difficulty, blind spots shared across models, and correlated repeated verifier calls. SPLIT fits the formula by empirical Bayes and uses it to plan budgets on unseen tasks. Across seven benchmarks spanning math, science QA, code and software-engineering agents, 26 models, 175 agent systems and six kinds of real verifiers, all from public releases, SPLIT lands within 0.02-0.8 percentage points of the best allocation in hindsight, while every fixed rule we test loses at least 2.5 points in some setting. Regret depends only on how well SPLIT ranks configurations, and it stays near-optimal under compute, price and latency costs and online. The formula also explains when asking more LLM judges lowers precision. As a forecaster far beyond the pilot, SPLIT beats power-law fitting when the verifier caps success, and we report where it loses.

    中文

    提升语言模型和智能体准确率的一种常见方法是在推理时投入更多计算：生成多个候选解，再提交验证器最认可的那个。成功既要求至少有一个候选解正确，也要求验证器选中它。前者会随采样数量可预测地增长；后者则不会，因为真实验证器（单元测试、多数投票、LLM 评审器、奖励模型）会接受错误答案、拒绝正确答案，并产生相关错误。在预算固定时，实践者必须决定采样多少次、使用哪些模型采样，以及投入多少计算进行验证；如今这些选择通常依靠经验法则。我们提出 SPLIT，利用少量带标签的试点数据作出这些选择。它基于一个精确公式，用于计算在接受/拒绝选择和最高分选择下提交正确答案的概率，并考虑任务难度差异、模型间共享的盲点以及重复调用验证器时的相关性。SPLIT 用经验贝叶斯方法拟合该公式，并据此为未见任务规划预算。在涵盖数学、科学问答、代码和软件工程智能体的七个基准中，涉及 26 个模型、175 个智能体系统和六类真实验证器（均来自公开发布），SPLIT 的结果距离事后最佳分配仅差 0.02–0.8 个百分点，而我们测试的每一种固定规则在某些设置下至少损失 2.5 个百分点。后悔值只取决于 SPLIT 对配置的排序效果；在计算、价格和延迟成本下以及在线场景中，它都接近最优。该公式还解释了何时增加 LLM 评审器会降低精确率。作为一个远超试点数据范围的预测器，当验证器限制成功率时，SPLIT 胜过幂律拟合；我们也报告了它表现不佳的情形。

    超越奖励打分：用于多模态响应生成的在线多智能体偏好学习

    Ziyun Zou, Jiwoo Hong, Yifan Lu, Shao Tang, Weiyi Wu, Aman Gupta, Jin Tian, Imran Razzak

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PrefMind jointly trains a Generator and Critic through online preference judgments and corrections, making multi-agent learning a substantial contribution to model and agent systems. It relates to reasoning through preference analysis, but the abstract does not establish a core advance in general reasoning or internal mechanisms.

    PrefMind 通过在线偏好判断与修正联合训练生成器和评判器，使多智能体学习成为对模型与智能体系统的重要贡献。它通过偏好分析与推理相关，但摘要并未证明其在一般推理或内部机制方面取得核心进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal preference alignment often follows a score-based RLHF pipeline: a reward model is first trained to learn human preferences, then used to score on-policy responses and optimize the response model's generation. This turns preference supervision into a scalar signal for generation: a model may learn to produce answers with higher preference scores, but is rarely trained explicitly to learn the reasons underlying human preferences. We therefore ask whether making preference understanding an internal capability of the response model can improve its generation. To investigate this question, we propose \textbf{PrefMind}, an online dual-agent reinforcement learning framework with two trainable agents: a response Generator and a preference Critic. Given a pair of candidate responses, the agents analyze and discuss which response better aligns with human preference. Human labels supervise their judgments and corrections. For pairs on which both the Generator and revised Critic correctly identify the human-preferred response, the Generator produces an improved answer, and the Critic compares it against the original preferred response to provide a generation reward. Both agents are jointly updated from interactions sampled with their current policies. Through this process, \textbf{PrefMind} trains the Generator to understand human preferences via explicit judgment and correction, and to translate this understanding into better responses. Experiments across three model scales show improvements in both standalone preference judgment and downstream response generation.

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) controllability, the ability of reasoning models to control properties of their CoT, is consequential for both their usefulness and reliable oversight. Recent work evaluates this capability by measuring whether models follow CoT constraints given in the user prompt, and reports very low controllability across models. We argue that this low controllability may not reflect an inherent inability of reasoning models to control their CoT, but instead result from naively specifying constraints in the user prompt. To test this, we introduce Self-Instructed CoT Controllability: a complementary evaluation that places the constraint as a self-instruction inside the model's CoT and measures its ability to follow it. We show that, under self-instruction, models achieve significantly higher controllability than with standard user instructions. Even a generic reminder to follow the user's constraint substantially improves controllability. Moreover, effective self-instructions can be bootstrapped into the reasoning through a simple instruction in the user prompt, enabling improved control even without access to the reasoning channel. Finally, using self-instruction, we demonstrate in a realistic monitoring setup that CoT controllability can be leveraged for monitor evasion, posing a risk to CoT monitorability.

    LLM-agent memory selection often uses retrieval rankings based on record relevance or individual influence. Such rankings cannot identify sufficient subsets under redundant or jointly necessary evidence. We study per-decision memory sufficiency: selecting a small subset that preserves full-memory behavior. To separate search error from model error, we introduce JointCoreBench, a benchmark with nine interaction families, six workflow domains, natural-language decisions, and exact sufficient-set oracles, and JointCore, a relevance cost-ordered group-deletion baseline that tests blocks before individual records. On 6,912 exact conditions, cost-ordered JointCore recovers a minimum-cost sufficient set in 100.0% of cases, reduces subset evaluations from 30.00 to 11.13 (62.9%), and achieves 87.8% active-memory savings. Across four 12B-70B model families and 432 tasks per model, its unweighted mean is 10.28 versus 16.00 model queries and 50.6% versus 43.1% minimum-cost recovery relative to cost aware singleton deletion. Both methods preserve full-memory behavior under the deterministic primary interface. Tests with physical deletion, UNKNOWN masks, PENDING sentinels, counterfactual values, and alternative labels identify interface dependent behavior. JointCore is an efficient benchmark baseline; the study does not establish deployment-ready memory compression.

    用于多层感知机 Kolmogorov-Arnold 几何的 Rényi 类集中度度量

    Juan Carlos Fern\'andez and Asunci\'on Jim\'enez-Cordero and Jos\'e Francisco Paris

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes architecture-independent Rényi-based metrics for measuring concentration in MLP representations via Jacobian minors. This offers a transferable interpretability measurement method, but the abstract does not address composition, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文提出与架构无关的 Rényi 度量，通过 Jacobian 子式衡量 MLP 表征中的集中度。这提供了一种可迁移的可解释性测量方法，但摘要未涉及组合、推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The interpretability of artificial intelligence models has become a central concern, especially for black-box models such as multilayer perceptrons (MLPs). Kolmogorov-Arnold Geometry has recently emerged as a framework for analysing the internal representations of these networks, by examining how the hidden layer locally responds to changes in the input through the minors of its Jacobian. The degree to which a few of these minors dominate the rest, known as their concentration, has so far been measured with the Participation Ratio. Although this metric has useful properties, its maximum value depends on the size of the network, so a given value cannot be read as high or low concentration without reference to the architecture. To overcome this limitation, in this paper we propose the $\alpha$-RC metrics, a family of R\'enyi-based concentration measures that compare the normalized magnitudes of the minors with the uniform distribution through the R\'enyi divergence of order $\alpha$. All the metrics in the family are bounded between 0 and 1 regardless of the architecture, with 0 indicating that the magnitude is evenly spread over the minors and 1 that it is carried by a single one. Moreover, the metrics are non-decreasing in $\alpha$, and for $\alpha$ = 2 they reduce to an explicit transformation of the Participation Ratio. Computational experiments with single-hidden-layer MLPs trained on a synthetic dataset show the benefits of our proposal.

    人工智能模型的可解释性已成为核心议题，尤其是多层感知机（MLP）等黑盒模型。Kolmogorov-Arnold 几何近来成为一种分析此类网络内部表征的框架，它通过 Jacobian 矩阵的子式考察隐藏层对输入变化的局部响应。少数子式相较其余子式占主导的程度称为其集中度，此前一直用参与比率（Participation Ratio）衡量。尽管该指标具有实用性质，其最大值取决于网络规模，因此若不参照架构，便无法判断某个数值代表的集中度是高还是低。为克服这一限制，本文提出$\alpha$-RC 度量，这是一族基于 Rényi 的集中度度量，通过阶数为$\alpha$的 Rényi 散度，将子式的归一化幅值与均匀分布进行比较。该族中的所有度量值都被限制在 0 到 1 之间，与架构无关：0 表示幅值均匀分布在各子式上，1 表示幅值集中于单个子式。此外，这些度量随$\alpha$单调不减；当$\alpha$= 2 时，它们可化为参与比率的显式变换。在合成数据集上训练的单隐藏层 MLP 计算实验表明了该方法的优势。

    Current Chain-of-Thought (CoT) verification methods detect reasoning faithfulness from model outputs or static activations, but are limited in explaining how unfaithfulness develops during generation. We introduce VERITAS to verbalise the model's computation: how different reasoning anchors emerge, transfer across layers, and surface in the output. VERITAS adopts the layer-wise Jacobian projection to produce a verbalised account of the model's internal reasoning evolution at each generated CoT token. By training a classifier on the extracted features along the traces, we show that these structured features provide insightful perspectives on how and where reasoning diverges toward unfaithfulness. Experiments on four datasets from FaithCoT-Bench and BonaFide show that VERITAS achieves a significant performance gain over LLM-as-Judge, with a 28.4% gain in balanced accuracy, and an average improvement of 16.0% over activation probing. Further analysis shows VERITAS can be generalised to different datasets and model architectures. Our work shows that verbalising model computation provides a richer and more interpretable lens on CoT faithfulness, moving beyond detection toward a mechanistic understanding of how reasoning fails.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents an iterative literature-research agent with mutable research state, adaptive subquestions, provenance-tracked evidence, and actions that revise the research plan.     本文提出一种迭代式文献研究智能体，具有可变研究状态、自适应子问题、带溯源信息的证据，以及能够修订研究计划的操作。这对智能体架构作出了实质性贡献，并与组合式研究分解和迭代推理部分相关，但没有直接研究模型内部机制或推理能力的发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Most retrieval-augmented systems treat literature search as a single retrieval step followed by summarization. Real literature research works differently: the investigator's understanding of the question changes as they read, new subquestions appear, and evidence is weighed, not just collected. We present Optimist Deep Research, an open-source agent that runs literature research as an iterative evidence-acquisition process over an explicit, mutable research state. A research question is broken into a tree of subquestions, each served by search intents that are translated into source-specific queries over arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, PubMed, Semantic Scholar and the web. Results are merged into a canonical, provenance-preserving document registry through a conservative four-tier deduplication hierarchy. The registry is expanded by citation snowballing until a saturation criterion is met, and then screened, ranked and allocated to subquestions round-robin. Documents are read in parallel into a structured evidence store of claims with support, location, type and strength. A critic reviews the state along eight dimensions and returns research actions rather than a binary verdict: it can add, split, rephrase, deprioritize or close subquestions, so the research plan is an output of the investigation as well as an input. The final report is written section by section from the evidence store, and every citation resolves to a retrieved document. We describe the design, the deterministic machinery that keeps a language-model pipeline auditable, and a case study that read 28 of 237 retrieved documents in about three and a half minutes. We also report weaknesses the case study exposed.

    大多数检索增强系统将文献搜索视为单次检索后接摘要生成。真实的文献研究方式不同：研究者对问题的理解会随着阅读而变化，新的子问题会出现，证据也需要权衡，而不只是收集。我们介绍 Optimist Deep Research，这是一种开源智能体，它将文献研究作为一个围绕显式、可变研究状态进行的迭代证据获取过程。研究问题会被拆解为一棵子问题树，每个子问题由搜索意图支持；这些意图会被转换为针对 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、PubMed、Semantic Scholar 和网络的特定来源查询。搜索结果通过保守的四层去重层级合并到一个规范化且保留溯源信息的文献注册表中。注册表通过引文滚雪球扩展，直到满足饱和标准，随后对文献进行筛选、排序，并以轮转方式分配给各子问题。文献会被并行阅读，并整理到结构化证据库中，其中包含具有支持依据、位置、类型和强度信息的主张。评审器会从八个维度审查研究状态，并返回研究行动而非二元判定：它可以添加、拆分、改写、降低优先级或关闭子问题，因此研究计划既是调查的输入，也是调查的输出。最终报告依据证据库逐节撰写，每条引文都对应一份已检索到的文献。我们介绍了该系统的设计、使语言模型流程可审计的确定性机制，以及一个案例研究：该研究在约三分半钟内阅读了检索到的 237 份文献中的 28 份。我们还报告了案例研究所揭示的弱点。

    Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based mobile agents are rapidly evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that perceive, reason over, and act on smartphone environments. This capability also exposes a new security risk: adversaries can embed malicious objectives in cross-application mobile content and steer agent behavior through indirect multimodal injection. Although prompt injection has been studied in desktop and web settings, its cross-modal properties in mobile ecosystems remain poorly understood, and existing security analyses are still limited. To close this gap, we introduce MobileInject, the first benchmark for evaluating mobile agents against multimodal injection attacks and reasoning-to-action security risks. MobileInject provides a high-fidelity interactive mobile evaluation framework covering 11 scenarios, 9 security-risk categories, and 108 executable risk instances. It further introduces Cross-Modal Consistency Injection to exploit corroboration across modalities, two enhanced attack methods, Multi-Role Collaborative Deception and Reasoning-Camouflage Injection, to intensify trust manipulation and reasoning hijacking, and a Reasoning Security Diagnosis Framework for fine-grained failure analysis. Systematic experiments show that mobile agents are broadly vulnerable to multimodal injection, and that many failures stem from reasoning hijacking at early stages. These findings establish MobileInject as a systematic cross-modal benchmark for studying and improving the security of mobile agents. Code release details are provided in the Appendix Open Science section.

    Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent outputs that lack source support or conflict with local operational constraints. We introduce Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT), a modular architecture that organizes generation as a closed Retrieve--Reflect--Revise loop. SRCoT separates environment state, persistent knowledge, accumulated experience, and short-term memory into provenance-labeled stores. BM25 retrieval supplies local context; subsequent passes expose intermediate drafts, missing-information markers, follow-up queries, and optional claim--evidence mappings. These artifacts inform retrieval, revision, clarification, or abstention decisions. We examine the architecture through qualitative, trace-based case studies in two fully synthetic settings: emergency medical services and Munich-Sim, an emergency-operations simulation. Local prototype runs on an Apple M4-family laptop with 128 GB memory illustrate source-labeled documentation, explicit gap marking, and structured dispatch-style outputs. The traces also reveal provenance-assignment errors, incomplete evidence coverage, and unsafe assumptions that remain possible despite prompting constraints. These cases demonstrate report-level inspectability and local execution, not comparative superiority, hallucination reduction, clinical validity, or operational safety. The architecture separates retrieval and control from the model interface, but behavior across different models remains to be evaluated. SRCoT is a research proof of concept requiring human review, with its principal contribution lying in an inspectable control procedure rather than a new model.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    Long-term agent memory requires recovering answer-relevant evidence dispersed across turns and sessions. Existing systems increasingly use structured memories and adaptive retrieval, yet often pass retrieved or expanded units directly to the reader, coupling memory addressing with evidence presentation and leaving the final context redundant or incomplete. To address this gap, we propose MemCompile, a query-conditioned evidence compilation framework for long-term conversational memory. Given a query, the Address Plane locates relevant support through compact source-linked descriptors and capacity-aware Cells, while a normalization boundary resolves heterogeneous retrieval hits to stable SourcePacket identities. Its Evidence Plane then allocates a bounded evidence budget across complementary packets, admits limited additional support, and renders the retained claims associated with each selected packet into an answer-ready context. MemCompile achieves 80.52% Judge Accuracy on LoCoMo and extends the empirical quality-cost Pareto frontier to a higher-quality regime. Its strong performance on LongMemEval-S further suggests that the benefits of query-conditioned compilation generalize across long-term conversational-memory benchmarks.

    Peak-Memory Schedules You Can Trust: Exact Realization, Certified Optimality, and the Limits of Recomputation for Inference

    值得信赖的峰值内存调度：推理中的精确实现、经认证的最优性及重计算的局限

    Ivan Fomin, Ivan Koryabkin, Boris Sheludko

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops exact memory-aware operator scheduling, certifies near-optimal schedules, and analyzes when recomputation helps, with both algorithmic results and inference experiments. This is a strong systems contribution, while its scheduling and recomputation results concern execution efficiency rather than model reasoning, internal mechanisms, or compositional generalization.

    本文提出精确的内存感知算子调度，对近优调度进行认证，并分析重计算在何时有用，同时提供算法结果和推理实验。这是一项有力的系统贡献，而其调度和重计算结果关注的是执行效率，而非模型推理能力、内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Real-time inference on small devices needs low activation memory without extra latency, which makes operator order the most valuable memory lever: it is free in time. We show that the usual way of deploying a better order, handing it back to the compiler and regenerating code, is unreliable. In PyTorch Inductor the regenerated program misses its predicted peak in 22 of 54 CPU configurations. It is worse than the stock program in 9 of them and in 19 of 50 on a GPU, and on the GPU it also changes numerical results. We instead profile the generated program, model its memory exactly from its own statements and their read/write effects, and permute those statements. We prove that this realizes the modeled peak whenever allocation does not depend on history. It does so to the byte, with bitwise-identical results, in all our CPU runs. On the GPU we characterize why the caching allocator breaks the condition. To know when to stop, we give forward and reverse "trap" lower bounds, each computable with $O(n^2)$ minimum cuts. They certify the found order optimal for 94% of held-out wrapper graphs and all 16 microcontroller-class models we study, in under a second. So most inference graphs are already scheduled optimally. Branching networks are the exception, where reordering is free and pays, e.g. 10.0% on DeepLabV3. In compiled training we save up to 7.6%. Beyond the certified optimum we study selective recomputation with per-operator caps. It is strongly NP-hard for every fixed cap even at treewidth two, encodes knapsack exactly on series-parallel graphs, and is solvable exactly on bounded treewidth. It is useless on public tiny models whose peak is a single layer, but on architectures that hold a cheap value for a late reuse it pays: on the public ReDimNet speaker networks, whose order is already optimal, it lowers the peak by 5.2-6.1% at under 0.4% extra MACs, with bitwise-identical outputs.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-augmented language-model agents rely on interface text: tool descriptions, argument schemas, and the candidate tool list shown at inference time. These interfaces often change after deployment even when the underlying tool semantics remain fixed, creating a practical reliability problem for function-calling systems. We study this failure mode as interface drift and evaluate whether a lightweight, training-free repair layer can recover robustness without retraining the base model. Our method, SchemaShield-Lite, combines schema validation, candidate-set retry for missing tool names, and one-shot constrained repair. On Qwen3.5-9B, it raises DICE-300 accuracy from 0.717 to 0.813 and BFCL-200 accuracy from 0.580 to 0.805, recovering 19/22 and 33/45 drift-induced failures with no observed repair harms. Naive retry does not explain the gains. Ablations show that candidate-set drift, especially distractor tools, accounts for most observed damage, while description and schema edits alone are less harmful. The results position validation-and-repair as a practical robustness layer for deployed LLM-agent tool use.

    When we say that a robot uses memory, does that memory actually play a role? Success-rate ablations alone cannot establish the use of task-relevant facts: they change information and computation together, while aggregate rates can hide offsetting gains and losses. We propose an Interventional Memory Evaluation Protocol (IMEP) for vision-language-action (VLA) systems to address four questions: (1) Does memory provide a net benefit? (2) Under what conditions does memory help? (3) Do changes to memory alter task outcomes? (4) Are these effects specific to task-relevant facts? At the retrieval interface, we compare target-fact substitutions with fact-preserving replacements, minimal numerical perturbations, and exact replicas, while assessing decision correctness separately from motor execution success. We evaluate within-episode, cross-episode, and agentic memory. In cross-episode learned-bank experiments, a one-unit-in-the-last-place (ULP) intervention, including its installation procedure, changes 11.9% of seed-paired outcomes, while changing key facts produces no clear additional effect over fact-preserving replacements. To examine when memory helps, we introduce ChainBench, where correct decisions require historical information unavailable in current observations. The full memory configuration raises task success from 39.1% to 74.3%, matching the oracle-decision condition under shared recorded executions. These results show that correct history can support robot decisions, but establishing whether a memory system realizes this benefit requires fact-specific evidence beyond aggregate success rates.

    高效的专家路由是混合专家（MoE）系统面临的一项基础挑战，尤其是对于由独立训练的异构大型语言模型（LLM）组成的集合。现有路由方法通常依赖联合训练的门控网络、基于提示的预测器，或计算成本高昂的多模型推理，这限制了它们的灵活性和效率。本文提出 ScoutRoute，这是一种轻量级的事后路由框架，通过对廉价侦察模型进行单次前向传播所提取的语言模型内部信号来预测专家能力。该方法利用隐藏状态表征，通过轻量级逻辑回归探针估计跨模型能力，同时将基于 logits 的置信度指标纳入领域感知路由策略，以实现高效的专家选择，且不修改底层语言模型。ScoutRoute 在五个开放权重语言模型上进行了评估，使用了四个基准数据集，涵盖数学推理、代码生成、常识推理和多学科知识。实验结果表明，ScoutRoute 的表现持续优于单一的路由信号，同时只需进行一次侦察模型推理。所提出的能力探针与传统置信度指标相比也表现出更优的校准效果，表明语言模型内部表征能够提供可迁移的信息，从而在异构语言模型之间实现准确、高效的专家路由。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GatewayBench systematically measures how MCP gateway architectures affect agents’ tool use, efficiency, and security across controlled task environments. This is a substantial contribution to agent systems evaluation, while capability tasks alone do not establish a contribution to reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    GatewayBench 在受控任务环境中系统测量 MCP 网关架构如何影响智能体的工具使用、效率和安全性。这是对智能体系统评估的重要贡献；不过，仅有能力任务并不能证明其对推理机制或组合泛化作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents have increasingly interacted with external environments by invoking tools, with Model Context Protocol (MCP) emerging as a standard interface for connecting agents to heterogeneous tools and services. As organizations deploy agents at scale, MCP gateways have become a critical middleware layer for aggregating, governing, and shaping the tool surface exposed to agents. Despite the growing importance of MCP gateways in agentic systems, no prior work has systematically studied how gateway design affects agent capability, efficiency, and security. To address this gap, we introduce GatewayBench, the first unified evaluation framework and benchmark for MCP gateways. We characterize gateway architectures into two major paradigms: flattened gateways and hierarchical gateways. GatewayBench comprises 524 tasks across six domains, together with a pool of 11,118 real-world tools from 251 authentic MCP servers. To emulate large-scale deployments, we systematically inject task-irrelevant tools sampled from this pool into each agent environment, enabling controlled evaluation as the accessible tool surface scales. Based on GatewayBench, we conduct extensive experiments across seven widely deployed MCP gateways and diverse agent configurations, covering both benign and adversarial tasks. Our results reveal substantial differences across gateway designs in task completion, tool-use efficiency, and resilience to attacks, and further demonstrate that these effects interact strongly with the underlying model and agent harness. These findings highlight the MCP gateway as a consequential yet underexplored component of the agentic AI stack. By enabling controlled evaluation of gateway architectures under realistic tool ecosystems, GatewayBench provides both practical guidance for MCP gateway design and a rigorous testbed for developing more capable, efficient, and secure agentic systems.

    中文

    AI 智能体日益通过调用工具与外部环境交互，模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）也逐渐成为连接智能体与异构工具和服务的标准接口。随着组织大规模部署智能体，MCP 网关已成为关键的中间件层，负责汇集、治理并塑造向智能体开放的工具范围。尽管 MCP 网关在智能体系统中的重要性不断提升，此前尚无工作系统地研究网关设计如何影响智能体的能力、效率与安全性。为填补这一空白，我们推出 GatewayBench，这是首个面向 MCP 网关的统一评估框架与基准。我们将网关架构归纳为两种主要范式：扁平网关和分层网关。GatewayBench 包含覆盖六个领域的 524 项任务，以及来自 251 个真实 MCP 服务器的 11,118 个真实世界工具。为模拟大规模部署，我们系统地从该工具池中抽取与任务无关的工具，并将其注入每个智能体环境，从而能够在可访问工具范围不断扩大的情况下进行受控评估。基于 GatewayBench，我们针对七种广泛部署的 MCP 网关和多种智能体配置开展了大量实验，涵盖良性任务与对抗性任务。结果显示，不同网关设计在任务完成、工具使用效率和抗攻击能力方面存在显著差异；结果还表明，这些影响与底层模型和智能体框架有很强的交互作用。这些发现凸显了 MCP 网关是智能体 AI 技术栈中影响重大但研究不足的组成部分。GatewayBench 能够在真实工具生态系统下对网关架构进行受控评估，既为 MCP 网关设计提供实用指导，也为开发能力更强、效率更高且更安全的智能体系统提供了严格的测试平台。

    The main contribution is an elastic model architecture and training pipeline that adjusts active width for deployment across hardware and multimodal settings, with throughput and accuracy evaluations.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLMs and LVLMs are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous hardware, ranging from data-center GPUs to resource-constrained edge devices. Their fixed-size architectures limit the ability to reuse a single model across deployment settings with different compute, latency, and model-size targets. We introduce HydraLLM, an elastic MQA-based architecture. Its number of active attention heads determines the effective widths of the embeddings, attention projections, feed-forward layers, and the output head, forming a nested family of subnetworks within a single parameter set. We introduce a static-to-elastic conversion pipeline that, starting from a pre-trained model checkpoint, includes importance-driven weight reordering and stochastic subnetwork training with knowledge distillation. We extend this principle to multimodal inference through an elastic projection module whose output width follows the active text width. HydraLLM covers a wider range of active parameter configurations than FFN-only elastic architectures. With 75% of heads active, HydraLLM achieves 2.2 percentage points higher TriviaQA accuracy than a state-of-the-art nested baseline configuration which has 17.25% more parameters. With 50% of heads active, our multimodal model achieves a CLIPScore comparable to that of the 7$\times$ larger Gemma 3 4B model. With only 25% of heads active, HydraLLM increases token-generation throughput by 75.3% over the full-width configuration.

    Markus Fischer, Jens Meiler, Matthias Elgeti

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents and evaluates a self-hosted research assistant whose agent harness coordinates literature search, reading, and computation, with evidence that the harness improves grounded answers. This is a substantial contribution to agent system design, while answer quality and tool use alone provide only an incidental connection to reasoning.

    本文提出并评估了一种自托管研究助手，其智能体框架协调文献搜索、阅读和计算，并提供证据表明该框架能改善答案的依据性。这是对智能体系统设计的重要贡献；不过，仅凭答案质量和工具使用只能与推理形成附带联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Research groups that want a language model grounded in their own literature face a choice between hosted services that receive their unpublished work and self-hosted deployments that keep the data local but give the model no access to the corpus. Munin is an open-source framework for a self-hosted scientific assistant that indexes a group's corpus and its citation graph, and wraps whichever open-weight model the group can serve in an agent harness with specialised reading, search, and computation tools. We claim that the harness, rather than the specific model, is what makes the system useful on domain literature, and we ship the evaluation suite that tests this claim with the software. On 199 paired literature questions, the harness more than doubles the accuracy of the base model, from 0.387 to 0.874 (+0.487, 95% CI [0.407, 0.568]), while naive retrieve-then-answer scores below the unaided model on every backbone tested. Under the harness, roughly twice as many answer claims trace to a passage the model read itself as with fixed top-5 retrieval. When the source paper for a question is removed from the corpus, the system abstains on about nine in ten of the questions it had answered correctly on the Qwen backbones and eight in ten on gpt-oss-20b, and it produces no fabricated local citation across 300 fabricated references. The pattern holds on three backbones from two developers, including a 20-billion-parameter model that runs on a single consumer-grade GPU. With all outbound network access disabled, both Qwen backbones still exceed the published PaperQA2 accuracy. The evaluation suite runs as a single command, so an adopting group can re-run it on its own corpus and model.

    中文

    希望语言模型以自身文献为依据的研究团队，面临两种选择：使用会接收其未发表成果的托管服务，或采用能将数据保存在本地、却无法让模型访问语料库的自托管部署。Munin 是一个开源框架，用于构建自托管科学助手：它为研究团队的语料库及其引文图建立索引，并将团队能够运行的任意开放权重模型封装在一个智能体框架中，配备专门的阅读、搜索和计算工具。我们认为，真正让系统能够有效处理领域文献的是智能体框架，而非某个特定模型；我们随软件一同发布了用于检验这一主张的评估套件。在 199 个成对的文献问题上，该框架使基础模型的准确率提高了一倍以上，从 0.387 提升到 0.874（+0.487，95% CI [0.407, 0.568]）；相比之下，在测试的每个骨干模型上，朴素的先检索后回答方法得分都低于未使用辅助工具的模型。在该框架下，答案主张中能够追溯到模型亲自阅读段落的数量，大约是固定 top-5 检索方法的两倍。当从语料库中移除问题对应的源论文时，对于 Qwen 骨干模型，系统会对原本答对的问题中约十分之九弃答；对于 gpt-oss-20b，则会对约十分之八弃答；在 300 条伪造参考文献中，系统没有生成任何伪造的本地引文。这一规律在来自两家开发者的三个骨干模型上都成立，其中包括一个可在单张消费级 GPU 上运行的 200 亿参数模型。在禁用所有外向网络访问的情况下，两个 Qwen 骨干模型的表现仍然超过已发表的 PaperQA2 准确率。评估套件只需一条命令即可运行，因此采用该框架的团队可以在自己的语料库和模型上重新运行评估。

    ENGLISH

    How does noisy supervision change the representations learned by a neural network? Training accuracy measures agreement with training labels but provides little information about representation geometry. We use persistent homology to track loop structure across distance thresholds in neural activations. Experiments span image classification, text classification, and modular arithmetic. On a fixed CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 training probe, equally sized clean-label and corrupted-label subsets show no detectable persistence difference at epoch 10, whereas corrupted-label subsets have higher persistence at epoch 50. The contrast survives uniform-scale controls, even though predictions match the assigned noisy labels for only 7-11% of corrupted probe examples at that checkpoint. Normalisation preserves the crossover between clean and noisy training trajectories on CIFAR-10/ResNet-18, whereas CIFAR-100/ResNet-18 shows no crossover under any of the five evaluated constructions. In a separate noise-rate calibration comparison across five pipelines, mean activation norm achieves a higher mean in-sample R2 than raw persistence (0.936 versus 0.908). These findings show that noisy supervision leaves a measurable geometric signature even when agreement with corrupted labels is low. Comparing persistence under scale controls with label-fitting measurements offers a way to study how representations respond to label corruption beyond what training accuracy reveals.

    Self-supervised speech models such as WavLM achieve strong spoofing detection performance, yet which layers encode the most spoof-relevant information and what acoustic properties they capture remain opaque. We present a layer-wise interpretability study of WavLM using the ASVspoof 5 database, combining three complementary analyses: (i) per-layer linear probing with attack-level evaluation across speech synthesis, voice conversion, and adversarial attacks; (ii) a canonical correlation analysis (CCA) linking layer representations to spoofing-relevant acoustic features; (iii) an exhaustive grid search over layer subsets showing that use of five layers outperforms full thirteen-layer pooling. CCA analysis reveals that, while most acoustic features peak in alignment with mid-layers and then decay, voice quality measures jitter, shimmer, and the harmonics-to-noise ratio show the opposite trend, with correlation increasing toward later layers. Embedding visualisations reveal that deeper layers capture a continuous acoustic similarity among attacks rather than discrete categories, suggesting these layers encode fundamental synthesis artifacts rather than attack-specific signatures.

    对比中的真相：基于语言模型似然的校准事实证据

    Ponhvoan Srey, Jason Lucas, Pittawat Taveekitworachai, Junyoung Lee, Anh Tuan Luu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives calibration results for contrastive factual likelihoods and studies evidence directions in likelihood geometry, then uses selective alignment to improve factual discrimination and generation. This gives substantial insight into evidence representation and factual confidence, while its relevance to reasoning is limited to factual assessment rather than multi-step reasoning; it does not address composition or systems.

    本文推导了对比事实似然的校准结果，研究似然几何中的证据方向，并利用选择性对齐提升事实区分能力和生成效果。这为证据表征与事实置信度提供了重要见解；与推理的关联仅限于事实评估，而非多步推理；本文不涉及组合或系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) encode substantial factual knowledge. Yet, estimating confidence in factual claims reliably remains challenging. We study likelihood-based factual confidence from the complementary perspectives of discrimination and calibration across multilingual factual statements. Specifically, we instantiate contrastive generative likelihoods as Contrastive Factual Evidence (CFE), which compares the likelihood of the same claim under competing factual and non-factual conditions, and derive its probabilistic counterpart, the Contrastive Factual Posterior (CFP). We show analytically that CFP calibration depends on the differential error between the two surrogate conditionals, allowing errors shared across them to cancel and yield tighter calibration bounds. Empirically, CFP substantially improves calibration while maintaining factual discrimination comparable to its strongest competitor. Nonetheless, discrimination is uniformly weak across methods in lower-resource languages, which simultaneously undermines the utility of the measured calibration. To this end, we interpret a likelihood geometry, within which an evidence-bearing direction is induced, along with an orthogonal evidence-invariant direction. In our investigation, we selectively align target-language claims with stronger English evidence only along the factual-evidence direction, improving discrimination and open-ended factual generation without target-language labels.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a theoretical account of ICL under unsupported instructions and tasks, including how decomposing long-horizon tasks into supported subtasks enables generalization. This directly advances compositional generalization and bears on task-solving, while its incidental ICL setting does not establish mechanisms of internal representations or model and agent systems.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In-Context Learning (ICL) enables pretrained LLMs to adapt to downstream tasks from a small set of input-output demonstrations, without parameter updates. Yet existing theory primarily explains ICL as identifying a latent task already represented in pretraining, leaving unclear whether ICL can succeed when either the instruction or the target task falls outside the pretraining support. We develop a theoretical framework under mild assumptions that separates these two forms of distribution shift. For target tasks represented in pretraining, we show that demonstrations can identify the task and reduce sensitivity to pretrain-supported prompt templates as their number increases. For an unsupported instruction, we show that under a fixed model-induced reference extension, demonstration evidence can dominate an $N$-independent instruction shift while preserving the exponential identification rate. We then use the same ICL framework as an interpretive lens for long-horizon target tasks that are not represented in pretraining but admit a plan that decomposes them into pretraining-supported subtasks. Applying the supported-task analysis step by step yields a standard accumulated-error bound and clarifies how invoking familiar subtasks along an intermediate-state trajectory can avoid directly selecting the unsupported complete task. Together, our results characterize when demonstrations, instructions, and task decomposition can support ICL beyond the corresponding pretraining supports.

    上下文学习（ICL）使预训练 LLM 无需更新参数，便能通过少量输入输出示例适应下游任务。然而，现有理论主要将 ICL 解释为识别一个已在预训练中表示的潜在任务，因此尚不清楚当指令或目标任务超出预训练支持范围时，ICL 是否仍能成功。我们在温和假设下构建了一个理论框架，将这两种分布偏移区分开来。对于预训练中已有表示的目标任务，我们证明，随着示例数量增加，示例既可以识别任务，也可以降低模型对预训练支持的提示模板的敏感性。对于不受支持的指令，我们证明，在固定的模型诱导参考扩展下，示例证据可以压过与 $N$ 无关的指令偏移，同时保留指数级识别速率。随后，我们将同一 ICL 框架用作一种解释视角，考察那些在预训练中没有表示、但可以通过计划分解为预训练支持子任务的长时程目标任务。逐步应用针对受支持任务的分析，可以得到一个标准的累积误差界，并阐明如何沿中间状态轨迹调用熟悉的子任务，从而避免直接选择不受支持的完整任务。总之，我们的结果刻画了示例、指令和任务分解在何种条件下能够支持 ICL 超越相应的预训练支持范围。

    SkillBrowser lets agents identify emerging capability needs and selectively load procedural skills, improving performance on multi-step tasks.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model agents increasingly rely on skills to extend their capabilities in complex tasks. However, scalable skill use requires Selective Skill Exposure (SSE): providing relevant procedural content when needed while avoiding unnecessary exposure that may disrupt reasoning. Existing paradigms fall short in complementary ways. Progressive disclosure exposes metadata for a growing skill library, introducing context pollution; retrieval limits catalog exposure, but static retrieval from the initial task query may be misaligned with capability needs that emerge during reasoning and may still inject unnecessary skills. We propose SkillBrowser, a Meta-Skill-managed framework that enables an agent to identify current capability needs, formulate targeted queries, and selectively load skills on demand. Across six SRA-Bench subsets and five LLMs, SkillBrowser improves aggregate accuracy over static retrieval and LLM-based selection, including multi-step tool use, and mitigates accuracy degradation on already-solvable instances. Benefits remain model- and task-dependent, with under-invocation of useful skills and additional latency as key limitations. These results demonstrate the viability of Meta-Skill-managed SSE for scalable skill repositories.

    Beyond Expected Values: Risk-Sensitive Planning with Distributional Monte-Carlo Tree Search

    超越期望值：基于分布式蒙特卡洛树搜索的风险敏感规划

    Quynh Trinh, Trung Nguyen, Nam Nguyen, Tuan Dam

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops and analyzes distributional MCTS algorithms for CVaR planning, with a finite-depth error bound and improved tail-risk outcomes. This is a substantial contribution to planning and decision algorithms; its connection to model systems is incidental because the abstract describes a planning method rather than model or agent architecture.

    本文开发并分析了用于 CVaR 规划的分布式 MCTS 算法，给出了有限深度误差界，并展示了尾部风险结果的改善。这是对规划与决策算法的重要贡献；其与模型系统的关联只是附带的，因为摘要描述的是一种规划方法，而非模型或智能体架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) typically stores only scalar mean estimates, which makes it poorly suited for tail-risk objectives such as conditional value-at-risk (CVaR). We introduce Categorical Thompson Sampling with Optimism (CATSO) and Particle Thompson Sampling with Optimism (PATSO), two distributional MCTS algorithms that maintain finite-support empirical backup laws at Q-edges. CATSO represents Q-edge laws with categorical atoms and Dirichlet Thompson sampling, while PATSO represents them with adaptive particles. Both algorithms select actions using the CVaR of a Thompson-sampled Q-edge law plus a polynomial optimism bonus, and propagate scalar continuation values through visit-weighted averages of child Q-edge CVaR scores. For the finite-depth nested CVaR planning target, we prove an $O(n^{-1/2})$ bound on the root value error after $n$ rollouts, which upper-bounds the risk-sensitive simple regret. CATSO adds a fixed-grid discretization bias, while capped PATSO adds a tunable Wasserstein compression bias. Experiments on stochastic planning benchmarks show that distributional Q-edges improve lower-tail return and reduce catastrophic outcomes when mean-optimal and risk-sensitive behavior differ.

    蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）通常只存储标量均值估计，因此不太适合条件风险价值（CVaR）等尾部风险目标。我们提出类别型乐观汤普森采样（CATSO）和粒子型乐观汤普森采样（PATSO）两种分布式 MCTS 算法，它们在 Q 边上维护具有有限支撑的经验备份分布。CATSO 使用类别原子和狄利克雷汤普森采样表示 Q 边分布，而 PATSO 使用自适应粒子进行表示。两种算法都通过对汤普森采样得到的 Q 边分布计算 CVaR，并加上多项式乐观奖励来选择动作；随后通过对子 Q 边 CVaR 分数进行按访问次数加权的平均，传播标量延续值。对于有限深度的嵌套 CVaR 规划目标，我们证明，在 $O(n^{-1/2})$ 次 rollout 后，根节点价值误差满足 $n$ 界，该界同时构成风险敏感简单后悔的上界。CATSO 会带来固定网格离散化偏差，而受限的 PATSO 会带来可调的 Wasserstein 压缩偏差。随机规划基准上的实验表明，当均值最优行为与风险敏感行为不同时，分布式 Q 边能够改善下尾回报并减少灾难性结果。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Darwin-Claw consolidates episodic experience into prototypes that update agent skills and durable memory for user-specific adaptation. This gives a substantive agent-memory contribution, with some generalization and reasoning relevance, but the abstract does not directly investigate reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    Darwin-Claw 将情景经验整合为原型，以更新智能体技能和持久记忆，从而实现针对特定用户的适应。这构成了实质性的智能体记忆贡献，并与泛化和推理有一定关联，但摘要并未直接研究推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across complex tasks, they predominantly operate in isolated sessions, lacking the ability to continually learn from historical interactions or adapt to user-specific environments. Existing self-evolution paradigms often indiscriminately inject raw interaction trajectories into memory or skill modules, leading to obscured behavioral patterns and compromised update controllability. Furthermore, as foundational LLM reasoning improves, the bottleneck for agentic evolution shifts from accumulating generic knowledge to effectively managing situational experience. To address this, we propose Darwin-Claw, an environment-adaptive self-evolving framework that systematically distills episodic experiences to drive the comprehensive evolution of operational skills and durable memory. Theoretically grounded in an iterative agent-actor and evolver-critic co-adaptation, Darwin-Claw introduces a Hierarchical Experience Consolidation System that extracts fine-grained error attributions and generalizes them into dynamically updated prototype vectors. This structured situational experience serves as interaction patches for context-sensitive perception and explicit optimization signals for skill refinement. Practically, Darwin-Claw is a readily deployable, automated framework compatible with mainstream agent systems without requiring manual curation. Extensive experiments on WildClawBench demonstrate that Darwin-Claw yields substantial performance improvements, establishing a controllable and stable pathway for the continual, user-centric adaptation of autonomous agents in real-world ecosystems.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-term LLM assistants must repeatedly decide what prior context to expose and which model should answer as an interaction evolves. Existing memory systems and model routers usually make these decisions separately, although memory construction changes the evidence, distractors, and difficulty of the resulting input. We introduce MARS, a memory-aware routing framework that uses session state as a shared control interface between memory construction and model selection. A Query and Topic Manager (QTM) estimates compact decision-relevant state that guides a fixed state-conditioned memory policy and an online router, enabling each turn to receive an appropriate memory view and a suitable model under a quality-memory-cost trade-off. We evaluate MARS on RealMem and MultiChallenge with 16 system configurations each, covering long-history memory-driven interaction and bounded sessions with structured context interference. On RealMem, MARS preserves 98.2% of full-context GPT-4o's QA while using only 14.5% of its generation API cost, including both generation and controller calls for MARS, and achieves the strongest measured memory-recall and retrieval scores among compared systems. On MultiChallenge, MARS trails the strongest static system overall but approaches its performance at lower recorded cost on a mechanism-focused subset. Together, these results support a favorable quality-memory-cost trade-off for long-history, memory-dependent interaction.

    RL-Guided Temporal Localization for Dual-Channel Retrieval in Long-Horizon Agent Memory

    面向长时程智能体记忆双通道检索的强化学习引导时间定位

    Dabin Sheng, Zhe Wu, Jinming Zhao, Junliang Xing, Yuanchun Shi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TIDER contributes an RL-trained temporal locator and dual-channel retrieval method for long-horizon agent memory, with benchmark gains. Its RL decision is retrieval optimization rather than a study of reasoning, while memory retrieval and organization provide a substantial systems contribution.

    TIDER 为长时程智能体记忆提出了经 RL 训练的时间定位器和双通道检索方法，并在基准测试中取得性能提升。其 RL 决策针对的是检索优化，而非推理研究；与此同时，记忆检索与组织构成了实质性的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Time-aware retrieval is crucial for long-horizon LLM agents to effectively leverage ever-growing long-term memory. Existing methods focus on lexical or semantic similarity, leading to target memories being crowded out by temporally mismatched yet semantically similar candidates. Even time-aware approaches inject temporal cues only during memory organization or answer generation, overlooking temporal constraints at the retrieval stage, where candidate selection occurs - the root cause of the displacement. Inspired by the temporal contiguity effect in human episodic memory, we propose TIDER (Temporal Interval-driven Dual-channel Evidence Retrieval), a time-aware agentic retrieval framework. Central to TIDER is a reinforcement learning (RL)-trained temporal interval locator that infers the temporal windows in which the evidence lies. RL optimizes window localization as a discrete, non-differentiable retrieval decision, using composite rewards to convert sparse answer supervision into fine-grained retrieval feedback. These temporal windows first define the temporal retrieval channel; the retrieved candidates are then merged with results from the semantic channel and reranked by proximity to the windows. This temporal grounding enables TIDER to retrieve temporally aligned evidence that would otherwise be drowned out by the volume of semantically similar yet temporally mismatched memories. With a lightweight 1.7B locator, TIDER achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on both long-horizon memory benchmarks - 61.52% on LifeBench (+8.82%) and 78.96% on LoCoMo (+3.66%) - which indicates that temporal cues are crucial for pinpointing target evidence amid a vast pool of semantically similar historical events in long-term daily-life memory.

    中文

    具备时间感知能力的检索对于长时程 LLM 智能体有效利用不断增长的长期记忆至关重要。现有方法侧重于词汇或语义相似度，导致目标记忆被时间上不匹配、但语义相似的候选项挤出。即使是具备时间感知能力的方法，也只在记忆组织或答案生成阶段引入时间线索，忽略了发生候选选择的检索阶段中的时间约束，而这正是目标被挤出的根本原因。受人类情景记忆中时间连续性效应的启发，我们提出 TIDER（时间区间驱动的双通道证据检索），一种具备时间感知能力的智能体检索框架。TIDER 的核心是一个经强化学习（RL）训练的时间区间定位器，用于推断证据所在的时间窗口。RL 将窗口定位作为离散、不可微的检索决策进行优化，并使用复合奖励将稀疏的答案监督转化为细粒度的检索反馈。这些时间窗口首先定义时间检索通道；随后，将检索到的候选项与语义通道的结果合并，并根据其与时间窗口的接近程度重新排序。这种时间锚定使 TIDER 能够检索到时间上对齐的证据，否则这些证据可能会被大量语义相似但时间不匹配的记忆淹没。采用轻量级 1.7B 定位器时，TIDER 在两个长时程记忆基准上都达到了最先进的准确率——在 LifeBench 上为 61.52%（+8.82%），在 LoCoMo 上为 78.96%（+3.66%）——这表明，在长期日常生活记忆中，要从大量语义相似的历史事件里精准定位目标证据，时间线索至关重要。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CDSE organizes persistent agent skills into coordinated functional components and updates them from successful and failed trajectories, improving results across agent settings. Functional differentiation offers a limited compositional connection, and trajectory-based skill improvement relates to reasoning, but neither is the paper’s central contribution.

    CDSE 将持久智能体技能组织为相互协调的功能组件，并根据成功和失败的轨迹更新技能，在多种智能体设置中提升了结果。功能分化与组合有一定关联，基于轨迹的技能改进也与推理相关，但二者都不是该论文的核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents tackle complex tasks through reasoning and interaction with external environments. Agent skills provide persistent, transferable capabilities that guide task planning, inform contextual decisions, support tool use, and enable executable procedures. Yet existing skill-evolution methods largely organize knowledge around skill artifacts, overlooking the functional heterogeneity within individual skills and its implications for knowledge maintenance and use. Inspired by cognitive science, we propose Cognitive Differentiation in Skill Evolution (CDSE), which evolves a unified skill through four functionally distinct yet coordinated components: Meta, Experience, Tool, and Script. CDSE extracts evidence-grounded semantic gradients from successful and failed trajectories, consolidates them by functional role, and applies component-specific updates and validation with cross-component coordination and adaptive invocation. An analysis of 500 top-ranked skill packages shows that 96.8% contain knowledge spanning at least two functional roles. Across six benchmarks, three agent models, and two execution harnesses, CDSE achieves the highest scores in all 36 settings, improving over the Base agent by 7.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method in each setting by 2.6 points on average. Ablation studies further support the importance of functional differentiation and adaptive invocation.

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过推理并与外部环境交互来处理复杂任务。智能体技能提供持久且可迁移的能力，用于指导任务规划、辅助上下文决策、支持工具使用，并实现可执行流程。然而，现有技能进化方法大多围绕技能工件组织知识，忽略了单项技能内部的功能异质性及其对知识维护和使用的影响。受认知科学启发，我们提出技能进化中的认知分化（CDSE），通过四个功能不同但彼此协调的组成部分来进化统一技能：Meta、Experience、Tool 和 Script。CDSE 从成功和失败的轨迹中提取以证据为依据的语义梯度，按功能角色整合这些梯度，并进行组件专属的更新和验证，同时实现跨组件协调与自适应调用。对排名最高的 500 个技能包进行分析发现，96.8% 的技能包包含至少涵盖两种功能角色的知识。在六个基准、三种智能体模型和两种执行框架上，CDSE 在全部 36 种设置中都取得最高分；与基线智能体相比，它提升了 7.6 个百分点，与每种设置下最强的竞争方法相比，平均提升了 2.6 个百分点。消融研究进一步支持了功能分化和自适应调用的重要性。

    Amit Ranjan Trivedi, Sruthikesh Surineni, Kyong Ho Lee, Mohit Mittal, Steven Li, Rex Hill

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is learning when a target model can correct a draft model’s reasoning trajectory, improving accuracy across several reasoning benchmarks. This substantially advances reasoning-time intervention; its sparse decoding setup is a systems connection, but the abstract gives limited insight into broader computation or agent design.

    该论文的主要贡献是学习何时调用目标模型来纠正草稿模型的推理轨迹，并在多个推理基准上提升准确率。这实质性地推进了推理时干预；其稀疏解码设置与系统研究有关，但摘要对更广泛的计算或智能体设计只提供了有限见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Dense assistance methods such as speculative decoding repeatedly verify draft tokens with a target model, keeping target computation coupled to generation. We study sparse collaborative decoding, where a draft model generates most tokens and a target model is invoked only for short corrective segments. The key problem is deciding when to call the target. We show that local uncertainty is a weak trigger: entropy, negative log-likelihood, logit margin, top-$k$ mass, and velocity features give near-chance failure prediction, with AUC 0.50-0.53. In contrast, aggregate trajectory-shape features over the draft confidence path reach AUC 0.86 using a lightweight logistic predictor trained only from draft correctness labels. This induces a trigger-timing tradeoff: early calls have more leverage but weaker evidence, while later calls have stronger evidence but less ability to redirect the trajectory. Used online, learned sparse collaborative decoding improves over the best open-loop schedule by +5.3 to +20.0 accuracy points across five GSM8K draft-target pairs. On MATH-500, it gains 7.0-13.5 points when early prediction and target competence align, but loses when either is weak. On StrategyQA, it improves over open-loop by 5.0-8.3 points, showing transfer beyond arithmetics.

    诸如推测解码这样的密集辅助方法会反复使用目标模型验证草稿 token，使目标模型的计算始终与生成过程耦合。我们研究稀疏协同解码：草稿模型生成大多数 token，目标模型仅在短小的纠正片段中被调用。关键问题在于何时调用目标模型。我们发现，局部不确定性是较弱的触发信号：熵、负对数似然、logit 间隔、top-$k$ 概率质量和速度特征对失败的预测接近随机水平，AUC 为 0.50–0.53。相比之下，对草稿置信度轨迹进行聚合得到的轨迹形状特征，使用仅由草稿正确性标签训练的轻量级逻辑回归预测器，可达到 0.86 的 AUC。这带来了触发时机的权衡：较早调用的影响力更大，但证据更弱；较晚调用的证据更充分，但重定向轨迹的能力较弱。在线使用时，学习得到的稀疏协同解码在五组 GSM8K 草稿模型与目标模型配对上，比最佳开环调度提升了 +5.3 至 +20.0 个准确率百分点。在 MATH-500 上，当早期预测与目标模型能力相匹配时，它提升了 7.0–13.5 个百分点；任一因素较弱时则会退步。在 StrategyQA 上，它比开环方法提升了 5.0–8.3 个百分点，表明这种方法能够迁移到算术之外的任务。

    The Sign Code: The Hidden Binary Nature of Deep Networks

    符号编码：深度网络隐藏的二元本质

    Niclas G\"oring, Shuofeng Zhang, Roi Holtzman, Yoonsoo Nam, Ard A. Louis

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper argues that binary neuron sign codes, rather than activation magnitudes, largely determine classification, supporting the claim with perturbation and margin analyses. This is a substantial contribution to understanding internal representations, with no substantive focus on composition, reasoning, or systems.

    该论文认为，二元神经元符号编码而非激活幅度在很大程度上决定了分类，并通过扰动和间隔分析支持这一观点。这对理解内部表征作出了实质性贡献，但未实质关注组合性、推理或系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size). We call the set of all neuron signs the \textit{sign code}. This raises a key question: does classification depend more on the sign code or on the magnitudes? For overparameterized vision classifiers with sign-preserving activations, the answer is overwhelmingly the sign code. A $k$-nearest neighbor classifier operating only on this binary sign code achieves accuracy comparable to the full model across different architectures, activation functions, and datasets. Moreover, replacing all magnitudes in every layer with random noise while keeping the original signs barely changes residual network performance. In contrast, flipping just 20\% of the signs reduces accuracy to chance. Models generalize well when same-class inputs share similar sign codes. When this overlap is disrupted by a regularizer, training accuracy remains high, but test performance collapses. A margin decomposition helps explain these results: the sign-only contribution to each logit grows as $\sqrt{d}$ in network width, dominating the magnitude residual. The natural unit of analysis for these networks may not be through their continuous weight space but instead through their discrete sign codes.

    中文

    训练后网络中的每个神经元都会输出一个数值，该数值可分解为符号（正或负）和幅度（绝对大小）。我们将所有神经元符号的集合称为\textit{符号编码}。这引出了一个关键问题：分类更多取决于符号编码还是幅度？对于带符号保持激活函数的过参数化视觉分类器，答案毫无疑问是符号编码。一个仅在这种二元符号编码上运行的 $k$ 近邻分类器，在不同架构、激活函数和数据集上的准确率都与完整模型相当。此外，在保留原始符号的同时，将每一层的所有幅度替换为随机噪声，几乎不会改变残差网络的表现。相比之下，仅翻转 20\% 的符号就会使准确率降至随机猜测水平。当同类输入具有相似的符号编码时，模型的泛化效果良好。如果正则化器破坏了这种重叠，训练准确率仍然很高，但测试表现会崩溃。间隔分解有助于解释这些结果：每个 logit 中仅由符号产生的贡献随网络宽度增长为 $\sqrt{d}$，并在很大程度上超过幅度残差。分析这类网络时，自然的分析单位或许不应是连续的权重空间，而应是离散的符号编码。
