    Ingo Marquardt, Anthilia Alchanat, Priyanka Jain

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study uses layerwise decoding and controls to distinguish word identity from passage-level context in LLM representations, finding these signals peak at different depths. This gives substantial empirical insight into representation structure, though it does not identify causal mechanisms or circuits.

    该研究通过逐层解码和对照实验，区分 LLM 表征中的词语身份与篇章级上下文，并发现这些信号在不同深度达到峰值。这为理解表征结构提供了实质性的实证见解，但未识别因果机制或回路。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In a previous report we showed that a decoder can recover open-vocabulary word-level information from 19-channel EEG recorded during silent reading, by aligning short EEG windows with hidden-state embeddings of the presented word taken from a large language model (LLM). That analysis contrasted two of the model's 33 layers: the context-free input embedding and one mid-depth layer. Here we ask how EEG-decodable structure is distributed over the full depth of the language model. We trained one decoder per layer of Llama-3.1-8B, with and without a causal transformer over the sequence of EEG windows. We distinguish word-level decodability from a context-tracking component. Word-level decodability peaks in early layers and declines steadily towards the last layer. In contrast, the context-tracking component of the retrieval gain rises with depth, both with and without a causal transformer. Unexpectedly, a decoder that sees a single 0.5-s window at a time tracks the text passage too. Two new controls dissect this component. A target-geometry control, a synthetic predictor made of the true target plus noise calibrated to each decoder's word-level accuracy, shows that context tracking is not a by-product of word decoding and target geometry. A control that permutes predictions across runs from either the same or from different sessions shows that most of the observed context-tracking is not caused by an EEG recording session signature. Instead, context tracking mostly follows the text. A single EEG window therefore carries passage-level information that a contextual target can absorb. The results locate word identity in the early layers of the language model, discourse state in the deeper layers, and make the choice of target layer a design dial for EEG language decoders.

    中文

    在先前的一份报告中，我们展示了解码器能够从静默阅读时记录的 19 通道 EEG 中恢复开放词汇表的词级信息，方法是将短 EEG 窗口与大型语言模型（LLM）中所呈现词语的隐藏状态嵌入对齐。该分析对比了模型 33 层中的两层：无上下文的输入嵌入层和一个中间深度层。在此，我们研究 EEG 可解码结构如何分布于语言模型的整个深度。我们为 Llama-3.1-8B 的每一层训练了一个解码器，并分别研究了在 EEG 窗口序列上使用和不使用因果 Transformer 的情况。我们将词级可解码性与上下文跟踪成分区分开来。词级可解码性在早期层达到峰值，随后向最后一层稳步下降。相比之下，无论是否使用因果 Transformer，检索增益中的上下文跟踪成分都会随深度增加而上升。令人意外的是，一次只接收一个 0.5 秒窗口的解码器也能跟踪文本篇章。两种新的对照实验进一步剖析了这一成分。目标几何对照使用一种合成预测器：将真实目标与噪声相加，并根据每个解码器的词级准确率校准噪声。该对照表明，上下文跟踪并非词语解码和目标几何的副产物。另一种对照将同一场次或不同场次的运行结果之间的预测进行置换，结果表明，大部分观察到的上下文跟踪并非由 EEG 记录场次特征造成，而主要随文本变化。因此，单个 EEG 窗口携带篇章级信息，可由具有上下文的目标吸收。结果表明，词语身份位于语言模型的早期层，话语状态位于更深层，并说明目标层的选择可作为 EEG 语言解码器的一个设计调节手段。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a configurable monitor for chain-of-thought behavior and evaluates its performance across tasks, unseen models, and altered trajectories, making CoT monitoring a substantial contribution to reasoning oversight.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring offers actionable evidence for oversight AI systems, with the potential to enable early detection and intervention. However, existing approaches are focused on specific tasks, whereas the regulation of AI, particularly reasoning models, requires monitoring a broader range of tasks. We introduce Factor for CoT monitoring, a strategy that supports customizing monitoring requirements in the prompt, which enables a single monitor to cover different tasks by relying on different factors. Furthermore, we introduce two types of factors, fine-grained and coarse-grained (e.g., monitoring whether a specific email address has been leaked versus monitoring privacy leakage), to accommodate diverse user monitoring needs. Based on this, we develop a CoT monitor named OwlSight that relies solely on factor to monitor behaviors related to multiple dimensions, including capability, safety, and trustworthiness. Experiments across 15,971 reasoning trajectories show that OwlSight surpasses general-purpose LLMs by 1.32-30.57 and 11.71-27.81 points at fine and coarse granularity, respectively, and achieves state-of-the-art results on OpenAI's CoT monitorability benchmark. It also generalizes to unseen models' CoTs and remains robust to Factor rephrasings, CoT compression, and obfuscation, offering a promising paradigm for CoT monitoring that can contribute to the oversight of frontier AI.

    思维链（CoT）监测为 AI 监督系统提供了可操作的证据，并有望实现早期检测和干预。然而，现有方法聚焦于特定任务，而 AI 治理，尤其是对推理模型的治理，需要监测范围更广的任务。我们提出用于 CoT 监测的 Factor 策略，它支持在提示中自定义监测要求，使单一监测器能够依靠不同因素覆盖不同任务。此外，我们还提出两类因素：细粒度因素和粗粒度因素（例如，监测是否泄露了某个特定电子邮件地址，与监测隐私泄露），以满足用户多样化的监测需求。在此基础上，我们开发了名为 OwlSight 的 CoT 监测器，它仅依靠 factor 来监测与多个维度相关的行为，包括能力、安全性和可信度。对 15,971 条推理轨迹的实验表明，在细粒度和粗粒度两种粒度下，OwlSight 分别比通用 LLM 高出 1.32–30.57 和 11.71–27.81 个百分点，并在 OpenAI 的 CoT 可监测性基准上达到最先进的结果。它还能够泛化到未见过的模型 CoT，并对 Factor 改写、CoT 压缩和混淆保持稳健，为 CoT 监测提供了一种有前景的范式，可用于助力前沿 AI 的监督。

    A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate. We present Tool Recommendation, a deployed system that gives an agent all of them, hundreds of times more than a typical MCP server exposes, through a fixed interface of three tools. It runs at the gateway between agent and tools, executing every call under the end user's own credentials and checking it against the user's consent for each service and the tools the agent may use. We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost. On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its size.     Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce GLOBE, an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated. This cycle transforms episodic feedback into a persistent, field-scoped optimization memory. Experiments show that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, while feedback-driven evolution and moderation further improve effectiveness and reduce downside risk. The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories, suggesting that agentic memory evolution supports interpretable and transferable product optimization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep neural networks demonstrate remarkable generalization despite being highly over-parameterized, challenging traditional statistical learning theories. While several theoretical paradigms such as margin-based bounds, PAC-Bayesian analyses, and neural tangent kernels provide global explanations, they often lack mechanistic insight into how generalization emerges from training dynamics. We introduce Neural Expansion, a unified geometric framework that characterizes generalization through the expansion of directionally-selective ray coverage in the input space. Using Generalization Intervals (GIs), we quantify direction-specific regions around training samples where the model's predictions remain stable. Our extensive empirical studies across diverse architectures and datasets reveal that training leads to progressive expansion of ray coverage, particularly along directions with low Jacobian singular values. This mechanism helps explain a large fraction of correctly classified test inputs, adversarial examples, and even mislabeled or out-of-distribution samples through the geometry of ray coverage rather than instance-level memorization. By connecting input-space curvature to predictive behavior, our framework provides a mechanistic foundation that complements existing global theories of deep learning.

    Red teaming must continually adapt as frontier LLM safeguards evolve, yet existing approaches largely search for adversarial prompts or optimize within fixed attack procedures. We observe that even when an attack becomes ineffective, its underlying mechanisms can remain useful and can be revised or recombined to construct stronger attacks. Based on this insight, we introduce RedDarwin, an agentic framework that shifts the unit of jailbreak evolution from prompts and fixed attacks to executable attack skills. RedDarwin consists of 47 reusable base skills and autonomously revises, composes, executes, and selects them using target-model feedback, allowing successful discoveries to become building blocks for subsequent evolution. RedDarwin produces 65 evolved skills, improving 44 of 47 base attacks and increasing their mean attack success rate (ASR) on AdvBench from 18.8% to 47.3%. We believe this paradigm can accelerate adaptive red teaming and inform stronger safeguards, creating complementary value for both safety evaluation and defense.

    We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural networks based on their last hidden layer representations. By evaluating representation quality with a parameter-free $k$-nearest-neighbor ($k$-NN) classifier, our certificate avoids traditional parameter-space complexity measures, KL divergences to a posterior, weight norms, and compression. The bound is tight: trained from scratch, it reaches an 8.0 percentage point gap to test error on CIFAR-10 (ResNet-18) and yields the first non-vacuous certificates we are aware of on CIFAR-100; with frozen DINOv2 representations, it certifies at 1.4\% on CIFAR-10 and 23.1\% on 1,000-class ImageNet.     Recent large audio language models (LALMs) have extended their capabilities beyond lexical speech understanding to tasks requiring paralinguistic and non-linguistic audio understanding, such as emotion recognition. However, these models still struggle to reliably utilize acoustic information, particularly when it co-occurs with spoken linguistic content. Existing benchmarks do not clearly distinguish acoustic perception from higher-level reasoning, making it difficult to identify the source of these failures. To address this issue, we introduce VocalGrad, a benchmark designed to evaluate LALMs' ability to perceive low-level acoustic variations. VocalGrad formulates this problem as a simple binary classification of temporal change direction, enabling evaluation largely independent of higher-level reasoning or semantic understanding. Our benchmark results reveal a substantial gap in acoustic perception between human annotators and state-of-the-art LALMs: while human annotators achieve high accuracy, LALMs perform at near-chance levels. Our analysis reveals two distinct failure modes: for some categories, task-relevant information is preserved in internal representations but not utilized by the language model head; for others, the information becomes progressively less linearly decodable across model layers. Overall, our results reveal substantial limitations of LALMs in modeling acoustic variation under controlled settings and expose representation differences not observable from text outputs.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Understanding how stochastic gradient descent learns internal representations in wide neural networks trained on rich target functions is a central problem in machine learning. We study this question in two-layer neural networks learning target functions represented by networks of the same architecture, with arbitrary nonlinearity, and with network width and input dimension growing proportionally. In this regime, standard approaches for describing the learning dynamics require tracking a diverging number of overlaps, which measure correlations between learned and target features, leaving no obvious description in terms of a few order parameters. Here, we develop a mesoscopic description of learning by characterizing the distribution of overlaps. In the early stages of learning, we find that a Gaussian description of overlap statistics reduces the learning dynamics to a few collective variables that track learning of the target function's linear and quadratic components. We then estimate the timescale of specialization, when Gaussian closure breaks down and individual learned features begin to strongly correlate with specific target features. We find that specialization in extensive-rank networks is accelerated via a quadratic shielding mechanism, whereby learning the linear and quadratic components of the target function filters gradient fluctuations. We finally describe how the activation function determines the pattern of specialization and characterize the subsequent refinement of learned features. Together, these results show how collective learning gives way to individual feature discovery and clarify when learning in large neural networks admits a simple statistical description.

    DLite 为长上下文、多轮智能体工作负载提出了一种无历史推测解码方法，复用目标模型的隐状态，并加入序列头和专门设计的训练方案。这是对推理和上下文管理的重要贡献，但摘要没有研究内部机制、组合泛化或推理能力。

    Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local simple prediction problem. A lightweight sequential head further restores intra-block causal dependencies with low overhead. To effectively train this heterogeneous history-free architecture, we introduce a tailored two-stage training strategy. Experiments on general-purpose, long-context and agentic workloads show that DLite achieves 2-6 acceptance length and outperforms the state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, DSpark, up to 70%.

    Computational drug discovery requires agents to compose scientific operations and adapt to changing evidence and constraints. Here we introduce DrugHarness, an evolvable agent harness coupling composable scientific execution with conditional skill induction. Its environment integrates over 80 scientific operations, biomedical resources and task-specific code, preserving associations among candidates, results and artifacts. From execution trajectories and outcome feedback, DrugHarness induces action hypotheses with observable applicability conditions, recommended actions and supporting evidence. An independent review agent evaluates candidate skills derived from these hypotheses through source verification and, when needed, targeted execution trials. Admitted skills guide subsequent tasks and are revised through feedback. Evaluation on MolBench and SMDD-Bench demonstrates capabilities in molecular screening, optimization and constrained design. Without evolution, DrugHarness exceeds reported MolClaw-CC results by 10.8 percentage points in affinity-comparison accuracy and 55% in mean top-three active hits on MolBench. Retrospective evaluation on skill-development tasks shows that evolution increases Qwen's affinity-comparison accuracy from 62.2% to 81.1% and optimization success from 79.5% to 87.2%. In a prospective HPK1 study, DrugHarness achieves a more favorable median docking score than Biomni among system-specific candidates. A synthesized compound achieves a cellular IC50 of 14.19 nM, a 2.64-fold potency improvement over the best input reference, with activity competitive with two selected compounds designed by experienced medicinal chemists. These results support conditional skill evolution for scientific agents and demonstrate a workflow connecting computational drug design with experimental validation.

    超越语言的引导：通过成对残差子空间移除改进多语言免训练文本嵌入

    Ailiang Lin, Zhuoyun Li, Yusong Wang, Keyu Mao, Kotaro Funakoshi, Manabu Okumura

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies language-conditioned representation geometry and proposes a subspace intervention to remove language-specific components from LLM embeddings. This is a substantial, transferable representation-method contribution, while multilingual embedding performance alone does not establish composition, reasoning, or systems advances.

    本文研究受语言条件影响的表征几何，并提出一种子空间干预方法，以去除 LLM 嵌入中的语言特定分量。这是对表征方法的一项重要且可迁移的贡献；多语言嵌入性能本身并不能证明其对组合性、推理或系统方面有所推进。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While deriving text embeddings directly from frozen LLMs has emerged as a promising direction, existing methods focus almost exclusively on English, leaving multilingual settings largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual training-free text embeddings in LLMs. Our analysis reveals a language-conditioned embedding geometry in which semantically equivalent sentences remain misaligned across languages. We hypothesize that language-specific variation can be disentangled from semantic content to improve embedding quality. To this end, we propose Paired-Residual Subspace Removal (PRSR), a training-free inference-time intervention that steers LLM representations toward a more language-invariant semantic space. PRSR first constructs paired residuals from multilingual parallel sentences to capture language-specific deviations. It then estimates layer-wise low-rank subspaces from these residuals and suppresses the corresponding components in the last-token hidden states. We conduct more than 200 monolingual evaluations across 18 languages using MTEB and MMTEB, along with cross-lingual bitext mining between English and over 200 other languages. Empirical results demonstrate that PRSR consistently improves the performance of existing training-free baselines in both monolingual and cross-lingual settings across different LLMs.

    中文

    直接从冻结的 LLM 中提取文本嵌入已成为一个有前景的方向，但现有方法几乎只关注英语，多语言场景仍基本未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们首次对 LLM 中的多语言免训练文本嵌入进行了系统研究。我们的分析揭示了一种受语言条件影响的嵌入几何结构：语义等价的句子在不同语言间仍然无法对齐。我们假设，可以将语言特定变化与语义内容解耦，从而提升嵌入质量。为此，我们提出成对残差子空间移除（PRSR），这是一种无需训练的推理时干预方法，能够引导 LLM 表征进入更加语言不变的语义空间。PRSR 首先从多语言平行句中构造成对残差，以捕捉语言特定偏差；随后，它从这些残差中估计逐层低秩子空间，并抑制最后一个 token 隐状态中的相应分量。我们使用 MTEB 和 MMTEB，在 18 种语言上进行了 200 多项单语评估，并开展了英语与 200 多种其他语言之间的跨语言双语文本挖掘。实证结果表明，在不同 LLM 上，PRSR 在单语和跨语言设置中始终能提升现有免训练基线的表现。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formulates personalized fact-level memory gating as contextual bandits with delayed feedback and contributes an online policy with a regret bound. Its central contribution is memory management for agents, while reasoning is incidental to using retrieved facts in responses and it does not study model internals or compositional generalization.

    本文将个性化事实级记忆门控表述为具有延迟反馈的上下文多臂老虎机问题，并提出了一种带有遗憾界的在线策略。其核心贡献是智能体的记忆管理；推理只是使用回复中检索到的事实时附带涉及的内容，本文也没有研究模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-term memory enables language-model agents to personalize future interactions, but a finite memory bank cannot preserve every extracted fact. Existing memory gating policies are typically shared across users and therefore fail to account for user-specific patterns of future reuse. In this paper, we study memory gating at the fact level. We first propose a retrieval-based labeling strategy that labels each fact by whether it is later retrieved and incorporated into responses. We then formulate online memory gating as contextual apple tasting with delayed one-sided feedback, and propose Warm-Start UCB, which combines offline learning from existing data with online adaptation to the current user. Our theoretical analysis establishes a high-probability regret upper bound of $\tilde{O}(T\epsilon \wedge d\sqrt{T})$ when the delay window is at most $O(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the total number of rounds, $\epsilon$ is the initialization error, $d$ is the dimension of the feature map, and $\tilde{O}(\cdot)$ hides constant and poly-logarithmic factors. The results of our experiment demonstrate that our method outperforms all baselines under different memory budgets and history lengths, establishing it as a promising personalized memory gating policy.

    中文

    长期记忆使语言模型智能体能够为未来交互提供个性化服务，但有限的记忆库无法保存提取出的所有事实。现有记忆门控策略通常在不同用户间共享，因此无法考虑用户特定的未来复用模式。在本文中，我们研究事实级记忆门控。我们首先提出一种基于检索的标注策略，根据每条事实之后是否被检索并纳入回复来为其标注。随后，我们将在线记忆门控表述为具有延迟单边反馈的上下文苹果品尝问题，并提出 Warm-Start UCB，将基于现有数据的离线学习与针对当前用户的在线适应相结合。我们的理论分析证明，当延迟窗口至多为 $\tilde{O}(T\epsilon \wedge d\sqrt{T})$ 时，以高概率成立的遗憾上界为 $O(\sqrt{T})$；其中 $T$ 表示总轮数，$\epsilon$ 表示初始化误差，$d$ 表示特征映射的维度，而 $\tilde{O}(\cdot)$ 隐含常数因子和对数多项式因子。实验结果表明，在不同的记忆预算和历史长度下，我们的方法都优于所有基线，证明它是一种有前景的个性化记忆门控策略。

We introduce the self-building laboratory (SBL), which designs, configures, and operates its own laboratory setup given a high-level scientific goal.     量子网络中的传输质量估计：计算、仿真还是学习？

    Anis Bekri, Amar Abane, Van Sy Mai, Abdella Battou, Saddek Bensalem

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The article proposes a compute/simulate/learn framework for estimating entanglement fidelity to support quantum-network control, with a simulation-based proof of concept and learned surrogates for faster estimates. Its relevance is strong for system control and resource allocation, while learning a surrogate is only an incidental connection to AI mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文提出计算／仿真／学习框架，用于估计纠缠保真度以支持量子网络控制，并提供了基于仿真的概念验证及可加速估计的学习型替代模型。该工作与系统控制和资源分配密切相关，而学习替代模型与 AI 机制或组合泛化的联系仅属附带。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Future quantum networks will rely on control-plane decisions such as routing, scheduling, entanglement provisioning, purification, and memory allocation. Each decision depends on a timely and reliable estimate of the quality of the entanglement that a candidate path can deliver, with end-to-end fidelity as a central metric. Inspired by the optical-networking experience with quality-of-transmission (QoT) estimation, this article asks when a quantum controller should compute fidelity analytically, simulate it, or learn a surrogate model. The optical analogy is useful but incomplete: optical QoT estimation often predicts a scalar transmission margin, whereas quantum QoT estimation must account for probabilistic entanglement generation, random memory waiting times, decoherence, state consumption, and measurement constraints that can make fidelity a stochastic target. We propose a compute/simulate/learn framework for quantum QoT estimation and illustrate it with a simulation-based proof of concept. Our study shows that analytical composition can be sufficient in simple regimes, that simulation becomes necessary when stochastic memory effects shape the delivered fidelity distribution, and that lightweight learned surrogates can approximate simulator labels at much lower runtime cost for online control. We close with open challenges for deployment, including stochastic targets, sim-to-real transfer, data-generation cost, physics-informed learning, and generalization beyond individual paths to full network topologies.

    中文

    未来的量子网络将依赖控制平面决策，例如路由、调度、纠缠配置、纯化和存储器分配。每项决策都取决于能否及时、可靠地估计候选路径可提供的纠缠质量，其中端到端保真度是一项核心指标。受光网络中传输质量（QoT）估计经验的启发，本文探讨量子控制器应在何时解析计算保真度、对其进行仿真，或学习一个替代模型。光网络的类比虽有参考价值，但并不完整：光学 QoT 估计通常预测一个标量传输裕量，而量子 QoT 估计必须考虑概率性纠缠生成、随机存储器等待时间、退相干、状态消耗以及测量约束；这些因素可能使保真度成为随机目标。我们提出一个用于量子 QoT 估计的计算／仿真／学习框架，并以基于仿真的概念验证加以说明。我们的研究表明，在简单情形下，解析组合可能已足够；当随机存储器效应影响交付保真度的分布时，则需要仿真；而轻量级学习型替代模型能够以低得多的运行时成本近似仿真器标签，以供在线控制使用。最后，我们讨论部署面临的开放挑战，包括随机目标、从仿真到现实的迁移、数据生成成本、物理信息引导的学习，以及从单条路径泛化到完整网络拓扑。

    A reasoning trace can accompany a correct answer without providing effective supervision for a particular student. We study how to construct traces that improve learning beyond answer-only supervision by considering both their intermediate content and their accessibility to the target learner. We introduce ReDiST, a student-conditioned trace-construction and distillation framework for evidence-rich reasoning. Starting from the student's own attempts, ReDiST revises answer-correct drafts against the supplied evidence and repairs unsuccessful drafts with additional guidance from the verified answer. A frozen student-matched reader screens and ranks original and edited candidates using answer recovery and verified-answer probability, given the question, evidence, and candidate trace. We distill the selected targets while balancing trace and final-answer supervision with an auxiliary answer loss. Construction and selection occur offline, and inference uses only the distilled student. Experiments on question-answering benchmarks show that ReDiST can improve both source-task and cross-benchmark performance over answer-only, original-trace, and the evaluated trace-selection and rewriting baselines. Across supervision recipes, performance rankings can differ between source and transfer benchmarks, highlighting the importance of evaluating trace teaching utility across distributions.

    正确答案可以附带一条推理轨迹，但这条轨迹未必能为特定学生模型提供有效监督。我们研究如何构建推理轨迹，使其相较于仅用答案监督更能促进学习，同时考虑轨迹的中间内容及其对目标学习者的可理解性。我们提出 ReDiST，这是一个面向证据丰富推理的学生条件化轨迹构建与蒸馏框架。ReDiST 从学生模型自身的尝试出发，依据给定证据修订答案正确的草稿，并借助已验证答案提供的额外指导来修复未成功的草稿。一个与学生模型匹配且参数冻结的阅读器，在给定问题、证据和候选轨迹后，依据答案恢复能力和已验证答案概率，对原始及编辑后的候选内容进行筛选和排序。我们对选出的目标进行蒸馏，同时通过辅助答案损失平衡推理轨迹与最终答案监督。构建和筛选均在线下完成，推理时只使用蒸馏后的学生模型。在问答基准上的实验表明，相较于仅用答案、原始推理轨迹，以及所评估的轨迹筛选和改写基线，ReDiST 能够提升源任务和跨基准表现。在不同监督方案之间，模型在源基准和迁移基准上的表现排名可能不同，这凸显了跨分布评估推理轨迹教学效用的重要性。

    DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses

    DiscoveryRSI：递归学习发现有价值的假设

    Jianyuan Zhong, Chenwei Wu, Zhaochen Yu, Xixian Jiang, Xuewei Li, Hao Xiao, Xilin Dai, Junyang Wang, Jiaru Zou, Zhiqing Cui, Boyuan Zheng, Jing Xiong, Zhen Zhang, Qiang Gao, Michael Morley, Luis Nakayama, Qiang Xu, Liyue Shen, Tao Gui, Leo Anthony Celi, James Zou, Zhenfei Yin, Yingcheng Wu, Ling Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DiscoveryRSI develops a multi-agent research workflow that recursively improves hypothesis generation, investigation strategies, and evaluation, with reported gains in scientific hypothesis quality. This advances agent organization and task execution, while reasoning is relevant through hypothesis development but remains part of a broader research-agent contribution; no internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization are described.

    DiscoveryRSI 构建了一套多智能体研究工作流，能够递归改进假设生成、调查策略和评估，并报告了科学假设质量的提升。这项工作推动了智能体组织和任务执行；推理能力与假设发展相关，但仍是更广泛的研究智能体工作的组成部分；文中没有描述模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scientific discovery requires developing worthwhile hypotheses into practical investigations, yet learning from this evolving research process remains challenging. We introduce an operational definition of valuable and testable research hypotheses: evidence-grounded claims about consequential uncertainties, coupled with feasible investigations, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations. Our DiscoveryRSI framework develops hypothesis trees through multi-agent evolutionary search, compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks, and recursively learns through three mechanisms: hypothesis credit optimization attributes scientific assessments to documented research contributions; harness replay identifies productive strategies and recurring failures to refine research workflows; and rediscovery applies accepted improvements to new investigations, generating further experience for subsequent learning. We also introduce DFM-Bench, which provides comprehensive assessment of hypothesis quality and cumulative research progress at the levels of hypotheses, revisions, development paths and research runs. Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation shows that hypothesis quality rises from 4.86 for the base model to 5.39 after two rounds of self-improvement, with the large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability. We further validate hypothesis quality through expert review, comparing our DiscoveryRSI-27B with other research agents. Preliminary human assessments show that DiscoveryRSI-27B scores higher than GPT-6 Luna on hypothesis importance and whether claims are plausible and evidence-bounded. DiscoveryRSI-27B achieved a 6.3% rate of hypothesis correspondence with research published after the model cutoff, largely outperform GPT-6 with 2.5% and Claude Opus 5 with 2.3%, while delivering greater human-rated improvement along research paths.

    中文

    科学发现需要将有价值的假设发展为切实可行的研究，但从这一不断演进的研究过程中学习仍然颇具挑战。我们对有价值且可检验的研究假设给出操作性定义：以证据为依据、针对重要不确定性的主张，并配有可行的调查、明确的判定标准和替代解释。我们的 DiscoveryRSI 框架通过多智能体进化搜索构建假设树，将选定的调查编译为可执行的 Harbor 任务，并通过三种机制递归学习：假设信用优化将科学评估归因于有记录的研究贡献；执行框架回放识别有效策略和反复出现的失败，以改进研究工作流；重新发现则将已接受的改进应用于新的调查，为后续学习生成更多经验。我们还推出 DFM-Bench，在假设、修订、发展路径和研究运行等层面全面评估假设质量和累计研究进展。在四个生命科学领域中，自动评估显示，经过两轮自我改进后，假设质量从基础模型的 4.86 提升至 5.39，其中可证伪性和数据可解析性提升显著。我们还通过专家评审验证假设质量，并将 DiscoveryRSI-27B 与其他研究智能体进行比较。初步人工评估显示，DiscoveryRSI-27B 在假设重要性，以及主张是否合理且受证据约束方面的得分高于 GPT-6 Luna。DiscoveryRSI-27B 与模型截点之后发表的研究相对应的假设比例达到 6.3%，大幅超过 GPT-6 的 2.5% 和 Claude Opus 5 的 2.3%，同时在研究路径上的人评改进幅度更大。
